steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Achari Paneer Masala Recipe, firstly soak the cashews in hot water for about 15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Dry roast the ingredients listed under masala which includes coriander seeds, fennel seeds, mustard seeds, methi seeds, Kashmiri dry red chillies, Kalonji, cumin seeds on low flame for about 5-10 minutes till the spices release their aroma.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Let them cool and grind to a powder using a mixer grinder. Puree the green capsicum, cashews and tomatoes together and set aside. Heat the mustard oil to its smoking point in a heavy bottomed pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add green chillies, asafoetida and saute for 10-15 seconds. After 10 to 15 seconds, add in the chopped onions and cook till they turn slightly golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onions are brown, add the powdered masalas and roast together for about 15 -20 seconds. Spoon in the pureed tomato and capsicum and cook till the gravy thickens and the oil separates and starts floating on the sides.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: This will take about 5 to 7 minutes. After 5 to 7 minutes, add the paneer and cook for just 2 minutes till the Achari Paneer Masala comes up to the temperature of the gravy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, check the salt and seasonings and adjust according to taste. Turn off the heat and transfer the Achari Paneer Masala to a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Achari Paneer Masala Recipe along with Phulka or Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, and Boondi Raita for a weekend meal.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Akuri Recipe, first chop onions, tomatoes and green chilies finely. Grate garlic cloves. Keep aside until ready to cook the Akuri.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Break all the eggs into a bowl, add salt to taste, pour in the cream and whisk well. The more you whisk the eggs, the fluffier the akuri will be. So take time to whisk the eggs thoroughly till frothy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Place a pan on the heat, melt some butter into it. Add grated garlic, chopped green chilies and onions and saute it all up until onions turn pink, but take care not to brown them.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: When the onions are soft and translucent, add tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn soft and release its juices. Now add the egg-cream Akuri mixture and allow it cook for a minute.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Then gently scrape the sides of the pan, slightly scrambling the eggs. Stir it all up and once again allow it to cook for a minute. Continue to gently scrape and scramble till the eggs are cooked, but not over cooked.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: They should be soft, slightly runny and creamy, and not shredded into separate bits. Sprinkle some chopped coriander leaves, mix well and turn off the flame and the Parsi Style Seasoned Scrambled Eggs is ready.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Akuri Recipe (Parsi Style Seasoned Scrambled Eggs) hot with sliced bread or toast and tea or coffee.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Mixed vegetables - mix of potato

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Allahabadi Tehri Recipe (UP Style Vegetable Rice), wash and soak the basmati rice for 10 minutes in water. Cut all the vegetables, namely potatoes, beans, cauliflower and carrots to similar size and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat mustard oil in a wide pan, and let it smoke. Add the asafoetida, whole garam masalas - cinnamon, bay leaf, green and black cardamoms, pepper corns and cloves and let the oil become fragrant.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, add the sliced onions and saute until translucent. Now, roughly pound the ginger garlic using a mortar and pestle and add it to the pan, and saute until the raw smell goes away.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the green chillies, turmeric, red chilli, cumin and coriander powder and saute for a minute. Add the cut vegetables and mix well till they turn a bit golden.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, add the whisked yoghurt and saute until the mixute comes together. Add in the drained rice, 4 cups of water, season with salt and cover it with a lid to cook for 20 minutes untouched.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once its cooked, add in the ghee, lemon juice, gently mix everything together and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Allahabadi Tehri Recipe (UP Style Vegetable Rice) along with Mirchi Ka Salan and Burani Raita for the weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Badam & Besan Ladoo recipe, start by melting homemade ghee in a Wok or Kadai, making sure that the heat is low.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in the gram flour, semolina and keep stirring for about 8-10 minutes till the mix gets a nice golden brown colour and starts bubbling. Keep the heat low through the process and continuously keep stirring to avoid charring.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add few sprinkles of water to the mix and stir well, this gives the tiny lumps of besan ladoo mixture. Switch off and add cardamom and raisins. Mix well till the mixture cools down.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Cardamom added to the hot mixture will infuse its aroma well. Let the mixture cool completely in normal condition. It takes a good 30 minutes or more. You could transfer the mixture to another kadai.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Meanwhile, heat the kadai again over low heat and dry roast almonds till aromatic and evenly roasted well. In a grinder, once the almonds cool down a bit, dry grind them to make a flour.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add sugar and almond flour to the mix and make sure it is evenly combined.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally roll out the dough form balls,adding a few rose petal leaves for that earthy touch and keep on a parchment to set for 10minutes before the badam and besan ladoos are ready to eat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve these Badam & Besan Ladoos during tea time with Turmeric Milk recipe and Baked Palak Ki Mathri or Khara Biscuit recipe.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To make Badam Nu Goshta recipe, first we will make masala for gravy. Soak the almonds in hot water for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes take out the water and put the soaked almonds in the mixer jar.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add ginger, garlic, dry red chilli, cinnamon, black pepper, long, a little water with almonds in a mixer jar and grind it to a paste. Keep it aside. Wash the mutton and soak it in hot water for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Now in a pressure cooker, add mutton, bay leaves, salt, 1/2 cup water and cook the pressure till 3 hours come, turn off the gas and let the pressure drain automatically. Heat the ghee in a pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add onions and cook it to become light brown. Now add almond masala and cook for 5 to 6 minutes. Now add tomatoes, salt and cook till the tomatoes become soft. It will take 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After 3 to 4 minutes add mutton to it, turn the heat on high, add milk and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Turn off the gas after cooking and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: You can serve Badam Nu Goshta Recipe with Cheese Garlic Naan and Shahanshahi Parsi Keema Pulao for dinner.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Nariyal Ki Kachori Recipe (Farali Aloo Vada), in a large mixing bowl, first mash the boiled potatoes until it is creamy. Add arrowroot powder, salt and cumin to the potato and stir well to combine.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Next we will make the stuffing for the potato mixture. In a bowl combine the fresh coconut, coriander, green chili,ginger,lemon juice, sugar, cashew nuts, peanuts ,raisins and a pinch of salt to taste.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Use your fingers and combine all the ingredients well. Shape the potato mixture into lemon size balls. Grease your palms and fingers with oil and take a potato ball and flatten it by pressing with your fingertips.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Spoon about a tablespoon of coconut mixture in the center. Cover the coconut mixture by bringing the potato from the sides to the center. Smoothen it to make a farali aloo vada.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Dust the aloo vada lightly in the dry arrowroot powder or cornflour. Preheat a Kuzhi Paniyaram pan, and add a few drops of oil in each cavity.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Place each of the stuffed Fatali Aloo Vadas into the cavities and fry until golden brown and crisp on all sides. Make sure you fry the vadas on medium heat so they get cooked evenly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Nariyal Ki Kachori (Farali Aloo Vada) along with Coconut Chutney or Green Chutney for Navratri festival or any other special occasion in the family. They made a healthy tea time snack or even appetizers for parties

name: Aloo Beetroot and Baby Corn Mixed Sabzi

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Baby corn - cut into strips
1/2 cup Green beans (French Beans) - cut into strips

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Aloo, Beetroot and Baby Corn Mixed Sabzi Recipe, cut the vegetables into strips and set aside.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: In a Pressure cooker, combine the beetroot, baby corn, carrot, and beans, add ¼ cup of water and pressure cook for 1 whistle, turn off the flame. Release the pressure immediately.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In a pan, heat mustard oil on medium-high heat, add the mustard seeds and allow them to crackle. Add the garlic and ginger, saute for a few minutes until the garlic turns golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next add in the slit green chilies and raw potato strips, cover and continue to cook until the potatoes are soft. Occasionally, open the lid and give it a mix.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally, add in the pressure cooked vegetables- beetroot, carrot, beans, baby corn and salt and turmeric. Give it a good stir and garnish with coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Aloo, Beetroot and Baby Corn Mixed Sabzi hot .Serve this Aloo Beetroot and Baby Corn Mixed Sabzi Recipe with Pudina Tawa Paratha Recipe (Mint Leaf Skillet Flat Bread) and Tadkewali Masoor Dal Recipe and Palak Raita Recipe (Spinach Yogurt Salad)

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Aloo Matar Korma Recipe In White Gravy, wash and pressure cook the baby potatoes to 2 whistles. Peel and keep aside. Similarly, steam or boil the green peas and keep them aside.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Make a smooth paste of the ingredients mentioned under 'grind into a smooth paste' which includes onion, cashew nuts, green chillies and ginger using a mixer grinder. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Now, heat ghee in a heavy bottomed pan, add the bayleaf, cardamoms, cloves and let it release its aroma into the ghee. This will take about 10 to 15 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground onion ginger cashew mixture into the pan and saute for 3 minutes. Gently whisk the curd and garam masala into the cream to a smooth texture and add it to the pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a cup of water, season with salt and let it simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Add the boiled baby potatoes and green peas, simmer for another 2 minutes and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve this delicious Aloo Matar Korma Recipe In White Gravy along with Tawa Paratha and Palak Raita for a weekday meal.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To prepare Aloo Posto (Potatoes in Poppy Seed Paste), get prep with all the ingredients and start by soaking khus khus in enough water for 15-20 minutes. Grind soaked khus khus to make a fine paste and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat vegetable oil and mustard oil together in a Wok/Kadai (You can use any of them either). Add kalonji and wait till it crackles. Now add sliced onions if using, and then the green chilies.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Sauté for a while and add potatoes and fry. After a while, add turmeric powder and mix well. Cook till potatoes start to soften. Add the khus khus paste and a little water, stir, and season with salt. Mix well and close the lid.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook in low flame till khus khus thickens. Add finely chopped coriander and turn off the gas. Serve Aloo Posto hot with Rice, Bengali Luchi and Phalguni dal with a dash of lemon juice.

ingredients.text: 500 grams Seeraga (Jeeraga) Samba rice - washed and soaked

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Ambur Star Chicken Biryani, thoroughly wash and clean the chicken and set aside. Soak the Seeraga samba rice, for a minimum of 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In an open pan, add ghee, bay leaf, star anise, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom. To this add 2 cups of water and bring to a single boil. Add the washed and drained rice and cook until the rice is about 70% cooked. (The rice grain should be undercooked in the center) Set aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In a deep kadai, on medium flame, heat 4 tablespoons of oil, add the sliced onions and cook till transparent for about 5-7 minutes. At this stage mix in the ginger paste, garlic paste and salt. Saute for a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix in the chopped tomatoes and cook until they are soft. At this stage add in the red chilli powder and coriander seeds powder.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Once the onion-tomato mixture comes together, slightly tilt the kadai, and remove the excess oil, spoon by spoon into a small cup/katori. Now that the excess oil has been drained out, add the yogurt/curd and chicken and mix well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Allow the chicken to cook until almost done to about 80%.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix in the mint leavesTo assemble to biryani, while the chicken continues to be in the kadai, add the 70% cooked seeraga samba rice on top of the chicken pieces and pour the excess flavoured oil over the rice and cover the kadai with a plate.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Turn the flame to the lowest heat possible. In a saucepan, boil water and turn off the flame and place this hot pan on the lid of the kadai. This process is done in order to seal the kadai in which the biryani is cooking.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The heat from the hot water in the saucepan provides heat from the top, while there is heat from the bottom as well creating the effect of "Dum". Let the biryani sit on this "Dum" for a good 20 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: After 20 minutes open the lid and lightly fluff up the biryani with a fork and serve piping hot. Serve the Ambur Star Chicken Biryani along with Tadka Raita Recipe (Spiced Curd With Onions) and Chettinad Kathirikai Chops Recipe for Sunday Lunch.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: To begin making the Anda Bhurji Recipe - Spicy Indian Style Scrambled Eggs whisk the eggs in a bowl with milk and salt to taste until light and fluffy and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Into a preheated pan add ghee, the cumin seeds, onions and chopped green chillies and saute till the onions turn slightly caramelized. Once done stir in the tomatoes and saute till they have soften.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the tomatoes have softened, add the whisked eggs. Turn the heat to low and keep stirring the eggs until it scrambles. It is important to cook on low heat for light and fluffy textured Anda Bhurji.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the Anda Bhurji is cooked, stir in the chopped coriander leaves and turn off the heat. Transfer the anda bhurji into a serving plate and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Anda bhurji for breakfast with buttered Homemade Whole Wheat Pav Recipe / Ladi Pav and Homemade Fresh Orange Juice or a wholesome and delicious lunch or dinner with a Tawa Paratha Recipe - Plain Paratha

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: To begin making the Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns recipe, in a heat proof boil collect chopped garlic and green chilies and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat vegetable oil in a pan till smoking hot, and pour the hot oil immediately over the chopped garlic and chilies. Wait till they crackle and leaves and aroma. Set aside to cool.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: While the garlic oil is cooling, set up a steamer and place the prawns in a pan/plate that will go inside the steamer.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Pour the garlic infused oil all over the prawns and gently rub them, season with some salt and set to marinade till the steamer gets ready. Now steam the prawns for around 8 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Meanwhile mix soy sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl. Take out the cooked prawns and spoon the sauce mix all over. Sprinkle some freshly crushed black pepper and some chopped coriander.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Drizzle some lemon juice over the prawns if you like or else skip it. Serve hot. Serve Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns as a side dish along with steamed rice and Jeera Rasam for a weekday meal.

ingredients.text: 500 grams Chicken - chopped to cubes with bone
2-1/2 tablespoons Whole Black Peppercorns - freshly crushed

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: To begin making Andhra Pepper Chicken Recipe, take a big bowl and marinate the chicken pieces with turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, salt and lemon juice, mix and keep refrigerated for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a deep frying pan, once the oil is hot, temper the oil with cinnamon stick, cloves and 3/4 portion of curry leaves and saute it for about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After 30 seconds, add the chopped onions and saute till they turn golden and start to caramelize. Once the onions are starting to brown, immediately add chopped green chillies and marinated chicken, saute for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add coriander powder and crushed pepper, mix well and cook on low flame until the curry comes together from sides of the pan. Stirring, intermittently sprinkle water as and when required. This will take about 4 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add about 1/4 cup water, once water starts boiling, reduce the heat and cover. Cook until the chicken is tender and cooked.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the chicken is soft cooked, open the lid and stir on medium heat till the moisture evaporates .Sprinkle chopped 3/4 cup of coriander and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Before serving garnish with 1 teaspoon crushed pepper, 1 teaspoon lemon juice and remaining coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Andhra Pepper Chicken Recipe along with Tawa Paratha Recipe, steamed rice and Andhra Style Pappu Charu Recipe (Lentil Soup Style Curry) for lunch.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Andhra Style Allam Pachadi, heat a kadai with oil, add the dals and saute them till they are light brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the dry red chillies, coriander seeds, onions, ginger and saute them till the onions are translucent. Once done, add the tomatoes and salt and saute till the tomato becomes mushy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Switch off the heat and grind it to a smooth paste. To make the tempering, heat a small kadai with oil, add mustard seeds and allow it to splutter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the curry leaves and hing, leave it for 10 seconds and pour it over the chutney. Serve the Andhra Style Allam Pachadi along with pesarattu or idli to enjoy your morning breakfast.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making Andhra Style Beetroot Vepudu, Firstly wash, peel and chop the beetroot into small cubes.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Steam the beetroot in a steamer until it becomes soft or place a sauce pan with water on medium heat and add chopped beetroot. Cover it with a lid and cook till it is done. The next step is to temper the steamed beetroots.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add oil to a wide pan and add cumin seeds, chana dal, urad dal, curry leaves, dry red chilli and fry until dal changes its colour.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add steamed beetroot to it, add salt according to your taste and let it cook for 1-2 minutes more. Serve Andhra Style Beetroot Vepudu with Paruppu Urundai Rasam and steamed rice for your weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - soaked and drained

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin with Andhra Style Corn Vada, add soaked and drained chana dal, corn kernels, ginger, green chilies, curry leaves and dry chilies in a mixer grinder and make a coarse paste out of it.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Take a mixing bowl and transfer this coarse paste in it. Add gram flour, chopped coriander leaves, cumin seeds, sweet corn kernels, salt and mix everything properly. Heat a deep pan with oil.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Take some oil on your palm and make Vada, deep fry them and put them on a tissue paper for sometime to soak the excess oil and it is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Andhra Style Corn Vada with South Indian Coconut Chutney, Dhaniya Pudina Chutney or any other chutney of your choice.

ingredients.text: 3 Dry Red Chillies - or 2 green chillies will do

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: We begin making the Andhra Style Karivepaku Pachadi Recipe (Curry Leaf Chutney Recipe) by heating a skillet with oil, crackle the channa dal and roast the dry red chillies.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once done, roast the curry leaves till it crisps up and then add the chopped ginger. Give it a saute. Then add in the tamarind water and let soak up the water. Reduce the flame at this point and give it a proper stir.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Allow it to cool down and then grind it into a smooth paste. Keep it aside. Now to temper you can heat a small kadai and then crackle the mustard seeds and dry red chilli and add it over the chutney and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Andhra Style Kavepaku Pachadi Recipe (Curry Leaf Chutney Recipe) along with Carrot Onion Uttapam Recipe to relish your morning breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Spinach Leaves (Palak) - Washed and chopped

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Andhra Style Palakura Pappu, add Arhar dal/toor dal into a pressure cooker with 2 cups water and pressure cook for about 3 whistles. Switch off the heat and allow it release the pressure by itself.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Once the pressure is released, open the lid and give it a stir. Place the pressure cooker on low heat and add the tamarind water. In the meanwhile, heat a small kadai with 1 teaspoon oil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds and allow it splutter. Add curry leaves and leave it to crackle. Next add dry red chilies and garlic, saute for few seconds and turn off the flame.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Pour this tempering over the Palakura Pappu and stir well. Serve Andhra Style Palakura Pappu with Phulka or hot steamed rice with a dollop of ghee over it, and Aloo Bhindi Ki Sabzi Recipe to enjoy your lunch.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Andhra Style Makka Garelu Recipe, blitz the corn in a mixer without water to a very chunky mixture.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Transfer to a bowl, add the remaining ingredients including the besan and combine to make a thick garelu mixture. Check the salt and adjust to taste accordingly. Heat oil for deep frying.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot take small portions of the makka garelu mixture, flatten it to make a round disc and slide into the hot oil. Fry until the garelu is browned and crisp.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Ensure you fry over medium heat, so it gets cooked evenly from inside out. Serve the Makka Garelu along with hot tea or dip it with a Date and Tamarind Chutney Recipe to enjoy your evening snack.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Andhra Style Nalla Karam Podi Recipe, get ready with all the ingredients. Heat a little oil in a kadai.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, on a medium flame, fry coriander seeds on a low medium flame until crisp and smells divine. It takes about a minute or two. Take the coriander seeds out of the kadai and put them on a plate to cool off.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: In the same kadai, roast Pottukadalai (Senagalu) and black urad dal. Fry until golden brown. Remove them on the plate along with coriander seeds.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Next, in the same kadai, dry roast chillies, curry leaves and tamarind till the moisture from tamarind is reduced a bit. Make sure not to burn chillies or curry leaves, saute till they crisp up.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once they are dry roasted, take them off on another plate to cool. After switching off the heat, add in the garlic and saute for a minute and leave in kadai for a minute.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix everything and allow to rest for a few minutes until the ingredients are cooled to room temperature. Transfer all the ingredients to a mixer jar and grind to a fine powder.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Andhra Style Nalla Karam Podi Recipe along with Tomato Uttapam Recipe, Ragi Idli Recipe and Chow-Chow Sambar (Chayote Squash Sambar) Recipe or along with a meal plate of steamed rice, Kollu Rasam Recipe (Nourishing HorseGram Stew), Elai Vadam Recipe and Mango Pickle (Andhra Avakaya) Recipe.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Andhra Style Paruppu Podi, heat oil in a kadhai/wok & roast the red chillies for abaout 3-4 minutes. When the chillies are roasted collect them in a plate.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In the same pan, add 1/2 teaspoon of oil & roast the dals - chana dal, urad dal, toor dal, moong dal and horse gramon low flame until golden brown. When done, collect them in a plate. Allow the ingredients to cool down completely.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind salt, jaggery, red chillies, hing into fine powder in a grinder. Then add in the dals & grind them into coarse powder. Andhra Style Paruppu Podi is ready to serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve this Andhra Style Paruppu Podi with hot steamed rice with a dash of ghee or gingerly oil and Keerai Sambar for a perfect South Indian meal.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal) - cooked
1/4 cup Raw Banana - cut into cubes
1/2 cup Bottle gourd (lauki) - cut into cubes

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making Andhra Style Pindi Miriyam Recipe, wash and pressure cook the toor dal to 3 whistles, mash and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a pan and roast all the ingredients mentioned in the spice paste table and grind it to a smooth paste using a mixer grinder by adding little water and keep aside.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Soak the lemon sized tamarind in half a cup of warm water, squeeze and extract the pulp and keep aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In the same pan, add all the vegetables, 2 cups of water, prepared spice paste, salt and let the mixture boil until the vegetables are cooked. Now, add the tamarind extract and cook until the raw smell of the tamarind goes away.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in the cooked and mashed dal, mix well and let it simmer for 5 minutes. Now, prepare a tadka by heating oil in a small tadka pan. Add in the mustard seeds, cumin, red chilli and curry leaves, let it splutter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add this prepared tadka to the boiling Andhra Style Pindi Miriyam Recipe, simmer for another 2 minutes and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Andhra Style Pindi Miriyam Recipe along with Steamed Rice, Andhra Style Kakarakaya Vepudu Recipe, Pineapple Rasam Recipe and Roasted Papad for a weekday lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making Andhra Style Potato Korma the Recipe grind the roasted poppy seeds and coconut with water to a smooth paste and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pressure cooker with oil, add fennel seeds, stone flower, star anise, cinnamon and cardamom and fry for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add sliced onions, ginger, garlic and green chilli and fry for about 5 minutes till the onions turn translucent. Add tomatoes and salt and saute until it becomes soft and mushy. Add in the chopped herbs and give it a stir.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground paste along with spice powders (red chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, coriander powder) and salt. Mix well. Saute for 5 more minutes, add potatoes and 1 cup of water and pressure cook for 3 whistle.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Switch off the heat and allow the pressure to release by itself and serve hot. Serve the Andhra Style Potato Korma along with Tawa Paratha or Hibiscus (Chembaruthi) Neer Dosa to enjoy your evening meal.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Pachi Pulusu, we will first roast the chilies in a pan till it is completely roasted. Chop the chillies very finely and transfer it to a bowl.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the tamarind water, coriander leaves, jaggery, onions and check for salt. Balance out the flavor by adding little jaggery if it is too tangy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a small tempering pan with oil, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds and allow it splutter for 10 seconds. Add curry leaves, hing, red chillies, and crushed garlic and leave the curry leaves to crackle for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Pour this over the pulusu and serve. Serve the Pachi Pulusu Recipe along with hot steamed rice, palya, and Gor Keri Recipe by the side to relish your lunch meals.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Andhra Style Uppu Pindi Recipe, you can prepare rice rava at home as well. Wash the normal rice with water and dry it out under the sun or outside for 20 minutes till it becomes dry and grind it coarsely.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil, add mustard seeds and urad dal and splutter them for 10 seconds and add the curry leaves too and let it crackle. Add in the dry red chillies, hing and fry for 10 more seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add onions and ginger, stir till the onions become translucent. Add the moong dal and fry for 2 minutes. Add about 4 cups of water and leave it to boil on a low heat. Add salt and adjust according to your palate.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: You can add the ground rice when it starts to boil and keep whisking so that there are no lumps formed. Add the sweetcorn and stir. Cover and cook over a low heat for 2 more minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Keep mixing at regular intervals so that it does not get stuck at the bottom. Serve the Andhra Style Uppu Pindi Recipe along with spicy coconut chutney and a glass of coffee by the side for your morning breakfast.

ingredients.text: 400 grams Brinjal (Baingan / Eggplant) - cut into long strips
Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - as required and roughly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Vankaya Kothimeera Karam recipe, wash and cut the brinjals in long strips and keep it immersed in salt water. This helps in avoiding the brinjals to turn black.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, add all the ingredients mentioned in the coriander masala table into a blender and make a smooth paste and keep aside. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan on medium flame, add the mustard seeds, urad dal and let it splutter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the dried red chillies and curry leaves and let it crackle. Now, add the slit brinjals and sauté until it wilts a little. Cook the brinjal until it is half done. This will take 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, add the spicy coriander masala mix to the brinjals, season with salt, toss well, and let it simmer for 10 minutes. Once the brinjals are well cooked, turn off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Transfer Vankaya Kothimeera Karam into a serving bowl and serve hot. Serve Vankaya Kothimeera Karam along with Tomato Onion Sambar and steamed rice with a dollop of ghee doe a weeknight dinner.

name: Andhra Style Vegetarian Biryani with Soya Chunks

ingredients.text: Sunflower Oil - or ghee for cooking

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Andhra Style Vegetarian Biryani, soak the soy chunks in 1/4 cup water and keep it aside. Soak the basmati rice also in water and keep it aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Ground all the spice mix mentioned in the biryani spice mix to a coarse powder. Heat a pressure cooker with oil. Add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves, star anise and mace.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry the spice for 10 seconds until the aroma is released. Add the chopped onions, ginger garlic paste and green chili. Sauté until the onions become light brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped tomatoes and little bit of salt so that the tomatoes will get cooked faster and become mushy. Add the powdered spice mix, turmeric powder and give it a mix.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Wash the soaked rice several times and add only the rice into the sautéed gravy. Add the soaked soya chunks as well. Mix well till the masala is mixed.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add 4 cups of water, check for salt and pressure cook for 2 whistle and switch off the heat. Allow the pressure to release by itself and open the lid and mix the rice well with the masala and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Andhra Style Vegetarian Biryani with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita and Mirchi Ka Salan Recipe by the side.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Annanas Ka Muzzafar Recipe (Pineapple layered Rice Recipe)start by heating the pressure cooker, add a tablespoon of ghee, toast the cinnamon and cloves. Then add in the rice, fry for few seconds.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Pour 2 cups of water, 50 ml water mixed with saffron and cook for 2 whistle. Once done release the pressure naturally. After the rice is cooked, remove all the spices from the rice and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a saucepan, add sugar, 1/4 cup water and a cinnamon pod, and keep mashing till it becomes thick and mushy. Heat another saucepan with ghee, add paneer, cashew nuts and raisins and fry them till it is golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In a flat ceramic bowl, add the pineapple and spread it over, then add the saffron rice, layer it till the brim and sprinkle the golden brown paneer and toasted nuts on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Annanas Ka Muzzafar Recipe (Pineapple layered Rice Recipe) as a dessert with a awadhi meal of Awadhi Style Taheri ,Awadhi Style Khatti Arbi Ka Salan and Makhana Ka Raita.

ingredients.text: 3 cups Sunflower Oil - for deep frying

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: For the dough:To begin preparing the Apple Cinnamon Modaks, combine maida, sooji or rava and rice flour together with salt. Add milk and start kneading until the dough is soft.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once it comes together, add the ghee and knead well once again.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Keep the dough covered with a cloth, to rest for 15 minutesFor the filling:In a Saucepan on a medium flame, add the apple pieces and brown sugar an cook the mixture till the sugar dissolves and the apples become soft.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Take it off the flame and add the cinnamon powder to it. Cool it down a bit before shaping the modaks. To assemble:Divide the dough into 8 portions the and keep remaining portions covered with a moist cloth to prevent drying.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Take one portion, roll into a ball and placing it on your palm, start flattening it out with the other hand, using fingers to make the edges thinner than the center. The disc you get should be about an inch in diameter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Form the disc into a bowl shape and then add a spoonful of the filling. Pinch the edges upwards and the bring them together to form the classic modak shape, making sure its sealed properly at the top. Giving it a pointy tip.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry these modaks in hot oil till they are golden brown and crisp. The Apple Cinnamon Modaks are now ready to become the talk of your festive celebrations!

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Apple, Kiwi, Pineapple Juice Recipe, prep all the ingredient ready. Add all the fruits into a blender and blitz them to a smooth paste.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In the middle add little water to adjust your consistency of the juice and blitz again. Serve it into a glass.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Apple, Kiwi, and Pineapple Juice Recipe with a bowl of porridge or a sandwich by the side for your morning breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil - or regular oil

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Arachuvitta Sambar Recipe, cook the toor dal in a pressure cooker adding 2 cups of water until you hear couple of whistles. After a couple of whistles, turn the heat to low and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, turn off the heat and allow the pressure to release naturally. Once the pressure is released open the cooker and whisk the dal until smooth. Keep this aside. Prepare the tamarind water according to the recipe and keep it aside. Cut the vegetables and keep aside. Next we will roast the spices for the Arachuvitta sambar recipe.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: In a small skillet, bengal gram dal and the urad dal; roast them on a medium heat until the dal is well roasted and has turned browned. It's important to roast on low to medium heat to it does not brown too fast.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once it's roasted, add the coriander seeds, methi seeds and red chilies and roast for about a minute until you smell the aroma. Finally, add the grated coconut and roast until the aroma comes through and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Allow the roasted sambar spice mixture to cool a bit. Once cooled, grind the mixture in a mixer grinder to make a powder. Keep this aside. The next step is to cook the vegetables. Into a pressure cooker, add the prepared tamarind water, the cut carrots, radish, drumstick, onions, turmeric powder, salt and the ground sambar powder. Pressure cook for a couple of whistles and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the pressure is released, add the cooked dal into the tamarind water. Stir well to combine. Check the salt and adjust to suit your taste. Give the Arachuvitta Sambar a brisk boil for a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Adjust the consistency of the Sambar by adding water and then simmering for a few more minutes. Once done, turn off the heat and stir in the chopped coriander leaves and transfer the Arachuvitta Sambar a serving bowl.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: The final step is the tadka for the sambar. In a small Tadka Pan, add the sesame oil and allow it to heat up a little. Once the oil is hot, add the mustard seeds, curry leaves and allow it to crackle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally add the asafoetida powder to oil and stir. Turn off the heat. Add this tadka to the Arachuvitta Sambar, stir and serve hot. Serve the Arachuvitta Sambar along with Steamed Rice, topped with ghee and a vegetable like Andhra Style Pavakkai Curry, Avarakkai Poriyal or Masala Roasted Baby Potatoes for a lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: You can also combine it along with rice and make it into a One Pot Meal - like Sambar Sadam (Rice) and serve it with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita.

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup Potato (Aloo) - cut into small cubes
Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - a small bunch finely chopped
Mint Leaves (Pudina) - a few sprigs finely chopped

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Aromatic Vegetable Pulao recipe, wash and soak rice for at least 30 minutes. Drain the water and keep it aside. Heat oil in a sauce pan and add onions, whole spices and cook until the onion turns golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Meanwhile add 4 cups of water in a different saucepan and bring it to rolling boil. Add ginger garlic paste and tomatoes with the onions and whole spices. Let it cook until the tomatoes are soft and mushy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the tomatoes are soft, add all the remaining spices and veggies and cook for a minute. After a minute, add the hot water to the veggies. Add the soaked rice into the pan and cover it with a lid.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Let it cook till the rice is 3/4 cooked and the turn the flame to low heat. Cook it for few more minutes till the rice is almost done and it is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Aromatic Vegetable Pulao along with Burani Raita, Raw Mango Raita or any other raita of your choice.

ingredients.text: 500 grams Brinjal (Baingan / Eggplant) - small green seedless variety cut in long slices

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making Aubergine in Spicy Peanut Sauce, cut the aubergines in long strips and soak it in water in order to avoid oxidizing further. Heat a pan/Kadai in low flame, add oil, the sliced aubergine and sauté for a minute.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Keep stirring it in little intervals until done. In the meanwhile, make a fine paste of roasted peanuts, grated coconut, coriander leaves, green chillies, and ginger/galangal with a little water using a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add this paste to the cooked aubergines and add a cup of water, let it cook and thicken a bit. Adjust the water as per your required consistency. Season with salt, bring it to a boil and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with ginger juliennes and serve the flavourful Aubergine in Spicy Peanut Sauce with Chilli Coriander Fried Rice for a light lunch

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin with Godumai Dosai, mix the wheat flour, yogurt and 2 cups of water properly and make sure that no lumps are formed. Add salt and allow the batter to rest for 1-2 hours.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After 1-2 hours, add the finely chopped onions, chillies, cilantro and curry leaves. Mix the batter and adjust the water quantity until you have smooth flowing batter that is not too thin.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The batter should have a thickness so you can spread as well - similar to a dosa or a crepe batter. Heat a little oil in the cast iron pan and when it is hot, pour one ladle of batter in the centre.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Spread the batter in a circular motion just like regular dosa or pancake. Pour a little oil on the sides of the dosa. Cover the dosa with a lid and cook for a minute. Open, flip and cook the other side of the dosa as well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Remove the dosa and continue the same process for the rest of the batter. Cook the dosa in low flame for best texture and colour.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Godumai Dosai with South Indian Coconut Chutney, Red Chilli Coconut Chutney or any other chutney of your choice.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making Avarekalu Payasa Recipe, wash the field beans and add them in a pressure cooker with enough water. Pressure cook for one whistle and turn of the flame, allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once pressure releases, drain the beans from the water and keep aside. The field beans shouldn’t be cooked mushy. You can also de-skin it if needed; de skinning adds a smooth texture to the payasa.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixer-jar, add grated coconut, poppy seeds and cardamom in a mixer, add very little water and grind into thick paste. Keep aside. Place a heavy bottom pan on a low flame, add jaggery and a little water to dissolve jaggery.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once it is dissolved, filter the jaggery syrup to remove impurities. Add it back to the pan and now add the ground coconut paste and cooked avarekalu. On a low flame boil the payasa for 10 -12 minutes.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Keep stirring and mash the beans lightly if you want a smooth texture. Turn off the flame. Meanwhile, in a separate pan, add a tablespoon of ghee and fry the cashew nuts and raisins. Once the cashews are brown turn off the flame.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add this to the Payasa and mix well. The delicious avarekalu payasa is ready.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Avarekalu Payasa as a dessert after a Karnataka Style meal of Karnataka Style Majjige Huli Recipe, Steamed Rice and Akki Peni Sandige (Rice idiyappam Fryums)

ingredients.text: 250 gram Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal) - 250 grams toor dal

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: We begin making the Awadhi Style Sultani Dal Recipe by pressure cooking the dal with 2 cups water, add a little turmeric powder and salt , let it cook for 4 whistles, release the pressure naturally once it is done.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once done transfer it into a sauce pan and using a muddler, muddle the dal into a smooth coarse paste by adding a little water. Heat the saucepan and then add milk, cream and curd then start mixing it slowly till the dal thickens.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: In the mean time keep the tempering ready by heating a heavy bottomed pan with and add the cumin seeds, let it splutter for few seconds. Add the chopped ginger, garlic and onions, saute for few minutes till it is translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally,add in the green chilies and dry red chili powder and reduce the heat. Pour in the tempered spice on top of the dal and give it a stir.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Awadhi Style Sultani Dal Recipe along with Awadhi Style Bakarkhani for a yummy lunch meal.

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups Basmati rice - soaked for an hour
3 tablespoon Dry coconut (kopra) - sliced or chopped
2 Saffron strands - soaked in 2 tablespoon milk

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Awadhi Style Zarda Pulao Recipe, we will firstly cook the basmati rice in a pressure cooker. Heat some oil and then add the whole spices and let the aroma release. Later add rice with 3 cups water.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook the rice for 3 whistles and release the pressure naturally. Keep it aside. Heat a heavy bottomed pan with ghee, add all the nuts including almonds, raisins, cashew nuts with grated coconut.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Toss till it turns onto golden brown. Add the sugar, and keep sautéing till the sugar meltsOnce done, add the grated paneer, and transfer the cooked rice onto the pan. Sprinkle the orange zest and lemon juice and toss again.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a pinch of salt and the saffron soaked in milk and give it a final toss. Serve it hot. Serve the Awadhi Style Zarda Pulao Recipe for a wholesome Festive Lunch meal along with Dal Makhani, Paneer Butter Masala and Butter Naan.

ingredients.text: 200 grams Chicken breasts - cut into 1 inch cubes

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Ayam Goreng Kremes, in a mixer jar, combine cashew nuts, garlic and onion, grind to a smooth paste along with some water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai on medium flame, add the freshly ground masala, along with the tender coconut water, salt, kaffir lime leaves, lemon juice, and coriander seeds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To this add the chicken pieces and allow it to cook. this will take a good 12-15 minutes. Now turn off the flame, remove the chicken pieces from the coconut water mixture and set aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Transfer the coconut water mixture in which it was cooked into a bowl. Heat a pan, on medium flame, add oil and add garlic to saute.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Saute the garlic until golden brown, next add the crushed dry red chilies and immediately add the chicken. Flash cook on high heat for about two minutes and transfer to a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In the mixing bowl, that has the coconut water mixture, add 1 egg, salt and mix well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil on medium-high heat, drop spoonfuls of this coconut water batter into the oil and deep fry until it turns into a deep brown colour. Use up all the batter and drain the fried discs on absorbent paper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.detail: Crumble these fried discs with your fingers and place them in a mortar and pestle and pound them until evenly crumbed.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add these crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and toss well - this is the Ayam Goreng Kremes or the Indonesian Crunchy Fried Chicken. Transfer to a serving platter and serve the Indonesian Crunchy Fried Chicken along with lemon wedges.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Ayam Goreng Kremes/ Indonesian Crunchy Fried Chicken as an appetizer along with a meal of Sambal Telor with Nasi Uduk Recipe (Indonesian Style Eggs Cooked in Sambal and Lemongrass Coconut Rice) and a dessert of Lemon Frozen Yogurt Recipe.

name: Baale Dindu Kadale Palya - Banana Stem Curry With Chickpeas

ingredients.text: 1 Banana Stem - cleaned and chopped (about 250 grams after cleaning)
1 cup Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas) - soaked overnight
1 Green Chilli - one small green chilli

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To prepare Baale Dindu Kadale Palya (Banana Stem Curry With Chickpeas Recipe), cut the extra portion of the banana stem, trim its top and bottom lightly, and chop the stem finely.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Take a Pressure cooker, add soaked chickpeasAdd sufficient water and cook for 1-2 whistles. Allow to release pressure by itself. Add the chopped banana stem required salt and cook further for 1 more whistle.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The chickpeas should be firm and not mushy. Heat a Kadai and dry roast coriander seeds till fragrant. Set aside. In the same Kadai, and add a little oil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, splutter cumin, add in curry leaves and saute for a few seconds. Add chopped onions, garlic and saute till cooked.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a Mixer, dry grind coriander and add all the sauteed ingredients with grated coconut and wet grind till smooth, with adding water if necessary.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: After the pressure in the cooker with chickpeas and banana stem releases, add the ground paste in a kadai along with the contents of the pressure cooker. Add chilli powder and allow the Baale Dindu Kadale Palya to come to a boil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Adjust salt and switch off flame. Add lemon juice to the recipe and mix. Garnish with coriander leaves, chopped green chilli, and serve Baale Dindu Kadale Palya hot with rasam recipe.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Baby Potatoes Pulao Recipe, wash and soak the basmati rice in enough water until further cooking. Peel the skin of the baby potatoes and keep them immersed in a bowl of water to avoid discoloration.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a heavy bottomed pan, drain the potatoes from water, dry them using a kitchen towel and then fry in the ghee until they turn golden in colour. Drain them on a kitchen towel and keep aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In the same pan, add the whole garam masalas including star anise, bay leaf, cloves, green cardamoms, cinnamon stick and let them release its aroma into the ghee. Add the thinly sliced onions and saute until they turn brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for 2 minutes. Add in the tomatoes and slit green chillies and saute till the tomatoes turn mushy.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: Now whisk in the red chilli powder, coriander, and garam masala into a bowl of curd to a smooth texture and add it to the pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the fresh coriander and min leaves and cook this mixture until all the masalas are well combined and the oil separates out.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, drain and add the soaked basmati rice to the pan, fried baby potatoes, 2-1/2 cups of water, season with salt, lemon juice and let it simmer for 20 minutes with the lid closed until the rice and baby potatoes are cooked.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the rice and potatoes are cooked, switch off the heat, fork up the rice and mix gently.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Baby Potatoes Pulao Recipe along with Cucumber Green Chilli Raita, Kachumber Salad and a roasted Papad for the lunch box or for the weekend brunch at home.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Badam Nu Gosht Recipe - Parsi Style Mutton In Almond Gravy we will first make the masala for the gravy. To make the Badam gravy masalaSoak almonds in hot water for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Drain the excess water and transfer into the mixer-jar In a mixer jar, along with the almonds add, ginger, garlic, dry red chillies, cinnamon, black peppercorns, and cloves. Grind into a smooth paste with some water and set aside.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Wash and clean the mutton soak in hot water for about 10 minutes. This will help remove the impurities if any and help tenderise the meat.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: In a pressure cooker, add the washed and cleaned mutton, bay leaves, salt, 1/2 cup of water and pressure cook for 3 whistles. Turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a skillet on medium heat, add the ghee, once the ghee has melted, add the onions and cook until it starts turning into a light brown colour. To this add the freshly ground badam gravy masala and saute for about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Then add tomatoes, and salt to taste and continue to cook with the lid on for a few minutes or until the tomatoes turn mushy. This takes a good 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Open the pressure cooker and transfer the mutton along with the stock to the badam gravy masala. Increase the flame to medium-high, add milk and give the Badam Nu Gosht a brisk boil for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: This will help the mutton absorb the flavours. Once done, turn off the heat and check the salt and seasonings and adjust to taste accordingly. Once done, transfer the Badam Nu Gosht to a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Badam Nu Gosht along with Cheese Garlic Naan Recipe and Shehenshahi Parsi Keema Pulao Recipe for a Parsi style Weekend Lunch.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making Baingan Ki Lonje Recipe, wash and cut the eggplants into half lengthwise along with the stem and keep them immersed in a bowl of water to avoid the oxidation.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: In a shallow frying pan, dry roast the ingredients mentioned in the spice mix table and grind them into a fine powder using a mixer grinder and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a tablespoon of ghee in a pan, add the sliced onions and saute until it turns translucent. Add the sugar and let the onions caramelize to light brown colour. This will take around 10 minutes.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Now, grind this caramelized onions along with the grated ginger, salt and the spice mix to a fine paste using a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Drain the eggplants, apply a layer of this onion masala over the eggplants on the inner cut side and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Now, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee in the same pan, add the cloves, gently place the eggplants on the pan and let it cook on the skin side. This will take 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Gently, turn over the eggplants and let it cook over the other side as well. Once done, add the lemon juice, gently toss everything together and switch off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Baingan Ki Lonje Recipe (Uttar Pradesh Style Brinjal Sabzi) with steamed rice, Methi Jowar Roti Recipe and Awadhi Style Dal Masoor Musallam Recipe for a weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Banana and Apple Porridge for babies, we have to first cook the rice. Add 1/4 cup rice along with 1/2 cup water to a pressure cooker.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Pressure cook for 3 whistles, turn off the heat and release the pressure naturally. Meanwhile, mash the banana in a bowl and keep aside. Peel and core an apple and cut the apple into small pieces.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add 1/4 cup water into a saucepan. Add the cut apple pieces to the saucepan and boil the apple pieces in the water until it is well cooked. Once the apple pieces are cooked, remove from the saucepan and mash them.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In a bowl, add the cooked rice and mash it. Next add the mashed banana and apples into the mashed rice. Give it a good mix. Banana and Apple Porridge is ready to be served.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: You can add some water or milk if you baby prefers it to be thinner. Serve this delicious Banana and Apple Porridge as a meal to your baby/toddler during lunch or dinner for a wholesome meal.

ingredients.text: 300 grams Banana Stem - peeled and cut into dices

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Banana Stem Thoran Recipe, prepare all the ingredients and keep them aside. Add the banana stem into the pressure cooker, add 1/4 cup of water and salt and pressure cook for 2 whistles.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Release the pressure immediately, by placing the cooker under cold running water. It is important to release the pressure immediately, so the banana stem does not become soggy.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Into a blender, blend the coconut, curry leaves and green chillies into a coarse mixture. Stir this mixture into the cooked banana stem and keep aside. Heat oil in a tadka pan; add the mustard seeds and urad dal.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Allow it to crackle and the dal to turn crisp and golden brown. Once done, stir in the curry leaves and turn off the heat. Pour the tadka over the banana stem thoran and stir. Check the salt and adjust to suit your taste.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Banana Stem Thoran along with Nellikai Rasam (Whole Gooseberry Rasam) Recipe and Steamed Rice for lunch or even pack it into your lunch box along with Phulkas.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - finely chopped for garnish

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making Bardoli Ki Khichdi Recipe, wash and soak the rice and dal separately for 30 minutes. In a pressure cooker pan, heat a tablespoon of ghee, add in the cumin seeds and let it sizzle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the asafoetida, onion and saute until it turns translucent. Add the ginger, green chilies and saute for a minute. Add the grated raw mango and mix well.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Now to the pressure cooker add in the cubed potatoes, green peas, turmeric, red chilli powder, mix well and let it cook for 2 minutes. Drain the water from the soaked rice, tur dal and add it to the pressure cooker.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add 4 cups of water, season with salt, close it with a lid and cook the khichdi for 4 whistles.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Once the pressure has released naturally, open the pressure cooker lid, mix the khichdi well, add in the remaining 1/2 tablespoon ghee, garnish with coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Bardoli Ki Khichdi along with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita and Papad for a simple wholesome weekday lunch.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To make the Indian Radish and Beetroot Salad Recipe, grate the radishes, carrots and beetroots and keep it ready .Transfer these grated vegetables-radishes, carrots and beetroots into a mixing bowl, along with the peanuts, green chilies, lemon juice and salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Toss well and serve. Serve this Beetroot Gajar Mooli Salad Recipe along with Awadhi Style Dal Masoor Musallam Recipe and Phulka Recipe (Roti/Chapati) - Puffed Indian Bread for a simple weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Beetroot Carrot Tomato & Ginger Juice Recipe, prep all the ingredients and place them in the Juicer or a Mixer Grinder.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: If using a Juicer, add water to the pulp to extract until the last bit of the juicer and serve. If you are using a Mixer Grinder, blend adding water to make a smooth paste.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Strain, add water to adjust the consistency of the juice and serve. Give this delicious Beetroot Carrot Tomato & Ginger Juice Recipe a try and serve it along with Breakfast Oatmeal Raisin Muffin Recipe for your breakfast.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Beetroot Juice With Cucumber & Pineapple Recipe add beetroot, cucumber, pineapple and ginger to a food processor or blender and make a fine puree.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Pour the puree into a strainer and extract the juice completely. Add the pulp back to food processor or blender along with cold water and blend again. Strain this second juice once again and add to the first extract.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir both the extract together, add in the lemon juice and serve chilled. Check the taste and adjust the sweetness by adding honey or more pineapple. You can also optionally add salt if you like it salty.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve this Beetroot Juice With Cucumber & Pineapple along with Grilled Hummus Paneer Bhurji Sandwich Recipe for a healthy wholesome breakfast.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Beetroot Tambuli recipe, heat oil in a wide pan and add cumin seeds and peppercorns. Once it splutters, add chopped ginger and green chillies and roast it until you see the change in colour.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the fresh coconut and roast until you see the rawness disappear. It will take about 1-2 minutes. Add these into a small blender and blend it without adding any water.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To the same pan, add some more oil and toss the grated beetroot with some salt. Saute until it becomes soft and tender. Allow it to cool.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once it is done, add the beetroot to the coconut mixture and blend it to a coarse textured paste in a blender. In a bowl add the yogurt, beetroot mixture and required salt and mix well. The next step is to make the tempering.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a tadka pan and add mustard, hing, curry leaves and red chillies. Spoon the tempering on the Beetroot Tambuli and it is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Beetroot Tambuli with Mixed Vegetable sambar and steamed rice for a delicious meal.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Bengali Doi Maach recipe, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Add garlic, ginger and onion and saute it for a minute. Let it cool down and then make a paste of this using a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: Marinate fish with raisin, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt and 1 tablespoon oil for 15 to 30 minutes in a mixing bowl. Mix everything properly. Add 1 tablespoon oil to the same pan that is used for frying onion and heat it.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add cumin seeds and let it sputter. Add cinnamon, clove, green cardamom and saute for a few seconds. Reduce the flame to very slow. Add the marinated fish with curd to the pan. Cook for about 10 minute at medium flame.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After 10 minutes, add green chillies, 1/2 teaspoon sugar and mix. Cook for another 4 to 5 minutes at slow flame. After 4 to 5 minutes, switch off the stove and it is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Bengali Doi Maach along with Chingiri Paturi and hot steamed rice for a perfect Bengali weekday lunch or dinner.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons Kalonji (Onion Nigella Seeds) - or nigella seeds
Ghee - or oil for cooking the paranthas

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Bengali Posto Porota Recipe, grind the poppy seeds and green chilies together adding very little water to make a smooth paste.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a large mixing bowl, add the poppy seeds mixture, flour, onions, sesame seeds, coriander leaves, salt and sugar. Add little water at a time and knead to make as smooth dough. Divide the dough into ten equal parts.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Dust each portion of the Posto Porota dough in flour and roll into a flat circle. Sprinkle a little nigella seeds on the top of the rolled out dough and press slightly so they don't fall out while cooking the Porota.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: The next step is cook the Posto Porota. Preheat and grease a skillet on medium heat. Place the porota on the skillet and allow it to cook for a couple of minutes before you add the ghee.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: After a couple of minutes, drizzle some ghee around the paratha and cook on both sides until browned and lightly crisp. Once done, remove from heat and continue the same process with the remaining parathas.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Bengali Posto Porota along with a your favorite Pickle, a bowl of yogurt for breakfast or a quick weeknight dinner along with your favorite vegetable.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making Bengali Style Basanti Pulao Recipe, smear the gobindobhog rice with turmeric and keep aside for 20 minutes for the rice to absorb the gorgeous yellow.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a tablespoon each of ghee and vegetable oil in deep fry pan. On low heat, fry the cashewnuts and raisins till they turn golden brown, keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In the same oil, on low medium heat, add the bay leaves, crushed cinnamon, green cardamom, cloves, saute till the spices start to release their aroma.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ginger paste and saute for a minute or two; just about till the raw smell of ginger vanishes. Now add the rice and give a gentle stir, taking care not to break the grains. Saute gently for 3-5 minutes over a medium flame.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add 4 cups of warm water (golden rule - rice and water should always be in a 1:2 ratio), add sugar and salt to taste. Throw in the fried cashew nuts and raisins.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover and cook till almost all the water has been absorbed, by time the rice should be almost done. Switch off the flame, add the remaining ghee, cover and allow to rest for a further 10-12 minutes. The Basanti Pulao is ready.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Bengali Style Basanti Pulao Recipe along with Lauki Raita Recipe and Kumro Patai Ilish Paturi Recipe. To end the meal on a sweet note serve it with Rasgulla Recipe.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Cholar Dal recipe, wash dal under running water nicely till clear water appear. In a pressure cooker, add dal with salt, turmeric, bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon and water till the dal is immersed.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Pressure cook for 2 to 3 whistles as we don't want the dal to get mashed completely. Once the dal is cooked, keep aside and prepare the tempering.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a wok/kadhai and add cumin seeds and asafoetida, wait till cumin crackles. Now add green chilies, ginger paste, raisins and saute for a while. Add in the cooked dal and grated coconut and stir well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Check salt again and adjust if required, cover the lid and cook for 10 to 12 minutes in low flame. Once the dal is done, add a generous pinch of sugar along with some coconut slices before turning off the gas.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve hot and delicious Cholar Dal with fluffy Bengali Luchi for a perfect Bengali meal.

name: Bengali Style Mixed Vegetable Sweet Pilaf

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making Bengali Style Mixed Vegetable Sweet Pilaf Recipe, wash the rice and drain water. Keep aside. Blanch the vegetables and peas in hot water. Heat oil in a handi. Lightly shallow fry the cubed paneer. Keep them aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In the same kadai, add bay leaf, dry whole masalas and onions. Fry till onions become translucent. Add in the blanched vegetables. Stir for a few minutes. Once the veggies are a bit tender till al dente, add cashews and raisins.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add the soaked rice. Sauté till the rice grains become a little long and white in colour. It will take around 3-4 minutes. Now add water a little more just to cover the rice. Add sugar and green chilli. Adjust salt.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover and cook till the rice is done. Remove the cover and drizzle ghee. Mix very well. Now add the fried paneer pieces. Remove from heat. Mix, cover and let it rest for 2-3 minutes and serve.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Try this Bengali Style Mixed Vegetable Sweet Pilaf Recipe during this festive season, along with Bengali Style Pomfret Shorshe Recipe and Bengali Special Chocolate Sandesh Recipe.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Fresh coconut - cut into small bits
2 Green Chillies - slit into halves lengthwise

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making Bengali Cholar Dal, first wash and soak chana dal in water for an hour or so.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook soaked dal with 2-1/2 Cups of water , turmeric powder, salt to taste and cook dal for 8 whistles / 30 minutes until the dal is cooked completely. See how to cook lentils (dals/pulses).

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Let the pressure release naturally and keep aside. In a pan heat mustard oil over medium heat, add the coconut pieces and fry until they turn golden brown. Turn off the heat. Transfer the fried coconut pieces in a bowl.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Keep aside until required. In the same pan heat a tablespoon of mustard seeds and add cumin seeds, once seeds crackle add dry red chilies, cloves, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, green chilies and grated ginger.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Saute for a few second and add the cooked dal and roasted copra into the pan. Briskly boil Bengali Style Cholar Dal for three to four minutes and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Transfer the Bengali Style Cholar Dal into a serving bowl; finally garnish with a few more of the roasted coconut pieces and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Bengali Cholar Dal with Begun Bhaja and steamed rice for a wholesome weekend lunch or dinner.

name: Bhaji Miligai And Baby Potato Fry

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons Gram flour (besan) - optional Salt to taste

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: To begin making the Bhaji Miligai And Baby Potato Fry Recipe, pressure cook baby potatoes for 1 or 2 whistles, until cooked al dente. Prep up with all the ingredients meanwhile and cut miligai to big chunks.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the pressure of the cooker releases, peel off all the potatoes. In a shallow frying pan, heat oil and fry chopped garlic. Add bhajji milagai and let it fry for just about a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add small potatoes and saute after adding curry leaves, salt, and turmeric evenly. You may optionally add besan and rice flour at this stage, if you want to make Bhaji Miligai And Baby Potato Fry Recipe as a crunchy appetizer.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix everything well and saute lightly until crispy and switch off. Serve Bhaji Miligai And Baby Potato Fry Recipe as a side dish along with Tomato Onion Sambar, Steamed Rice and Elai Vadam for an everyday meal.

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon Black pepper powder - freshly crushed

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Bhopali Style Gosht Ka Pulao recipe, wash and rinse rice well. Soak in clear water and set aside for minimum one hour before cooking.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In a large thick bottomed vessel, heat oil and add bay leaf, black cardamom, cardamom pods, mace powder, whole black pepper corns and cinnamom stick. Let it cook for about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After 30 seconds, add chopped ginger, garlic and saute for a while. Add chopped onions and saute till translucent and raw smell disappears. Meanwhile add green chilies as well. Let t cook for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next, add the mutton pieces and mix well on high flames. Let it be on high till the moisture evaporates well. Cook it for about 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add sour curd and crushed mint and mix nicely such that everything gets incorporated well. As soon as you find curd leaving water from sides, turn the flames to low.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Close the lid and allow it to cook till mutton gets almost 80% tender. Once the mutton is semi cooked, add red chili powder, coriander powder, black pepper powder and some more dry mint. Mix well.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry everything till oil starts leaving from sides. You may adjust oil if required. Add soaked rice, and fry again for couple of minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add water till the surface of the rice or double the quantity of rice. (Ex - If you take 10 cups rice then add 20 cups of water)Adjust salt as needed and stir well. Keep the flames high till you get a boil.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.detail: Simmer the flames and let the rice cook with lid partially closed. Once the rice is cooked, turn off the gas and add ghee all over. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Bhopali Style Gosht Ka Pulao along with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita, Tadka Raita or any other Raita of your choice.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Bihari Style Baingan Ka Chokha Recipe, we will first get all the ingredients prepped up as mentioned in the ingredient list. The next step is to roast the eggplant (baingan) over a gas flame.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: You can also roast it in the oven. To roast the baingai using the oven, preheat the oven to 180 C.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Place the brinjal on a baking sheet and place in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes or until the brinjal has started to soften and the outer skin is charred.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: When you prick inside with a knife, you can feel that the brinjal has become tender, if not continue to roast until done.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To roast the baingai over the gas flame, place the brinjal on the stove top flame, with continuous monitoring, using tongs to turn the brinjal around while it is roasting.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: After about 10 minutes you will notice that the brinjal’s skin begins to char and the inside begins to get tender. To test, when you insert a knife you will feel it is soft and not hard. If hard continue to roast until done.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once brinjal is roasted allow the brinjal to cool down. Peel the charred skin of the cooled brinjal and discard the skin. Coarsely mash the pulp using a fork or mince finely using a knife. Heat mustard oil in a heavy bottomed pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add asafoetida and stir for a few seconds. Add the onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies and cook for 2-3 minutes until the onions soften. Add the tomatoes, and cook them until they turn soft.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally add the mashed roasted baingan, salt and cook for another 4 minutes until all the flavors are incorporated. Check the taste and adjust accordingly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Once done, transfer to a serving bowl and serveServe the Bihari Style Baingan Ka Chokha along with Litti or Phulka & Kadhi for lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Biryani Chammanthi Recipe, keep all the ingredients ready and add them into a grinder and grind it into a smooth paste. Once done add lemon juice and salt and mix well and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Biryani Chammanthi Recipe (Green Chutney Recipe) along with Peppery Mushroom Biryani Recipe or Awadhi Style Chickpea Kofta Biryani Recipe.

ingredients.text: 1-1/2 cup White Urad Dal (Whole) - soaked overnight

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making Biuli Dal Er Boda Recipe - Bengali Style Urad Dal Vada, grind soaked dal with no water or very little water. The batter should not be too smooth and fine.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once done transfer the Urad dal batter into a bowl and to it add the chopped onions green chillies and suji along with salt. The suji makes the outer coat crunchy. Mix well to combine.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Preheat a paniyaram pan on medium heat and add some oil in each off its cavity. Drop a spoonful of batter in each cavity. Cook till the top of the Biuli Dal Er Boda Recipe is steamed.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Turn carefully with a spoon or spatula after 2 minutes or when one side is golden brown. Wait for 2-3 more minutes till the other side browns and cooks. once done transfer them on a serving plate and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Biuli Dal Er Boda Recipe - Bengali Style Urad Dal Vada with Green Chutney and Masala Chai Recipe for an evening snack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Black Eyed Beans (Lobia) - soaked for at least 4 hours

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Black Eyed Peas Masala Vadas recipe, strain the water from the lobhia using a colander and pat dry to remove as much moisture as possible.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixer jar add green chillies, ginger, salt, asafoetida and 2 tablespoons of the lobhia and grind and add this into a mixing bowl. Now add the remaining Lobhia into the mixer jar and grind coarsely, add to the mixing bowl.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Squeeze out extra moisture from the crushed corn and add it into the mixing bowl. Add all the remaining ingredients into the mixing bowl. Combine everything and taste to adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Shape the mixture into vadas and deep fry until golden in a deep fry pan. Make sure to cook on a medium to high flame so that its cooked through.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: If the vada mixture is very moist it could absorb lots of oil, the trick is to pat the vadas on a clean dry towel so it absorbs excess moisture.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Then transfer them to your hands and drop them gently into the oil to fry, this way you will get crispy non greasy vadas.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Black Eyed Peas Masala Vadas with South Indian Coconut Chutney or Tomato Garlic Chutney on a rainy day.

ingredients.text: 1 cup White Urad Dal (Split) - soaked for 2 hours
Sunflower Oil - as required for frying the bonda

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Bonda Mor Kuzhambu Recipe, we start with making the bonda. Wash and soak the urad dal for 2 hours, and then grind it along with ginger and green chilli to a smooth paste using a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Whisk
