steps.detail: Take out this batter in a bowl, season with salt and whisk it vigorously to attain a light texture. In the mean also soak the coriander seeds, toor dal and a died red chilli in water and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat enough oil in a frying pan on medium heat, and once the oil is hot enough, drop a spoon full of small balls of the bond batter into the oil and fry till golden brown as you would make the medu vada's.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Remove, drain it on the kitchen absorbent paper and keep it aside. Likewise, prepare the bonda's with the remaining batter.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Now, to make the mor kuzhambu take the soaked coriander seeds, toor dal and red chilli in a mixie jar and grind it to a smooth paste along with ginger and grated coconut.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: Take a bowl, whisk the curd to smooth texture, add the ground coconut mix to it, season with salt and whisk it together. Heat oil in a pan on medium heat, add mustard seeds, chana dal and let it crackle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the asafoetida, a dried red chilli and curry leaves and let it splutter. Add the sour curd and coconut mix to this, 2 to 3 cups of water and bring it to a boil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: If the mor kuzhambu is too thick, add more water, adjust the seasoning and simmer for around 10 minutes. Once the Mor Kuzhambu is well cooked, add the prepared bonda's to it, bring it to a gentle boil and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Bonda Mor Kuzhambu Recipe along with Steamed Rice and Crispy Potato Fry for a delicious weeknight dinner or for the weekend brunch.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Brahmi Chutney Recipe, clean and wash brahmi leaves. Heat a kadai with coconut oil, add urad dal, chana dal, red chillies, curry leaves and hing.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry them in oil till the urad dal and chana dal turns golden brown in color. Allow them to cool to room temperature. Transfer roasted and cooled masala to a blender / mixer. Add in salt , tamarind, coconut and brahmi leaves.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind to a smooth consistency by adding little water.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Brahmi Chutney Recipe is a simple nutrient dense dish that can be relished with rice, Homemade Crisp Ghee Roast Dosas, Carrot & Cheese Filled Idli Recipe, Jolada Roti Recipe (Jowar Bhakri) etc.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Bread, Paneer & Potato Instant Vada Recipe, crumble down the bread slices to small bits.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl, add rice flour, rava (sooji), curd, cumin seeds, onion, ginger, paneer, mashed potato, coriander leaves and salt, along with crumbled bread. Keep aside. In a wok, heat enough oil to deep fry the vadas.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: While the cooking oil is heating up, mix all the ingredients in the mixing bowl. With the help of water as required, knead well form a soft dough. The dough should not be runny, but not too stiff as well. It should be pliable.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Pinch out a small ball and gently press to flatten and then make a hole in the centre with your fore finger, as you prepare dough for medu vada. By this time, the oil would be hot enough.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Check the temperature by dropping a small bit of the prepared dough. If the dough raises immediately, the oil is hot enough to fry. Turn the heat to medium low through out frying process.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Drop the prepared Bread, Paneer & Potato Instant Vada thick batter into the hot oil. Drop a couple of more vadas if your deep fry pan can fit. But do not over crowd the kadai also, or it might lead to vadas being less crispy.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Flip the bread vada on both sides and fry till the vada is evenly golden browned. Take them out on an absorbent paper towel to get rid of excess oil.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: You can delicately pat them to drain more oil absorbed.*Paniyaram Method:To make this Bread, Paneer & Potato Instant Vada Recipe in paniyaram pan, heat the paniyaram pan, brush oil on the cavities, add the batter into the cavities.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.detail: Drizzle a few drops of oil into each cavity. Once the vadas are brown on the bottom, with the help of a spatula or spoon, you can flip the vada to the other side and drizzle a few drops of oil into each cavity. Take the Bread Instant Vadas once they are evenly browned.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Bread, Paneer & Potato Instant Vada Recipe with Foxtail Millet Rava Idli Recipe, Arachuvitta Sambar Recipe (Traditional South Indian Sambar with Fresh Spices) and Pudalangai Thogayal Recipe (Snake Gourd Chutney Recipe).

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoon Fresh coconut - pieces (adjust quantity according to taste)

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Brinjal Mor Kuzhambu Recipe, soak the the dals - chana dal, toor and rice in lukewarm water and rest it for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Once done grind the dals and rice with little water to a smooth paste and add coconut and curd and grind it again in the same mixer to a smooth paste and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil, add chopped brinjal, sprinkle with salt and turmeric and cook till it becomes soft. Pour in the tamarind water and allow it to cook for at least 15 minutes until the brinjal becomes quite mushy.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix in the curd and the freshly ground dal-rice paste into the kadai and stir well, sprinkle salt and pour in some more water to adjust the consistency.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Allow it to boil for at least 10 minutes until the raw smell of the rice and dal goes away. Switch off the heat and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a tempering pan with oil, add mustard seeds , urad dal and fenugreek seeds and allow it to sizzle. Add curry leaves and dry red chillies and allow it to crackle for few seconds.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Sprinkle a pinch of hing at the end and pour this over the mor kuzhambu and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Brinjal Mor Kuzhambu Recipe along with steamed rice, Beetroot Poriyal Recipe or a Chow Chow Thoran (Poriyal) Recipe to make it a complete meal.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Broccoli - cut into small florets

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Broccoli Capsicum Pulao Recipe, we will first cook the rice. If you already have the rice cooked, then you can skip this step.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: In a heavy bottom pan, cook the rice along with 2 cups of water, some salt and 1 teaspoon of ghee. Cook until all the water in absorbed and the rice is cooked and separated. Keep it a covered side and allow it to cool.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In a heavy bottomed pan, heat the remaining ghee over medium heat.. Add in the onions, chili's, garlic and bell peppers and sauté them well until softened. Keep the pan covered so that the bell peppers get softened and cooked.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once done, add in the broccoli and sauté them together with the onion mixture until lightly softened. Finally, add the cooked rice, black pepper powder, salt to taste and coriander leaves.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir all the ingredients together until well combined. Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste. Turn off the heat and serve the Broccoli Capsicum Pulao Recipe warm for a delicious weeknight dinner.

name: Broken Wheat And Green Moong Khichdi

ingredients.text: 1 cup Broken Wheat (Dalia/ Godumai Rava) - lightly roasted
1/2 cup Green Moong Dal (Whole) - lightly roasted and soaked in water for 30 minutes
1/4 cup Green beans (French Beans) - finely chopped
Mint Leaves (Pudina) - a few sprigs chopped

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Broken Wheat And Green Moong Khichdi, first crush together the garlic cloves, cumin seeds and green chilies in a small mortar and pestle. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil or ghee in a pressure cooker and add mustards seeds. Once they crackle, add the crushed garlic-cumin-chillies paste and the curry leaves. Fry for a few seconds and then add the onion.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Saute for a minute and then add turmeric powder, asafoetida and ginger. Mix it properly and add all the vegetables. Saute for another minute and then add the dalia and green moong.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add enough water (depending on the consistency required) and mix well. About 3 cups for a porridge like consistency. Sprinkle some salt and cook it till the cooker releases 2 whistles or till well cooked.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Wait for the pressure to come down on its own. Garnish the khichdi with chopped mint and coriander, lime juice (if using) and serve immediately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Broken Wheat And Green Moong Khichdi with Mooli raita or Gujarati Kadhi and papad.

name: Broken Wheat and Mixed Millet Upma

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin with Broken Wheat and Mixed Millet Upma, mix broken wheat and millet and wash it. Strain the water and keep it aside. Heat ghee in a cooker, add cumin seeds and allow it to crackle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add grated ginger, chopped green chilies and onion and saute. Add peas and carrots to it and fry well for few minutes. You can add more vegetables like capsicum, cauliflower, corn, mushroom etc.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Quantity of vegetables depend on one's personal requirement. Add the washed broken wheat mix to the fried veggies and stir fry everything together till they turn golden in colour and you get the roasted aroma out of it.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Pour one cup of water or as much as required to cover the surface of the fried mix. Add salt according to your taste and pressure cook till the cooker releases 2-3 whistles.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Turn off the gas and allow the steam to settle completely. Open the lid and mix everything well with a spatula. Squeeze lemon juice over and garnish it with finely chopped coriander.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Broken Wheat and Mixed Millet Upma with a hot cup of masala chai or a smoothie of your choice.

name: Buckwheat Crepes Stuffed With Spinach And Eggs

ingredients.text: Water - as required to make a thin batter
1 tablespoon Butter - or ghee to coat the pan (optional or you can use an oil spray)

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Buckwheat Crepes Stuffed With Spinach And Eggs, first make the crepe batter. For this, whisk together the eggs and milk (under “For the buckwheat crepes”) in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add to it, the melted ghee (or butter) and grated nutmeg, stir in the buckwheat flour, salt and mix gently, but thoroughly, till there are no lumps. Set the mixture aside for 15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To make the filling place a pan or wok on the heat, and add some oil to it. When it is warm, add the onion, ginger-garlic paste and green chilies and saute together for 1-2 minutes till the onion is translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped spinach leaves next and toss. Sprinkle salt and cook for 1-2 minutes till the leaves wilt. Next, pour in the whisked eggs and stir vigorously to scramble the eggs.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook for 1-2 minutes till the eggs are still soft and moist, but cooked through. Sprinkle the coriander leaves (or any other herb of choice) and turn the heat off. Set the filling aside while you proceed to make the crepes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To make the buckwheat crepes place a large flat non-stick/griddle/crepe pan on the heat. Smear some ghee or butter evenly over it.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Pour a ladle full of the batter on the pan and immediately tilt the pan in a circular fashion to spread the batter evenly into a thin pancake. Cook until the bottom is lightly browned, usually about 30-40 seconds.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Flip the crepe to cook on the other side for a few seconds. When full cooked, lay the crepe on a serving dish using a flat spatula. Spoon over the filling on half the crepe or a quarter of the crepe. Fold over the other side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Buckwheat Crepes Stuffed With Spinach And Eggs along with Chickoo Banana Date Smoothie for breakfast.

ingredients.text: 2 cups Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - finely shredded

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Cabbage Palya recipe, cook shredded cabbage in boiling water for 5 to 7 minutes or until it is slightly transparent and drain excess water using a colander.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat mustard oil in a wide pan, add mustard seeds and let it crackle. Once it crackles, add hing, curry leaves, green chillies and garlic. Saute it until the garlic changes its colour slightly.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the onions and a tiny bit of salt and let it cook until it turns slightly golden. At this stage add the cabbage and add the required salt and mix well and cook until you see it drying. This shouldn't take too long.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add the chopped tomato, grated coconut and coriander. Mix well and cook covered until the tomato becomes soft. Dish it out into bowl and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Cabbage Palya is best served with steamed rice and mixed vegetable sambar, or as a tiffin box dish with chapattis.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: To begin making the Tamil Nadu Style Muttaikose Pattani Poriyal Recipe (Cabbage and Peas Stir fry Recipe), firstly we will chop the cabbage and keep it ready.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil on a saucepan, add mustard seeds and leave it to splutter, immediately add hing and urad dal. Fry for 10 seconds. Add the dry red chillies, curry leaves and fry them for 10 more seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped cabbage and saute well. Add salt to speed up the cooking process. After a minute, add the green peas, coconut and saute for another 2 more minutes. Check for salt and switch off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Muttaikose Pattani Poriyal can be served along with Smoked Dal Makhani Dhaba Style Recipe, Phulka and Steamed Rice to make a comforting meal.

ingredients.text: 500 grams Boneless chicken - cut into pieces of uniform size

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: To start preparing this delicious Calcutta Style Chicken Biryani Recipe, marinate the chicken pieces with curd, red chilli powder, turmeric and salt for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Partially cook the rice along with black cardamom and bay leaves. The rice needs to be boiled till 50% done. Drain away the water and set aside the rice for later use.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Dry roast the rest of the whole spices namely, peppercorns, cloves, green cardamom and cinnamon for 30 seconds or till fragrant. Let it cool and then grind it into a fine powder in a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee in a deep & heavy bottomed pan. Add chopped onions and sauté till soft and lightly browned. Mash the ginger, garlic, and green chillies together using a mortar & pestle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ginger-garlic-chilli paste to the onions once they are lightly browned. Sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder and sauté further for a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the marinated chicken to the above, and mix well till the chicken is well-covered with spices. Cover and cook for 10-12 minutes on low flame. Add a little water if required.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: While the chicken is cooking, chop the potatoes into four pieces and fry them till crisp and cooked. Now take a heavy bottomed non-stick Biryani pot or earthen pot and grease it with ghee.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Spread one layer of rice and top it with a layer of chicken gravy and 2 potatoes. Repeat this three times ending with a layer of rice. Heat the rest of the ghee and pour it on the top layer.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Seal the mouth of the pot with wheat flour dough to tighten the lid if using earthen pot and place a heavy weight like mortar on top of it. Cook this on low heat for 10 to 15 minutes and let it stand for another 30 minutes before opening.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Calcutta Style Chicken Biryani Recipe hot with Burani raita or Tomato Onion & Cucumber raita and non-veg gravy like Laal Maas or Creamy Butter Chicken.

ingredients.text: 2-3 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - chopped into medium size pieces

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Capsicum Bath recipe, firstly wash rice and cook it with water and salt in a saucepan. The cooked rice grains should be separate and not mushy. Once cooked, spread the cooked rice on a wide plate.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: This will make the grains separate further and also helps to cool down quickly. (It has to be cooled properly before using)Heat oil in a kadhai and add mustard seeds, lentils and cashew nuts.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once they splutter add curry leaves, red chili and green chili .Add onion, green peas, turmeric and salt. Saute it till the raw smell of onion goes away. Once it is done, add chopped capsicum and cook it for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the capsicum is cooked half, add vangibath powder, tamarind juice and mix everything well. Cover and cook for 3-4 minutes, so that capsicum takes in the flavour. Finally, add the grated coconut and give a gentle mix.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Switch off after the extra moisture has evaporated. Now add rice to the pan and mix everything properly. Drizzle some lemon juice, salt and mix it well again.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Capsicum Bath with Lauki Raita, Beetroot Raita, Burani Raita or any other Raita of your choice.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Yellow Moong Dal (Split) - soaked for an hour

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making Capsicum Usili Recipe (Tamil Nadu Style Capsicum cooked with lentils spice mix), wash and soak the split moong dal for an hour.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Drain the water and grind it along with red chillies, fennel seeds and little salt to a coarse mix using a mixer grinder, and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a Pan/Kadai on a medium heat, add the mustard seeds and urad dal and let it splutter. Add the asafoetida and curry leaf. Now, add the capsicum, season with salt and stir it well. Let the capsicum cook for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Take this capsicum out in a bowl and keep aside. In the same pan add 2 tablespoons of oil and the coarsely ground moong dal mix. Cook until the moong dal mix is cooked well, stirring in between. This will take 6-7 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add the sautéed capsicum to this moong dal mixture and give it a good stir. Simmer for another 5 minutes until the capsicum and the moong dal mixture is well combined.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Switch off the flame and serve the Capsicum Usili Recipe along with Steamed Rice and Tomato Rasam or Thakkali Vengaya Kuzhambu recipe for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 Green Chilli - slit in the middle

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Carrot And Coriander Soup recipe, Iin a large pressure pan or cooker, heat ghee or butter and add chopped onions and garlic along with slit green chillies. Fry until the onions are translucent; about 1 minute.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir in chopped carrots, coriander and cloves and sauté again for another minute on high. Add water to immerse the vegetables and pressure cook for one whistle.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: If you do not have a pressure cooker, cook in a deep saucepan until the carrots are cooked and turn soft. Once the pressure in the cooker goes down, drain the vegetables and pour the stock into an another saucepan.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Remove green chilli and cloves from the drained vegetables and blend the rest to a fine puree. Pour the puree into the stock and mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Once it comes to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes. Garnish with finely chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with a squeeze of lemon or lime.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Carrot And Coriander Soup with Garlic Bread and Moong Sprouts Salad With Grated Carrots and Coriander for a healthy and light dinner.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To make the Carrot Capsicum Poreal Recipe, first of all pour the carrot, salt and 2 tablespoons water in a pressure cooker. Turn off the cooker and cook till 2 cities come. Take out the pressure and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Now heat oil in a pan. Add the mustard seeds, cumin seeds, urad dal and cook till the lentils turn brown. After the lentils turn brown, add curry leaves, asafoetida, green chillies and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add capsicum, salt and cook until the capsicum becomes soft. Take care not to burn capsicum. Now add coconut, mix it and turn off the gas. Remove and serve in a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Carrot Capsicum Poriyal Recipe with Chow Chow Sambar, Tomato Rasam and Rice for the day's dinner.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Carrot Pachadi with Coconut Recipe, take a big bowl, add the curd and whisk it to a thick consistency with silky smooth texture and keep aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a hand mixer jar, add the grated coconut, coriander and green chilli and make a course mix of it. In the same jar add the roughly chopped carrots and pulse it to a course mix.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add this course carrot coconut mix to the bowl of curd, season with salt and mix well. Now, heat oil in a tadka pan on medium flame, add the mustard seeds and split urad dal and let it crackle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the asafoetida, curry leaves, red chilli and let it splutter. Add this tadka to the bowl of carrot pachadi and mix well.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Carrot Pachadi along with Vegetable Biryani or Paneer Biryani for your weekend brunch along with Kachumber salad.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - cut into small cubes

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Carrot Paruppu Usili Recipe, wash and soak toor dal for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes drain the water from dal.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Combine the soaked toor dal along with fennel seeds, dried red chillies, and salt in a mixer jar and grind to a coarse mix using a mixer grinder. Transfer to a bowl. Heat an idli steamer on medium heat, with a cup of water.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Grease the idli mould and keep it ready. Now make small lemon sized balls of the prepared toor dal mix, and place it in the idli mould.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Cover and steam cook for 10 minutes, until the dal mixture is cooked. (Don't make the ball of dals too tight as the lentils will not steam very well)In a wide pan, add oil and heat it on medium heat, add the mustard seeds, asafoetida and let it splutter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the dried red chilli, curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the cubed carrots, season with salt, mix well, cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until the carrots are cooked well.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Meanwhile, remove the steamed toor dal balls, crumble it with your hands so that it resembles the sandy texture. Once the carrots are cooked well, add this crumbled toor dal mix to the pan and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: At this stage you can add a teaspoon or two of oil, if the mixture looks too dry. Saute for 2 minutes, until the dal crumbles are nice and crispy and switch off the heat. It is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Carrot Paruppu Usili Recipe along with Steamed Rice, Jeera Milagu Rasam, Chow Chow Poricha Kootu and Roasted Papad for a weekend lunch.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: To begin making the Carrot Tadka Raita Recipe, in a mixing bowl, combine yogurt, black salt, cumin powder, salt to taste and whisk well until smooth.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once done add coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chillies and grated carrots to the whisked curd. Mix well to combine and keep it aside.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: To make the tadka, heat oil in a pan on medium heat, add the cumin seeds, asafoetida and chopped garlic, and saute until the garlic is golden brown in colour. Turn off the heat once done.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Pour the tadka over the carrot raita and serve chilled. Serve Carrot Tadka Raita along with Stuffed Mooli Paratha Recipe or Baby Corn and Tomato Mixed Rice.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Sweet Potatoes - boiled and mashed

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the sweet potato parathas, we will first make the dough. Add flour and salt in a large bowl, adding little water at a time to make soft, pliable dough. Knead dough until it is smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add oil to coat the dough and knead little more. The dough will be soft and nonsticky. Allow the dough to rest for about 15 minutes, covered. Knead dough until it is smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add oil to coat the dough and knead little more. The dough will be soft and nonsticky. Allow the dough to rest for about 15 minutes, covered.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Divide the dough into lemon sized balls and roll them out thin to approximately 3 inches in diameter. Note tossing the dough in dry flour while rolling will prevent it from getting sticky when rolling them out.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In another bowl, combine all the ingredients for the filling together. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste. Add 1 tablespoon of the stuffing in the center. Gather the sides and bring them together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Remove the little excess dough which popped out when you brought them together. Press the stuffed dough down. Toss it in some flour and roll it gently applying just even pressure to roll.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.detail: Roll it to desired thickness and your comfort level in rolling. Place the stuffed sweet potato carrot parathas on the hot griddle/skillet.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook on medium heat adding a little oil or ghee to cook the parathas until you notice it gets brown spots on both the sides and has lightly crisp outer crust.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Carrots & Sweet Potato Stuffed Paratha Recipe along with Boondi Raita Recipe Spiced With Black Salt, Instant Gor Kairi Lonche Recipe - Sweet Raw Mango Pickle and Apple, Kiwi, Pineapple Juice Recipe for a complete breakfast.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making Carrots and Coriander Fritters Recipe, grate the carrots and keep them aside in a bowl. To this add the chopped coriander leaves, green chilli, chickpea flour, season with salt and mix well.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: The carrots will eventually release water which will help in binding all the mixture together. The batter will be little thicker than the usual pancake batter. Now, heat the skillet on medium flame, brush it with oil.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Pour a ladle full of the batter and carefully spread it out to form small disc. Pour oil over the sides and let it cook for 2 minutes. Once the bottom is cooked, flip over and cook the other side for another 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Remove it on a plate and proceed with making the next fritter with the remaining batter. Serve the Carrots and Coriander Fritters Recipe along with Milk for kids evening snacks or include it into their lunch boxes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: You can also serve it with Dhaniya Pudina Chutney for your tea time snack.

ingredients.text: 4 Raw Banana - par boiled and grated thick

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making Vazhakkai Podimas Recipe, pressure cook the plantains along with the skin with 1/2 cup water using a pressure cooker for 2 whistles. Once the plantains are cooked, peel its skin, grate is and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a pan on medium flame, add the mustard seeds, urad dal and let it crackle. Add the curry leaves and let it splutter. Add the onions, green chillies and ginger and saute until the onions turns translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the grated plantains, season with salt and saute over medium heat for 5 minutes. Once its done, add the grated coconut, give it a good stir and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Vazhakkai Podimas Recipe along with Steamed Rice and Mixed Vegetable Sambar Recipe for the weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 Cauliflower (gobi) - roughly chopped into smaller pieces

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Cauliflower Kurma recipe, soak the ingredients given under 'masala paste' in 1/4 cup of warm water for 20 minutes and then grind them to a fine paste using little water in a grinder.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil. Add the chopped cauliflower and cook them for 5 minutes and switch off the stove. Drain the water and set aside the cauliflower. Heat a wide pan or wok over low flame with coconut oil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add all the ingredients mentioned under ‘for tempering’.Now add the grated ginger, garlic, chopped shallots, tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Keep stirring till the onions turn transparent and the tomatoes mushy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add turmeric powder, cumin powder and mix well. Add 1/2 cup of water and let it simmer for 3-4 minutes. Now, add the boiled cauliflower and allow it to simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: When the cauliflower is completely soft boiled, add the ground masala paste and salt. Mix well and cook over low flame for another 5 minutes only. Switch off and garnish.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Cauliflower Kurma is a tasty, healthy and popular side dish served along with appam, idiyappam, phulka or malabar paratha.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Ceylon Egg Parotta Recipe, we will add all the ingredients into a mixing bowl except oil. Add little water slowly and mix to form a soft and sticky dough.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a tablespoon of oil and knead it a little more and rest for at least 20 minutes outside. To make the stuffing, heat a skillet with oil, add ginger and garlic and saute till it softens.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add onions and saute till they turn translucent and later you can add bell peppers and keep cooking until it softens. Add chopped tomatoes and green chilies, sprinkle with salt and cook till the tomatoes turn mushy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in red chili powder, turmeric powder and cook for another 5 minutes and switch off the heat. Whisk the eggs in a bowl, add salt and sautéed vegetable mixture and start beating them till it combines.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a roti tawa on a medium heat and leave it side. Pinch out a little dough from the kneaded dough. Dip it in the flour and start rolling to form a thin dough.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Place the rolled dough on the tawa and cook till you seed small boils and flip it over. Add some egg mixture in the center and fold over on either side to form a small pocket.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: You can seal by adding little egg after every fold as well. Flip it over and cook on either side, drizzle some oil as well and cook till it light brown.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Ceylon Egg Parotta Recipe as a snack or just as it is for breakfast or lunch with a cup of Masala Chai or a fresh Muskmelon (Kharbuj) Juice by the side.

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup Basmati rice - or govind bhog rice

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: To begin making Chaal Kopi Recipe -Bengali Style Cauliflower Stir Fry, heat mustard oil in a Kadai and lightly roast the cashew nuts and raisins till the cashew nuts turn golden brown in colour and the raisins puff up.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Keep them aside. To the same pan, add cauliflower florets and stir fry them with little salt and 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder. Sprinkle water and cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Take them out once the cauliflower is cooked and roasted. Keep aside once done. In a heated pan add mustard oil and once it's heated, add cumin seeds, bay leaf, whole cardamom, clove and cinnamon sticks.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Roast until you smell the aromas of the whole spices. at this stage add ginger and green chilies. Saute them for a few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add the drained basmati rice to the pan and saute for about 3 to 4 minute until the rice turns crisp.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the rice has turned slightly crisp, add the tomatoes, cumin powder, coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, sugar and salt. Saute them for about 2-3 minutes. Add water.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover and cook till the rice is fluffy and fully cooked. At this stage, when the rice is cooked and fluffy and all the water has been absorbed; add the cauliflower, the peas, garam masala and stir.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Saute until the Chaal Kopi is well combined with the rice and the masalas. Check the taste, adjust the salt accordingly. Once combined, add the cashew nuts and raisins and transfer the Chaal Kopi in a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chaal Kopi Recipe (Bengali Style Cauliflower Stir Fry) along with Bengali Luchi or Steamed Rice and Bengali Style Lau Die Tetor Dal for a lunch meal, along with sliced fresh Vegetable Salad.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Chalimidi recipe, rinse raw rice and soak in enough water for 5 hours. Drain soaked rice in cotton cloth and let it dry for 1 hour. Grind rice into fine powder.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Pass the flour through the sieve, collect fine rice flour. Heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a heavy bottomed pan, roast cashews, raisins and coconut separately until golden brown. Remove from flame, keep it aside.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Melt powdered jaggery with little water. Boil the jaggery syrup until thickens up and when tested by pouring in a small bowl of water it forms a ball. Add all the ghee into the panakam (jaggery syrup) and whisk well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Remove the syrup from heat, add rice flour little at a time and mix vigorously. Do not add too much rice flour and make it thick. This dish will thicken up as it cools. So keep the consistency loose.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add all the roasted cashews, raisins, and coconut into the dish and mix well. Transfer into a serving bowl and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chalimidi as a dessert after your South Indian meal of Tomato Onion Sambar, Cabbage Thoran, Jeera Rasam, Potato Roast with Steamed Rice and Elai Vadam.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Cheese Masala Omelette Recipe, chop tomatoes, onions, chillies and coriander leaves. Grate the required amount of cheese and keep aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Break 2 eggs into a mixing bowl and add the chopped tomatoes, onions, green chillies, coriander leaves and grated cheese. Mix all the ingredients well to make a the omelette mixture.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Place an omelette pan on medium heat and add some oil to grease the pan. Once the pan in hot, reduce the flame to low and add the egg mixture to the pan. Make sure the egg mixture is equally spread across the pan.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover the pan with the lid, so that the omelette gets cooked a little fasterRemove the lid and check if the omelette has cooked.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: You can either flip the omelette to cook on the other side or fold the omelette in half and cover the pan again so that the cheese melts inside the omelette and all ingredients get cooked thoroughly Keep the lid on for 30 seconds to minute and then turn off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Cheese Masala Omelette Recipe with a cup of Adrak Chai Recipe and a fruit bowl for a sumptuous breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon Lemon zest - grated without the pith
4 tablespoons Parmesan cheese - or any cheese of your choice

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making Cheesy Corn on the Cob Recipe, take a small bowl, add the melted butter, grated ginger, lemon juice and lemon rind, mix well and keep the flavored butter aside.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Next, gently massage the corn cobs with a little oil and roast it over the stove top/barbecue, one by one till cooked well and keep aside.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To arrange the dish, take the roasted corn cob, brush it generously with the ginger and lemon butter, add the grated parmesan or cheese of your choice over its top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: You can also, microwave the readily prepared Cheesy Corn on the Cob to let the cheese melt for half a minute before serving.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Cheesy Corn on the Cob as an after school snack for the kids with Biscottior include it as a starter to your next barbecue party menu on a weekend.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making Chenai Kizhangu Poricha Kootu Recipe (Tamil Nadu Style Yam Cooked in Coconut Gravy), remove the skin on yam. Chop yam into 1 inch cubes. Pressure cook with little salt and turmeric powder for 1 whistle.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Soak yellow moong dal and channa dal separately for 1 hour. Pressure cook for 1 whistle. Add 1 teaspoon oil in a pan.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Roast dried red chilies, ginger-garlic, green chillies, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick, cloves, onion and grated coconut until fragrant and roasted well. Cool and grind the roasted spices into smooth paste.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat remaining oil in a pan. Add bay leaf and fennel seeds. Roast for 10 seconds. Add the ground masala paste and cook until oil separated from the sides of the pan. Add cooked dal and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add cooked yam along with tamarind juice and cook for 5 minutes. Add little water and cook for another 10 minutes. Check for seasoning.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chenai Kizhangu Poricha Kootu Recipe along with steamed rice, Muttai Parotta Recipe ( Ande Ka Paratha / Egg Filled Flat Bread), steamed rice, Tamil Nadu Style Dal Masala Vada with Cabbage Recipe and Tamil Nadu Style Pala Kottai Sambar Recipe for a complete lunch or dinner.

ingredients.text: 4 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - chopped for garnish

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Cherupayar Thoran Recipe, wash the green gram and pressure cook it for 3 whistles by adding enough water and salt. Crush garlic and green chilli in a mortar pestle. Mix it with the grated coconut.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Keep it aside. Heat a heavy bottomed pan with coconut oil. Once he oil is hot, add mustard seeds and urad dal. Once they splutter add cumin seeds, dry red chilli and curry leaves. Give a quick fry.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add onion, turmeric and salt in the pan. Saute the mixture till the onion becomes soft and translucent. Add the coconut mixture and sauté it well till raw smell goes. Add the cooked green gram and mix it well.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Keep on the flame on low for 2-3 minutes. Switch off and garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve Cherupayar Thoran hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Cherupayar Thoran Recipe along with Keerai Sambar, Steamed Rice, Elai Vadam and Beetroot Pachadi for a weekday meal.

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - finely chopped for garnish

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Chettinad Beetroot Kurma Recipe, heat a pan and dry roast all the ingredients mentioned in the Chettinad masala table except coconut till it gets fragrant and keep aside.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Once its cool, grind it along with the coconut to a smooth paste adding little water using a mixer grinder and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in the same pan on medium flame, add the bay leaf and chopped onions and fry until it turns translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the curry leaves, ginger garlic paste and turmeric powder and saute until the raw smell of the ginger-garlic goes away. Add the beetroot cubes and saute for a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground Chettinad masala paste, curd, season with salt, mix well and let the gravy simmer for 10 minutes with the lid on.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the green peas, tomatoes, a cup of water if the gravy is too thick and simmer for another 10 minutes and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the delicious Chettinad Beetroot Kurma Recipe along with Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha and Boondi Raita for a weekday lunch or dinner.

ingredients.text: Sunflower Oil - as required for deep frying

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Inippu Seeyam recipe, soak rice and urad dal separately in water for about 4 hours. Drain the water and grind into thick consistency batter. Add a teaspoon salt and keep aside.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Soak Bengal gram dal for about 2 hours. Then cook in open pot until dal is well cooked and turns soft. Do not overcook dal and make it mushy. Remove dal from heat, drain any excess water if remains. Mash it well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In a heavy bottomed pan, heat crushed jaggery with 2 tablespoon water. Once jaggery melts, add cooked Bengal gram, grated coconut and mix well. Continue to cook until the mix turns thick. Add cardamom powder and mix well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Remove from heat and let it cool down. Divide into equal portions and roll into balls. Meanwhile, heat oil for deep frying. Dip each ball into rice-dal batter gently, coat well.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Then carefully drop into hot oil and deep fry on medium low flame until it turns golden brown. Remove from oil and drain on kitchen paper to absorb excess oil. Serve hot or cold.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chettinad Inippu Seeyam as a dessert after your meal of Chettinad Muttai Masala and Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Masala Powder Recipe, heat a skillet on low-medium, add the whole spices - coriander seeds, cumin seeds, red chillies, carom seeds, star anise, cardamom , cinnamon, cloves, fennel seeds, peppercorns, fenugreek seeds, poppy seeds, mace until fragrant.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: This will take about 8-10 minutes. Turn off the flame. Once the roasted Chettinad masala powder ingredients has cooled down to room temperature, transfer to a mixer-jar and grind until you get a fine powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Store the Chettinad masala powder in an airtight container and can be used for upto 3-4 months.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - cut into cubes

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Mint Potato Biryani Recipe, wash the rice and soak it for 10 minutes. I have used seeraga/jeeraga samba rice. Chop the onion and tomato lengthwise. Crush the garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: Wash and chop potatoes into cubes. Slice the paneer into cubes. Take one chopped onion, mint leaves and fennel seeds in a blender. Add a little water and grind into a puree. Keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a pressure cooker, add the spices listed under “dry spices" including cinnamom stick, cloves, cardamom and bay leaf. Saute for a minute. Add chopped onion and saute until translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add slit green chilli and crushed ginger garlic. Saute well until the raw smell goes. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until it turns soft and mushy. Now add the ground mint puree, curd, few mint leaves, potato and paneer cubes.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir and cook until the oil separates. Add coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala and biryani masala powder. Mix and cook for 5 minutes. Add rice along with required water to it. Mix and bring to boil.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Close the lid and pressure cook for 3 whistles. Once done, wait until the pressure releases naturally and open the lid. Fluff the rice gently and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chettinad Mint Potato Biryani along with Mirchi Ka Salan and , Burani Raita or any raita of your choice.

name: Chettinad Mushroom And Green Peas Stir Fry

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Mushroom and Green Peas Stir Fry Recipe, by roasting the spices for the chettinad masala and grinding into a smooth powder.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Next to stir fry the mushrooms, take a pan with oil add the chopped ginger and garlic, allow them to fry for few minutes. Then add in the onions, saute till it becomes translucent and slight brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next add in your chopped mushroom and saute till it releases all the water and cooks well. At this point, you can add in your ground masala and green peas and mix it well. Stir fry till the raw smell of the masala goes away.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve it on to a plate. Serve the Chettinad Mushroom and Green Peas Stir Fry Recipe along with some Egg Masoor Dal Recipe (Lentil Curry With Eggs) and Kerala Style Whole Wheat Parotta Recipe to make a complete meal.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: To begin making Chettinad Muttai Masala Recipe, hard boil the eggs in boiling water for 12 minutes. Once cooled, remove the shells and keep aside.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Now, dry roast the ingredients listed under the Chettinad masala paste like the coriander seeds, garlic, ginger, coconut, fennel seeds, peppercorns, poppy seeds, cumin seeds and red chill in a Shallow fry pan till the coconut starts to turn brown.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Turn off the heat and let the masala cool down. Once cool grind the roasted masala into a smooth paste in a Mixer grinder with a little water and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a Kadai on medium flame, add the cinnamon stick and cloves and let the spices release its aroma into the oil. Now, add the sliced onions and sauté until it turns translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the tomatoes and cook until it is well cooked, soft and mushy. Now, add the ground Chettinad masala mix and mix well. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mix is cooked well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and sauté until the oil separates. Add half a cup of water, season with salt and let it simmer for another 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, add the halved boiled eggs and turn off the heat. Transfer the Chettinad Muttai Masala into a serving bowl and serve.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with coriander leaves and serve the Chettinad Muttai Masala along with Kerala Parotta and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita for dinner.

ingredients.text: 10 Badam (Almond) - soaked in water and skin removed

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Pazha Payasam recipe, soak almonds and cashews for 4 to 5 hours and grind them to a smooth paste using a mixer grinder. Add milk in a saucepan and bring it to boil.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: When it starts boiling, add almond cashew paste in it and mix everything properly. Cook on low flame till it is reduced to 3/4th in quantity. Stir constantly to ensure that the milk does not burn.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the milk has reduced add sugar and cook till it is reduced to 1/2 in quantity. Add cardamom powder, stir and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Allow the Payasam mixture to cool till it reaches room temperature and then refrigerate for an hour. Meanwhile cut all the fruits in to small pieces and mix them together with honey. Refrigerate the mixed fruits for an hour.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: After an hour combine both Payasam and fruits together and serve the Chettinad Pazha Payasam immediately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chettinad Pazha Payasam as a dessert after a delicious meal of Chettinad Pattani Kurma, Chettinad Style Poondu Rasam and Steamed Rice.

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cup Baby Potatoes - boiled and peeled

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Style Urulai Roast Recipe, boil the potatoes in a pressure cooker with the skin on for about 4 whistle. Release the pressure naturally and drain the water. Peel off the skin and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a small skillet, dry roast all the Chettinad masala spice including coconut, curry leaves, dry red chillies, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon stick, whole black peppercorns and coriander seeds. Let it cook for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Allow it to cool and ground them into a smooth paste by adding little water. Heat a kadai, crackle the mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Add curry leaves and let it sizzle and the add the onions, garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook till the onion becomes translucent. Then later add the tomatoes and a bit of salt and smash it till the tomatoes get cooked. Now add the boiled baby potatoes and let it cook for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Then finally add in the Chettinad ground masala and saute till Urulai Roast gets evenly coated and all the water gets absorbed. At the end add a little bit jaggery, tamarind paste and check for salt.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Give the Urulai Roast a stir and cook for about a minute or two. Serve the Chettinad Style Urulai Roast Recipe along with Tawa Paratha, Palak Dal and Masala Chaas for a weekday lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe, cook the rice to a fluffy texture and keep aside. Also, coarsely pound the ginger, garlic and fennel seeds using a mortar and pestle and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a pan on medium flame, add the cinnamon stick and cloves and let it splutter. Add the ginger, garlic and fennel seeds mix and saute until the raw smell goes away.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the curry leaves and sliced onions and saute until the onions turn translucent. Add the tomatoes and saute until its half cooked. Now, add the slit green chilli, red chilli powder, mint and coriander leaves and mix well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Season with salt and cook the mix until the tomatoes are well cooked and the whole mixture comes together. This will take around 10 minutes. Now, add the cooked rice and mix it evenly using a fork.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.detail: Let it simmer for 5 minutes and switch off the flame. Serve the Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe along with Cauliflower & Cucumber Raita Recipe (Cauliflower Yogurt Salad) for lunch or for kids lunchbox.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Basmati rice - washed well in water
1 Bay leaves (tej patta) - torn into half

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Chettinad Vegetable Pulao, first prep all the ingredient like chop the vegetables and get all the ingredients measured and keep it handy. Soak the Kohinoor Super Basmati Rice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: The first step is to roast and grind all the ingredients for spice powder. Heat a small skillet over medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the whole spices including cloves, cinnamon stick, whole black peppercorns, fennel seeds, coriander seeds and roast for two to three minutes until you smell the aromas and the spices are get a roasted colour.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Once done, allow the spice to cool and then blend into a fine spice powder using a blender. Keep aside. The next step is the make the Chettinad pulao in one single pot.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the ginger garlic, onion and green chilies. Saute until the onions soften.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onions soften, add carrot, green beans, potatoes, bay leaf, turmeric powder, red chili powder and freshly ground spice powder. Stir well to combine. Add the washed Kohinoor Super Basmati rice, salt and 2 cups of water.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Bring the rice to a roaring boil. Once it comes to a roaring boil, turn the heat to low, cover the pan and cook the rice until all the water is absorbed and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Allow the Chettinad vegetable pulao to rest for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes stir in the mint leaves and the green peas and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Chettinad Vegetable Pulao along with Tomato Onion Raita and Vegetable Kurma for lunch or dinner.

ingredients.text: 5 to 6 Dry Red Chillies - adjust according to taste
2 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - finely chopped for garnishing

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Chettinad Vengaya Kosu Recipe, first make the spice paste for the kosu. Heat a kadai on medium heat and dry roast red chillies and fennel seeds till they turn fragrant. Turn off the heat and let them cool.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Once the red chilli and fennel seeds are cooled, grind them in a mixie jar along with coconut. Add a little water to make a smooth paste. keep the masala paste aside. You can proceed to make the tempering.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: To prepare the tempering, heat a kadai on medium heat. Add sesame oil and temper with fennel seeds and curry leaves. Add the sliced onions and tomatoes. Add turmeric powder and salt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix well and let them cook on low flame till the tomatoes become soft and pulpy. Add 1 cup of water to the mixture. Now add the ground masala and mix well. Let the gravy simmer for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: After 3-4 minutes, turn off the heat. Transfer Chettinad Vengaya Kosu in a serving bowl.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with chopped cilantro/mint leaves and serve hot with Biryani, Ven Pongal or Onion Rava Dosa Recipe for breakfast, lunch or weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups Seeraga (Jeeraga) Samba rice - washed and soaked

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Chicken Donne Biryani Recipe, thoroughly clean and wash the chicken pieces.*For the marinationIn a large mixing bowl combine the chicken, yogurt, turmeric powder, salt and lemon juice.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Nicely massage the chicken for 5 minutes and then allow it to rest for a minimum of 30 minutes.*For the green biryani masalaIn a mixer-jar combine the coriander leaves, mint leaves, and green chilies and grind to a thick fine paste along with some water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Transfer to a bowl and set aside. To make the Donne Biryani, in a heavy bottomed pan, heat oil on medium flame, add all the whole spices including bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom and star anise, let this sizzle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the whole spices have sizzled add ginger and garlic paste and the sliced onions, fry until the onions turn golden brown in colour. This will take about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Once the ginger-garlic-onion mixture has cooked well, add in the chicken pieces along with the marinade. Mix and continue to cook the entire mixture for 5-7 more minutes, stirring continuously.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally add in the freshly ground green biryani masala and washed and drained rice, 3 cups of water into the pan. Give the Chicken Donne Biryani a good mix and cover the pan. Turn the flame to the lowest heat.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: In a saucepan, boil water and turn off the flame and place this hot pan on the lid of the kadai. This process is done in order to seal the kadai in which the Chicken Donne Biryani is cooking.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The heat from the hot water in the saucepan provides heat from the top. After 20-25 minutes open the lid to check if the chicken and rice is done. If its is done, lightly fluff up the Chicken Donne Biryani with a fork .

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Transfer the Donne Biryani into a serving plate and serve piping hot. Serve this Chicken Donne Biryani Recipe along with Pudina & Dhaniya Raita Recipe, Roasted Papad and Satvik Carrot Sprout Salad for a hearty Sunday lunch.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making Chicken In Curry Leaves Gravy Recipe, in a mixer grinder, grind curry leaves, coriander leaves, mint leaves and green chillies to a fine paste by adding a little water. Heat oil in a kadai on a medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, add onions and sauté on a low heat till the onions turn soft. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté till the raw smell goes. This will take about a minute or two.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground paste of mint, green chillies and curry leaves, mix well. Add salt and about 1 cup of water and bring to a boil. When it comes to a boil, add the chicken pieces and mix well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Continue cooking for 5 more minutes, then reduce heat and close with a lid. Cook for about 15 minutes or till the chicken is tender while stirring occasionally. You will get a thick gravy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add lemon juice at this stage and stir till combined. Check for seasoning and adjust salt and add white pepper powder to suit your palate. Let it cook for about a minute. Switch off gas and transfer to a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chicken In Curry Leaves Gravy along with Steamed Rice and Burani Raita. You can also serve this with Phulka and Kachumber Salad for a weekday meal.

ingredients.text: 500 grams Chicken - chopped to bite size

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making Chicken In Tomato Onion Gravy Recipe, take onions, green chillies and tomatoes (de seeded) in a mixer jar and grind to a smooth paste.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: In a pressure cooker, add the onion-chilli and tomato paste, curd, salt, chicken masala powder, lemon juice and ginger garlic paste. Stir to combine.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chicken pieces and about half cup of water and close the lid of the pressure cooker and cook on high flame for about 3 whistles or till the chicken is cooked till tender.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once the pressure is released on its own, heat a bit of oil in a kadai and once the oil is hot, transfer the gravy of the cooked chicken from the pressure cooker.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Retain the cooked chicken in the pressure cooker. you may do this by refraining the chicken with a slotted spoon while pouring the gravy. Cook for a few minutes while stirring, till the gravy starts bubbling and thickening.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the gravy is thickened to desired consistency, add the chicken pieces to the kadai, close a lid and cook on a low flame for about 5 minutes or till the flavours seep in a bit more in the chicken pieces.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serv.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chicken In Tomato Onion Gravy Recipe along with Homemade Butter Naan Recipe (Soft Yogurt Bread) or Jeera Rice Recipe - Cumin And Ghee Flavored Rice and Pickled Onions for a complete meal.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Chicken Pasanda Recipe, thoroughly wash and clean the chicken pieces.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: For the spice mixHeat a skillet on low flame and add all the whole spices - Cumin seeds, Black Pepper, Cinnamon Stick, Cloves, Cardamom pods, Bay leaves and Dry red chillies and roast them for few minutes until the spices are well roasted and aroma begins to rise.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Turn off the flame and allow it to cool. Transfer the spices into a mixer-grinder and grind it into a powder. To marinate the chickenIn a large bowl, add curd, freshly ground spice mix, finely chopped ginger and garlic.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chicken breasts into the mixture, coat the masala onto all the pieces of the chicken and let it marinate for half an hour. Heat a heavy bottom pan on medium flame and add oil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, add onions and fry till they turn golden brown. this will take about 4-6 minutes. Now add in the tomatoes, sprinkle salt and turmeric powder and give it a good toss.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover and cook until the tomatoes turn mushy. Add the marinated chicken pieces and stir all the ingredients well. Adjust salt according to your taste, cover the pan with a lid and cook for another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Chicken Pasanda Recipe along with Whole Wheat Palak Naan Recipe and Burani Raita for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 300 grams Chicken breasts - cut into 1 inch cubes
1 Stalk Lemon Grass - white portion only
2 Stalk Lemon Grass - tender white portion only

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Chicken Rendang Recipe we will first make the spice paste. To make the spice paste for Chicken RendangIn a saucepan, heat 1/2 cup of water, add the dry red chillies and bring it to a brisk boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Turn off the flame and let the chillies cool, drain the excess water and set aside. Once the chillies have cooled down split each of them into two, and deseed, ensure all the seeds are completely removed.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Transfer to a bowl and set aside. In a mixer jar, combine the boiled and deseed chillies, onions, ginger, garlic, and lemon grass and grind into a paste. Add some water if required to get a thick spice paste and set aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Getting ahead to make the Chicken Rendang RecipeIn a kadai, heat oil on medium flame, add the whole spices- cloves, cardamom, star anise and cinnamon, once they begin to sizzle, add the freshly ground spice paste to this and cook until the raw smell goes away.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: This will take a good 5-7 minutes. Next add the coconut milk, salt, sugar, lemon grass, mix well and bring to a single boil. Reduce the flame to medium-low, add the chicken pieces and cover the kadai.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: This will take about 6-8 minutes. Ensure you cook the chicken only until tender. Do not over cook, you will be left with rubbery pieces of meat. Turn off the flame and leave the lid on it as before.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a small skillet on medium flame and dry roast the freshly grated coconut , till it turns into a golden brown colour and the aroma wafts in the air. Turn off the flame and add this toasted coconut to the Chicken Rendang.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Check the salt and seasonings and adjust to suit your taste. Transfer the Chicken Rendang to a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chicken Rendang along with Thai Coconut Garlic Rice Recipe, a fried egg on the side for a lip smacking meal.

ingredients.text: 200 grams Chicken - cut into small pieces
1 Sweet Potato - skin peeled and chopped small

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Chicken and Sweet Potato Dill Curry Recipe, heat a small skillet with teaspoon oil, add coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick and allow it to sizzle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add ginger, garlic and allow it soften for few seconds. Add chopped onions and saute till they turn translucent. Fry till the onions turn golden brown and is caramelized well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Switch off the heat, add the sautéed onion mixture into the grinder and grind it to a smooth paste. Open the lid, add dill leaves and little water and grind it again for some more time till it forms a nice puree.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pressure cooker with oil, add bay leaf and add in the ground paste and cook for at least 10 minutes. Add sweet potato, chicken, salt and about 1/2 a cup of water and pressure cook it for at least 4 whistle.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Chicken and Sweet Potato Dill Curry along with methi Laccha Paratha, Beetroot Raita to make it a complete and satisfying meal.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - washed

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making Narkel Diye Cholar Dal, Soak the dal for 5 to 6 hours. Pressure cook the dal with a little salt and turmeric until just cooked, take care that the dal does not become too mushy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a little oil in a heavy bottomed pan and shallow fry the coconut slices till a gorgeous golden. Drain and set aside. Heat the ghee-oil mixture in a pot. Throw in the crushed cinnamon and cardamom.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once they release their aroma, add the bay leaf, cumin seeds, dry red chillies and allow to splutter. Add the grated ginger and green chillies, saute for a while and then gently pour the dal.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.detail: Simmer the dal over low flame, occasionally stirring, for about 5 to 7 minutes. Add the raisins, sprinkle in the sugar and adjust the salt. (The dal is meant to have a thick consistency, you would not want it to be too thin).

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Finish with fried coconuts and serve hot. Enjoy Narkel Diye Cholar Dal along with Steamed Rice and Begun Bhaja for a weekday meal.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Kabuli Chana (White Chickpeas) - soaked overnight

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin with Chickpea Salad with Raw Mango, wash and soak the chickpeas overnight.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: In a pressure cooker, add the chana and water and pressure cook for 6 whistles on high flame, reduce the flame and continue to cook for 15 more minutes. Turn off the flame.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Allow the pressure to release naturally, drain the water and transfer the chana into a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl, combine the chana, onions, chopped green chilli, tomatoes, salt, red chilli powder and give the mixture a good stir. To this add raw mango pieces, chaat masala, lemon juice and toss the salad mix.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with chopped coriander and mint leaves. Serve Chickpea Salad With Raw Mango as a tea time snack with Masala Chai or Watermelon Carrot Radish Juice Recipe and Baked Mathri.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas) - soaked overnight

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Chickpea Sundal recipe, heat oil in a pan on medium heat; add the mustard seeds and allow it to crackle. Once it crackles, stir in the ginger, green chillies, asafoetida, salt and the cooked chickpeas.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir-fry for a few minutes until all the ingredients are well combined. Turn off heat and stir in the coconut and coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Chickpea Sundal hot as healthy tea time snack for the family or make it for special festivals like Gollu (Navratri). Serve Chickpea Sundal as an evening snack with Mango Iced Tea during summer.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: You can also serve it with Keerai Sambar and Steamed Rice for your weekday meal.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: We begin making the Chinese 5 spice powder by grinding all the ingredients in a hand blender to a coarse powderOnce done store it in an airtight container for further use.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Chinese 5 spice powder in a Zhejiang Style Crispy Five Spice Powder Spring Roll Recipe.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin with the Chingiri Paturi Recipe start by soaking khus khus for minimum 3 to 4 hours or overnight. Wash and clean prawns nicely in salt water to remove that fishy smell. In a grinder jar, take soaked khuskhus, mustard seeds, green chilies and grated coconut. Grind to make a thick & smooth paste. Add salt as per taste and mustard oil in the paste. Mix well and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat 2 cups of water in a pan and add few drops of lemon juice and 2 pinch of salt. As soon as the water starts boiling, add prawns and turn off the gas and remove pan from the stove and keep aside for few minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The prawns will blanch and also get properly cleaned. After a while, drain water and collect the prawns and keep aside. Heat mustard oil in a non stick pan and saute the prawns for 2-3 mins.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Divide the prawns in four equal portions and keep aside. For making leaf parcels, first take a banana leaf and heat on stove top very carefully from both sides. Keep the leaf high from flames to avoid getting burnt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: By doing this the leaf will soften and get easily folded like a fabric without tearing apart. Do this for all for pieces of leaf and keep aside. Now take a banana leaf piece and place around of khuskhus paste in the center.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add one portion of sauteed prawns on the paste. Gently mix such that the paste coats all over the prawns. Add some more paste over the prawns and around mustard oil on top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.detail: Carefully fold the two opposite sides of the leaf inwards and then the next two sides inwards to make parcels. Tie the packet cris-cros with thread and put a knot. Make other parcels following the same method and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a non stick pan that has a lid. Brush some mustard oil all over. Place the parcels on the pan and cover the lid. Steam the parcels in low flames for 10 mins or till you find the color of leaf changing.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Carefully flip the parcel and steam from the other side as well. This might take 15-20 mins in total. Turn of the gas and carefully transfer the parcels on the serving plate and serve hot with plain steamed rice.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.detail: Do not open the parcel before serving, they shall be opened by the one who is about to relish this delicacy. Enjoy the Chingiri Paturi Recipe with some hot rice and samar for amazing lunch.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Palm jaggery - use date palm jaggery
3/4 cup Palm jaggery - use date palm jaggery

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Chirer Dudh Puli recipe, firstly we will make the stuffing. Take a large pan, 1 cup jaggery into this pan and heat it on medium flame.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the jaggery is melted, add grated coconut, stir this mixture continuous until the mixture comes together and sticks together. Switch off the gas when the mixture leaves the sides of the pan.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Keep this mixture in a wide plate to become cool. The next step is to make the outer shell for the Puli.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Soak Chire or Poha or flat beaten rice into a bowl of water for 2 to 3 minutes, then wash the chire or poha properly and drain the water through a colander.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add chire or poha, maida and sooji in a bowl, make a soft dough by adding milk gradually. Now make lemon sized balls from the dough. Flatten each ball with your fingers then a make a bowl by pressing down the middle section in.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Do not make it very thick or thin. The shell would be medium thin. Add small amount of jaggery coconut mixture into it. Bring together both the edges, then press and seal with your finger. Make other pulis the same way.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To make the kheer, add milk for Kheer in a big heavy bottomed pan on medium flame. Once it starts to boil, switch the heat to low and cook for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Then remove the pan from the heat, add the required jaggery and mix, then place the pan back on the heat again and let it be cook on low flame. Adding jaggery into the milk in this way will prevent the milk to be curdled.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add all the prepared pulis now one by one, cook for another 10 minutes or until pulis are soft and the milk has thickened. Once done, take the Chirer Dudh Puli out in a bowl and serve hot or chilled.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chirer Dudh Puli as a dessert after your meal of Dhokar Dalna, Bengali Style Sheem Poshto and Luchi for your everyday meal.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To make this Chow-Chow Kothamalli Chutney Recipe| Chayote Coriander Chutney, clean, peel and dice the chayote and get ready with the other ingredients. In a saucepan, heat oil, add urad dal, channa dal, and mix them well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After they turn golden brown, add chillies and sauté.Add the diced chow-chow and sauté them till they are cooked but firm. Add tamarind to chow chow and sauté.After the chow chow is cooked, turn off the flame and let it cool.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixer, add coriander leaves, chow-chow mixture, and salt to taste. Grind to a smooth chutney. Add water only if needed. If needed you can temper them with some mustard seeds, urad dal, and curry leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chow-Chow Kothamalli Chutney Recipe| Chayote Coriander Chutney with idlis, onion rava dosa recipe or as an accompaniment with full course lunch.

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon Whole Black Peppercorns - freshly cracked

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Chunky Cucumber Salsa, lay the cucumbers on a flat wooden surface or working space. Use a rolling pin and bash the cucumber into bite size chunks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Alternatively, use a wooden mortar pestle to roughly break the cucumbers down to chunks. In a bowl toss together the cucumber chunks, tomato, onion, garlic and coriander leaves.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the jalapenos, black pepper, salt, lime juice and toss again. Garnish with spring onion leaves. Chill for half an hour and then serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Chunky Cucumber Salsa with Chips made of Homemade Tortillas or as an accompaniment to Mexican Brown Rice and Quinoa Casserole or Vegetarian Bean & Cheese Enchiladas.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Chunni ki Puri / Dal & Besan Puri Recipe, wash and soak the moong dal for 20 minutes. In a pressure cooker, add the dal along with 1/2 cup of water and pressure cook for 2 whistles and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: Allow the pressure to release naturally. Once the pressure has released, mash dal with a whisk or churner, and allow it to cool. There will be very little water remaining which you can use to make the poori dough.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a large mixing bowl, add whole wheat flour, besan, salt, hing and the mashed dal. Add a little water if required and knead into a firm dough. Add a teaspoon of oil on the top and knead for a few more minutes until smooth.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Cover with a muslin cloth and set aside. In a heavy bottomed pan, add required amount of oil for frying the Dal & Besan Puri.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Divide the Dal & Besan Puri dough into equal portions, and dust the surface with whole wheat flour and flatten the dough balls with the rolling pin. Roll them out into a 2-1/2 to 3 inch diameter circle.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once the oil is heated, gently slice in the Dal & Besan Puri. Using a slotted spoon, keep pouring oil over the puri and gently press the puri, so that the chunni ki puri puffs up.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: At this point, turn the puri to the other side and fry till it turns golden brown. Drain the Dal & Besan Puri on a kitchen towel to absorb the extra oil and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chunni ki Puri/Dal & Besan Puri along with Jodhpuri Aloo Recipe or Rawal Pindi Style Chole Recipe and Boondi Raita for a weekday meal.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Classic Indian Sliced Salad Recipe, wash and wipe all the veggies clean. Peel the skin of the cucumber and the carrot. Cut the tomato and onion into slices and have them ready.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Attach the thin slicing blade into the masterchef jar. Close the lid of the Jar. Add the cucumber into the spout of the lid and turn on the processor to make thin cucumber slices.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once done transfer the cucumbers into a bowl and keep aside. Next add the carrots into the spout of the lid and turn on the processor to make thin carrot slices.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Take a serving plate and arrange the carrots at the edge of the plate .Then arrange the sliced cucumbers followed by the tomato slices and the onion slices in serving plate.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Sprinkle some salt and some crushed pepper and squeeze some lemon juice over the sliced vegetables and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Classic Indian Sliced Salad Recipe along with a Smoked Dal Makhani, Palak Paneer Recipe, Jeera Rice or Tawa Paratha for a special weeknight dinner. You can also have this salad as a midday snack.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Classic South indian Rava Idli Recipe, prep all the ingredients and keep them ready. Heat a teaspoon of oil in a pan on medium flame, add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the torn curry leaves, grated ginger, green chilies and cashew nuts. Roast them for a few minutes. Add the Semolina/Rava and roast until you get a good aroma. Set aside to cool. Set aside the roasted rava idli mixture to cool.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl combine the roasted rava idli mixture along with the yogurt, and add just enough water to make a thick batter and keep aside to rest for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After the resting period, you will have to add a little water as the rava idli batter would have soaked up all the moisture. Add the grated carrots and enos fruit salt and whisk the rava idli batter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: If the batter is too thick add water to make a thick batter of dropping consistency. Stir well for a couple of minutesPreheat an idli steamer with enough water and keep it ready.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Grease the idli mould with oil and spoon the Rava Idli mixture into the cavities. Place it in a preheated steamer and steam for 10 minutes until done.

steps.title: Cook
