steps.detail: When you test, the rava idli should be cooked and the tester should come out clean. Serve the Rava Idli along with South Indian Coconut Chutney and Potato Saagu for a quick and wholesome breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Dry coconut (kopra) - cut into small pieces

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making Kopparai Thengai Milagai Podi Recipe first cut the dry coconut into small pieces and keep them aside. We will roast all the ingredients separately on medium heat so that the dals and other ingredients do not burn.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pan on medium heat and first roast the channa dal until it turns golden brown in colour. Remove in a bowl and allow to cool. Next in the same pan roast urad dal till golden brown. Remove in a bowl and allow to cool.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next add the sesame seeds to the same pan and roast for a few seconds till the sesame seeds start popping. Remove into a bowl and keep aside. Now we will roast the red chillies till crisp and keep them aside as well.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Finally we will roast the dry coconut till it starts to turn golden brown. Do not brown it too much. keep stirring in between. Remove in a bowl and allow to cool.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the dals and all the other ingredients have cooled add them to a mixer grinder along with hing and tamarind and grind till you get a coarse powder. Add salt to the grinder now and pulse again to get a coarse powder.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Once done, transfer the Kopparai Thengai Milagai Podi into a bottle and store for a couple of months.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Kopparai Thengai Milagai Podi with Homemade Soft Idli, Green Coriander and Coconut Chutney and Filter Coffee for delicious breakfast.

name: Coconut Rice Pulao With Coconut Cream

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To beging making the Coconut Rice Pulao With Coconut Cream Recipe, wash and clean the basmati rice 2-3 times and soak for 30 minutes. In the meantime, prepare coconut milk.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Blend the coconut cream with 2 cups of water in a Mixer/blender till it forms a smooth mixture. Keep it aside. You may skip this step if using coconut milk. Drain the soaked rice and add it to an Electric rice cooker.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the coconut milk into it. You can also use a Pressure cooker or Open container to cook the rice. In a small pan, add oil or ghee.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: When the oil is hot, add bay leaf, cardamom pods, cloves, black peppercorns, and sauté at low heat till it releases the aroma. Add the cumin seeds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: When the seeds stop to sizzle, add the grated or chopped ginger and sauté for 2 minutes so that the raw smell goes away. Now add the chopped carrots and green peas. Sauté at medium heat for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the fried carrots and peas mixture into the rice cooker. Add water as required for the rice to cook. Cover the cooker with the lid and cook until the rice is cooked.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: For tempering, in a small pan, add 2 teaspoons of ghee or oil. Saute the cashews and the coconut slices for 2 minutes on low heat. Add this tempering to the cooked rice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Coconut Rice Pulao With Coconut Cream Recipe with Cabbage Onion Vada Recipe and Vegetable Stew for a delicious and comforting Lunch.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: To begin making Coorg Koli Curry Recipe, marinate the chicken in red chilli powder and turmeric powder and let it sit in the fridge for 30 minutes minimum.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Take a mixer jar and add coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon, cloves ginger, garlic, green chillies and roasted poppy seeds. Grind them all together, add some water to it.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, take a large pan and heat cooking oil on medium flame. Once the oil is hot enough, add the chopped onions and fry till golden brown, on a medium heat.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Now turn the heat to low, and add the masala paste which you ground earlier into the pan, stir till the raw smell disappears.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add the chicken pieces into it, and required salt to taste and cook for about 7-8 minutes on low heat. Once the chicken looks well coated with spices, then add some water.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover it with a lid and cook the chicken on a low heat for about 15 to 20 minutes or till it gets tender. Once the chicken is cooked, add tamarind extract and cook for 5 more minutes. Switch off and serve it hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Coorg Koli Curry Recipe Coorgi Akki Roti or Ari Pathiri Recipe for a complete comforting meal.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: To begin making Coorg Style Bollari Barthad Recipe (Mangalore Cucumber Stir Fry), halve the cucumbers and scoop out the seeds and rind. Cut it into small pieces without peeling.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a kadai and add mustard seeds, allow them to splutter. Once they do splutter, on a medium heat, add urad dal to the pan immediately.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the urad dal is crisp and changes colour, add the cumin seeds, curry leaves and broken red chilli and saute a bit till the curry leaves sizzle. Immediately add crushed garlic cloves and onions.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Saute them till the onions are translucent. Add the diced Mangalorean cucumber, turmeric, salt and mix. Cook with the lid closed. Sprinkle a little water if you feel the barthad needs more water to cook.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: While the cucumber is cooking, in a mixer, grind coriander seeds, cumin seeds and red chillies with a bit water. Finally add fresh coconut and pulse once or twice.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: When cucumber is about 3/4th done, add the ground masala paste and jaggery. Mix and cook till all the water has been absorbed .

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Coorg Style Bollari Barthad Recipe (Mangalore Cucumber Stir Fry) along with Steamed Rice, Nuggekai Kharbyaali Recipe (North Karnataka Spiced Drumstick Sambar), Pineapple Gojju Recipe, and Phulka for a complete meal.

steps.title: Bake
steps.detail: To begin making the Coriander Garlic Baked Chicken recipe, thoroughly clean the chicken and rub with salt and let it rest for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Meanwhile, make a paste of Jeera, garlic, ginger, coriander leaves, onion and green chillies along with a few teaspoons of water in a mixer grinder. Line baking tray with parchment paper and arrange chicken pieces on it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Pour the marinade and ensure that the chicken pieces are coated with marinade on all sides. Arrange the vegetables on the leftover spaces on the tray. Let the chicken pieces rest for 2-3 hours.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Preheat oven for 10 minutes at 200 degree centigrade. Brush oil on the chicken pieces. Bake the chicken pieces for 30-40 minutes and reduce the temperature to 180 degree centigrade.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Brush oil in between to ensure the chicken remains soft and juicy. Serve hot. Serve Coriander Garlic Baked Chicken along with Beetroot Salad Recipe With Mixed Greens & Feta Cheese for a healthy weekday dinner.

ingredients.text: 4 Green Chillies - (depending upon how spicy you want)
1/2 cup Green peas (Matar) - fresh or frozen

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Coriander Semiya Recipe, soak the rice sticks in just enough hot water to cover it fully. Keep aside for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain and keep aside.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: In a blender container, blend the coriander leaves (coarsely chopped), coconut, green chilies and garlic to a fine paste. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan and add the dry spices (cloves, bay leaf, cardamom and star anise). Saute till it emanates a good aroma, takes a few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the sliced onions and fry on medium till soft and light golden brown. Next, add in the carrots, green peas and cook till the carrots become soft.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Once the carrots become soft, stir in the coconut paste and sauté on medium high, stirring often till almost dry and the spices have fried well. Add the garam masala powder, soaked and drained rice sticks and salt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix everything nicey. Keep stirring on medium heat till the coriander paste and spices have coated the vermicelli well and the mixture is heated through. Close and heat on low for about 2 minutes more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Remove and serve hot with potato chips and a salad and boondi raita or any raitha. Serve Coriander Semiya Recipe along with Boondi Raita, Tadka Raita or any other raita of your choice.

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons Mango pickle - or any pickle of your choice
3 tablespoons Sunflower Oil - for rolling and frying

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Corn Stuffed Paratha, we have to first wash the corn and keep the potatoes cooked.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: You can either pressure cook the potatoes for 2 whistles or add them to saucepan with water and boil them for 15 mins/until it is cooked. Once the potatoes are cooked, peel the skin and add them to a bowl and mash them.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once mashed, add chopped coriander leaves, sweet corn and homemade tomato pickle. Mix well. Add required amount of salt and mix the mixture well. Keep aside. The corn stuffing is ready.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now we have to make the dough for the paratha. In a flat bowl add wheat flour, salt and mix. Add water little by little and knead the dough until it is smooth and homogeneously mixed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Apply a coating of oil on top of the ball of dough and leave it to rest for 10 minutes. Next, divide the dough into medium sized balls. Take one ball of dough and roll it out until its about 4-5 inches diameter.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Place one tablespoon of stuffing in the center and join the ends of the paratha dough so that the stuffing in encased in the dough. Do the same with the rest of the dough and corn mixture.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Place a tawa on medium heat and add some oil. Place the stuffed paratha on the tawa and cook on both sides until done. Drizzle some oil on top of the paratha when cooking on both sides.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Take off the pan and finish the rest of the rolled out parathas. Serve Corn Stuffed Paratha Recipe with Pisarna Manga Recipe and Homemade Curd

name: Corn and Spinach Whole Wheat Calzone

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - or tofu

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Corn and Spinach Whole Wheat Calzone Recipe, first get all the ingredients ready. To begin making the dough for the spinach roti - in a wok, add a teaspoon of oil and stir fry the spinach until it wilts down.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once the spinach wilts down, turn off the heat and allow it to cool. once cooled, puree the spinach.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a large mixing bowl, add the pureed spinach, the whole wheat flour, salt and add little water at a time to make a smooth firm dough. Drizzle a little oil and knead again to make a smooth dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Divide the dough into 8 to 10 equal portions and shape into balls. Keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To make the corn filling for the calzone, heat oil in a pan and add green chillies and capsicum and stir fry until the capsicum becomes soft and tender.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once soft and tender, add the remaining filling ingredients and stir well to combine. Check the salt and adjust to suit your taste.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.detail: To make the calzones, roll the dough ball into a flat circle of 3 inch diameter by dusting it in flour. Place a tablespoon of the filling on one side of the rolled dough.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.detail: Now fold the other to make a calzone which is half moon shaped. Take a fork and press on all sides to seal the edges and make a design. Place this calzone on a hot tava on simmer.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a little oil on both sides and cook until the dough is cooked through and brown on both sides and lightly crisp. Once done, remove from the skillet and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Corn and Spinach Whole Wheat Calzone as a tea time snack, pack into the kids lunch box or even serve it as an appetizer for parties along with Macaroni Minestrone Soup and Roasted Potatoes & Zucchini Bake

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Rice - soaked in water for at least 3 hours

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Creamy Phirni recipe, drain the soaked rice and add it to a mixer grinder. Grind the rice coarsely in a grinder by adding a little water or milk.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: The texture should be of fine grains and should not become a paste. Boil milk in a heavy bottomed pan. Once it starts boiling, add green cardamom into the milk. Add sugar in the boiling milk and then add rice into it.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir continuously it for at-least 20 minutes or till the rice gets cooked and the mixture turns slighlty thick. When it starts getting thick, turn off the heat and let the phirni cool properly.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Pour the creamy phirni in kullads (earthen pots), top with pistachios and cover the pots. Keep it in fridge for 2 to 3 hours. Now take it out, garnish it with sliced almonds or pistachios and serve it chilled.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Creamy Phirni as a dessert after your scrumptious meal or make it during Ramadan to celebrate the festival.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Creamy Phirni with delicious meal of Aloo Gobi Ki Sabzi, Ajwain Puri and Boondi Raita on a weekend for brunch or a meal.

ingredients.text: 3 Ripe Bananas - (small) cut into small cubes
1/2 cup Green seedless Grapes - cut into half

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Fruit Custard will first mix the custard powder with a little milk to form a smooth mixture with no lumps. Add the remaining milk and stir well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Place the custard milk in a saucepan and cook over medium heat and keep stirring continuously until you begin to see the custard thicken.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: It is important to keep stirring it continuously, else the custard mixture will form lumps and will not have a smooth texture. Once the custard thicken, add the sugar and stir well for another 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Give it a taste, the custard should not feel raw, instead should be cooked well and taste creamy. Once the custard is cooked, allow the custard to cool completely.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the custard is cooled, add in the chopped seasonal fruits and give it a stir. Serve the Fruit Custard recipe as an easy indian dessert for your parties or even for a simple sunday lunch.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Palak Pakora Recipe, first prepare all the ingredients and keep aside. In a mixing bowl, combine the besan, rice flour, spinach, onion, green chili, garlic, ginger, fennel seeds, eno, hing and salt.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To the bowl, add a little water at a time to make a thick batter. Heat a Kuzhi paniyaram pan over medium heat, add 1/2 teaspoon of oil in each of the cavities of the pan.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Spoon a tablespoon of Palak Pakora batter into each of the cavities and pan fry until brown and crisp, flip on the other side and cook as well.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Once done transfer the palak pakoras onto a plate with an oil absorbent paper and serve these crispy Pakoras hot. Serve the Palak Pakora with Mint Chutney and Adrak chai for a tea time snack during monsoons.

ingredients.text: 1 Pomfret fish - cut into 1 inch size pieces
1 teaspoon Salt - + Extra for pomfret pieces

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Crispy Pan Fried Pomfret Recipe, wash Pomfret with water. Drain all the water and sprinkle some salt and keep it aside for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixer grinder, add coriander leaves, fennel seeds, whole black peppercorns, cloves, turmeric powder, dry red chillies, garlic, ginger and tamarind. Grind all the masala with about 1/3 Cup water to smooth batter for fish.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a teaspoon of salt into the paste and mix well. Apply this batter or paste to pomfret pieces and keep aside for marination for about 10 minutes. Heat a skillet, add oil.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: Coat the marinated pomfret pieces well with semolina on both the sides. Place them over oil on the skillet. Let them fry on medium heat for about 3 to 4 minutes. Flip to fry on the other side.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once they are all brown and crispy, switch off the heat and remove them out on a serving plate. Enjoy this tasty, crispy pomfret masala fry as an appetizer.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Crispy Pan Fried Pomfret along with Prawns Coconut Curry and Steamed Rice for a weekday meal.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making Crispy and Spicy Chilli Chicken Recipe, Clean chicken and chop them to bite sized pieces.and slice the onions as well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In a kadai, heat about 2 teaspoons oil and cumin seeds and wait for a few seconds till they sizzle. Immediately add ginger, garlic, green chillies, cinnamon sticks, and cloves to roast well till the chillies brown a bit.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Once it is done, in a mixer, add the roasted masalas and coriander leaves into it and grind them into fine thick paste. You can add a bit of water to make a paste. Keep this paste aside for later use.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a large mixing bowl, add chicken pieces and put in salt, curd/yogurt into it.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground thick masala paste, turmeric powder, corn flour, maida, egg white and stir nicely until the chicken gets coated evenly with all the ingredients.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Keep this chicken mixture to marinate for about 4 hours in the refrigerator. Once the chicken is marinated for 4 hours, heat enough oil to deep fry, in a deep frying pan.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot enough, drop the chicken pieces one by one into the deep frying pan on a low flame to allow them to crisp up.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Now once the chicken pieces turn to golden brown colour, take them off from the pan onto a kitchen towel. Fry all the chicken in batches until they are crisp and golden brown.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Once all the chicken is fried, in the same hot oil, deep fry the onion slices and curry leaves till crisp, on a medium high heat. While serving, serve crispy fried chicken and top it with some fried onions and curry leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Crispy and Spicy Chilli Chicken Recipe as a side dish with the main meal of steamed rice and Milagu Rasam (Village Style Pepper Rasam) Recipe for dinner with friends and family.

name: Cucumber Tomato Corn Peanut Salad With Lemon

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Cucumber Tomato Corn Peanut Salad With Lemon Recipe, we will first chop all the vegetables and keep it ready.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a sauce pan on medium heat, add th corn kernels along with 1/2 a cup of water boil for 6-8 minutes. Turn off the flame, drain the water and set the corn aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl combine, cucumber, tomato, onion, corn, green chili, peanuts. Squeeze in the lemon juice, sprinkle salt and add coriander leaves and give it a mix. Toss it nicely and check for salt and adjust accordingly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Sprinkle with toasted and crushed peanuts and serve. Serve the Cucumber Tomato Corn Peanut Salad With Lemon Recipe along with tawa paratha, Dal Palak Recipe and some steamed rice by the side.

name: Cucumber, Red Radish, Tomatoes & Onion Salad

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Cucumber, Red Radish, Tomatoes & Onion Salad Recipe, first get all the ingredients chopped.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a large mixing bowl, add all the vegetables- cucumber, radish, tomatoes, onions, and add salt, pepper, green chilies, lemon juice and coriander. Toss the salad well and serve it fresh.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Cucumber, Red Radish, Tomatoes & Onion Salad along with Golden Glow Smoothie Recipe for a simple evening snack during the summer season.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To prepare Curd Rice Recipe With Mint Flavor, first we need to wash and soak rice for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Once the rice is soaked, take a deep pan or rice cooker, add 1 and 1/4 cups of water, soaked rice, mint leaves and pinch of salt in it. Cook rice till it is completely cooked soft.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: Now whisk the curd without adding water since this recipe needs a thick yogurt. Mash the rice lightly and when rice is cooled completely, add whisked yogurt and milk to it. For Tempering, heat oil in a tadka pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, add mustard and let it splutter. Then add fresh mint leaves, carrot, coriander leaves, curry leaves and salt mix for a few seconds and switch off heat.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Now pour the seasoning to the curd and rice mixture and mix well, then keep the mixed curd rice with tadka into the refrigerator for about 30 minutes or till cold.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: After this, Garnish them with Pomegranate seeds and few more mint leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Curd Rice Recipe With Mint Flavor along with Carrots And Coriander Fritters Recipe or Mangalorean Style Biscuit Roti Recipe for lunch or pack them into lunch box.

ingredients.text: 2 Green Chillies - finely chopped (adjust according to your taste)

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Curd Rice With Carrots recipe, wash and soak rice for 20 to 30 minutes. Add the required water, salt to the cooker and cook the rice. Fluff up the rice or mash lightly to suit your liking. Cool it completely.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add curd to cooled rice and mix well until combined. If using milk, add it as well and stir. Heat oil in a tadka pan, add cashew nuts, groundnuts and fry them till golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add cumin and mustard seeds, when they begin to splutter, add dals and fry until golden. Once it is done, add ginger, chili and curry leaves. When the curry leaves turn crisp, add hing and switch off the stove.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add coriander leaves and grated carrots to the curd rice, pour the tempering and mix. Serve Curd Rice With Carrots as a side dish with your delicious meal or have it on its own for a light and healthy lunch.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: You can also pack it for your lunch box.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Dal Banjara Recipe, add all the ingredients into the pressure cooker including black urad dal, chana dal, ginger, green chilli, tomato, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, turmeric powder, garam masala powder.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add 2-1/2 cups of water and pressure cook the dal for two to three whistles. After two whistles, turn the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the pressure is released completely, open the cooker and your dal is ready. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste. Transfer the dal to a serving bowl. The next step is to make the tadka.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a small pan, add the cumin seeds and red chilies. Allow them to roast and crackle. Once done, turn off the heat and pour the seasoning over the dal. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Dal Banjara along with Phulkas, Bhindi Masala and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita for a weekday meal.

ingredients.text: 1 Bay leaf (tej patta) - torn into half

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: To begin making Dal Tadka Recipe, cook the lentils (split moong dal) with 2 and half cups of water, turmeric powder and salt until soft. Whisk the dal if you like a finer texture, else let the dal have grainy texture.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Allow it to rest in the pan/pressure cooker it was cooked. Heat a teaspoon of ghee in a small pan; add in the cumin seeds and allow it to crackle. Next add in the ginger, green chillies and bay leaf and stir fry for a few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the seasoning to the cooked lentils. Give the lentils along with the seasoning a brisk boil , add in the butter and adjust the salt levels to suite your taste.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: After a couple of minutes of boiling the dal, turn off the the heat, squeeze in the lemon juice and stir in the chopped coriander leaves.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Transfer the Dal Tadka to a serving bowl and Serve Dal Tadka along with Phulkas and Kachumber Salad for a weekday meal.

name: Dal Vada with Oats and Vegetable

ingredients.text: 1 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - soaked for 30 minutes
1/2 cup White Urad Dal (Whole) - soaked for 30 minutes

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Dal Vada with Oats and Vegetable Recipe, finely grind the soaked dals with salt and adding as little water as possible into a thick smooth vada batter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped carrot, cabbage, onions, green chillies, coriander leaves, curry leaves, garlic and oats and mix into the ground dal paste. Check the salt and spice levels to adjust to suit your taste.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat the Kuzhi paniyaram Pan and add a drop of oil to coat the pan; once the pan is well heated scoop the vada batter using a scoop spoon.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Cover the pan and allow it to steam .You will notice the top part of the vada getting cooked.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: At this point you could add another drop of oil and then using a tiny flat spoon gently flip the vada so it can get cooked from the other side and crisp as well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: When you insert the back of the spoon or a knife in the center it should come out clean - this the test to check whether it is has been cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.detail: Continue the same process with the remaining vada batter and enjoy the healthy version of the vada's.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Dal Vada with Oats and Vegetable Recipe along with Sweet and Spicy Raw Mango Chutney along with Baked Chevdo Recipe (Chivda Mixture -Tea Time Snack) to have a variation for your tea time snacks.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Date Obattu recipe, first we need to prepare the ingredients required for this recipe. Soak dates in 1/2 a cup of hot water for 1-2 hours. Grind the almonds to a powder.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind the dry coconut into a thick paste with very little water. Now grind the soaked dates mixture without any additional water to a smooth paste.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Combine date paste, almond powder, coconut paste and jaggery (if using) in a pan and cook for 2-3 minutes. Let this mixture cool slightly and shape them into 4 equal sized balls and set aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In mixing bowl add semolina, maida, salt and enough water to make a soft and knead well for 6 to 8 mins and let it rest with a moist cloth covered over it for 1 to 1 and half hours.

steps.title: Knead
steps.detail: Now knead again briefly and pour enough oil to cover it completely. (If you spread a tiny piece of this mixture with your fingers on a clean surface and lift it up it should not break and you must almost be able to see through it)On a sheet of grease-proof paper, smear some oil, pinch a gooseberry sized dough and flatten it with your fingers and place the date ball on it, now cover the ball by stretching the ends of the dough using your fingers and seal it securely.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Place this dough secured date ball on the greaseproof paper and pat it with your fingers to as thin as possible or thick according to your preference. Now transfer this on to a hot tava and peel the paper after 30 seconds.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook on both sides uncovered by drizzling some oil or ghee. Serve Date Obattu with South Indian Kosambari Recipe with Raw Mango, Cucumber, Carrot and Beetroot and Paruppu Rasam for a wholesome meal.

name: Delicious Methi Chicken Curry - Murgh Methi Curry

ingredients.text: 300 grams Boneless chicken - cut into pieces
1 cup Methi Leaves (Fenugreek Leaves) - roughly chopped
1 tablespoon Sunflower Oil - to fry the onions

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making Methi Chicken Curry recipe, firstly clean the chicken and wash thoroughly in sufficient water. Drain the water from chicken and cut into medium sized pieces. Keep them aside. Add garlic, ginger, green chillies and the coriander leaves into a mixer grinder and grind them into a paste using very little water. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Take a bowl and add curd, half of the green paste that we made above and half of the turmeric powder. Mix it well. Next add the chicken pieces into the bowl and coat the chicken with this coriander, ginger and garlic mixture.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: Once it is done, keep the chicken aside to marinate for about an hour. The next step is to make the gravy for the methi chicken curry. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, add the sliced onions and saute adding a pinch salt to speed up the caramelization (browning). Keep stirring on low to medium heat constantly till the onions are lightly browned.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The caramelised onions impart a delicious flavour to the Methi Chicken Curry. Turn off the heat and keep these onions aside to cool down a bit. When cooled down, grind to a fine paste in a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil into the same pan over medium heat. Add the whole spices mentioned for tempering which includes cloves, cinnamon stick, cardamom, black peppercorn and bay leaves. Saute until the aromas of the spices wafts in the air.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next add the remaining green coriander paste, the caramelized onion paste and stir for a couple of minutes. Now add the remaining turmeric powder and the chopped tomatoes. Saute and cover the pan with a lid and cook until the tomatoes turn soft. Once the tomatoes are soft, add the red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped methi leaves and saute till the leaves become soft. At this stage, add the marinated chicken with the entire marinade and saute on high flame for 2 to 3 minutes. When the chicken changes colour, add a cup of water and bring the mixture to a boil. Add salt to taste. Cover and cook the Methi Chicken Curry on medium heat stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: It will take about 20 minutes to cook the chicken to perfection. When the chicken is fully cooked, add the kasuri methi and check seasoning. Adjust salt and other spices if desired.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook uncovered on high flame for a few more minutes to thicken the Methi Chicken gravy. Once the gravy thickens, turn off the heat, transfer to a serving bowl and garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve Methi Chicken Curry Recipe along with Tawa Paratha, Tomato Onion and Cucumber Raita and Jeera Rice for a weekend dinner along with your friends and family.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making Desiccated Coconut Coriander Chutney Recipe, get all the ingredients ready. Add all ingredients in a mixer jar and grind it to a fine paste with the help of a water as needed. Transfer this to a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Desiccated Coconut Coriander Chutney Recipe as a dip with Cheese Crackers Recipe for a movie evening at home.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Dhaba Style Tawa Pulao recipe, first cook the brown rice in 1-1/2 cups of water in a pressure cooker for 3 to 4 whistles. Turn off the heat and allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the pressure has released, open the cooker and allow the rice to cool completely, before adding it to the Tawa Masala. To make the Tawa Masala, heat ghee in a heavy bottomed pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the ghee is hot, add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add chopped green chillies, onions and cook them till the onions are soft and translucent. Once the onions are soft, add chopped carrot, green peas and corn.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook for about a minute or two until slightly tender. Add salt to taste, red chilli powder and pav bhaji masala. Once the vegetables are cooked, add tomatoes and cook for about a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After a minute, add the cooked brown rice and mix everything well. Cover the pan with a lid and let Dhaba Style Tawa Pulao cook for 2 to 3 minutes more. Open the lid and give the Tawa Pulao a good stir.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Once done, switch off the gas and garnish the Dhaba Style Tawa Pulao with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Dhaba Style Tawa Pulav along with Palak Raita, Tadka Raita or any other Raita of your choice, Satvik Carrot Sprout Salad and Papad for a weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making Dhaba Style Tomato Chutney Recipe, wash and wipe the tomatoes dry using a kitchen towel and then roast it over the stove top until all the sides of it are well charred. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Now, roast the garlic cloves along with the skin by fixing it in a fork over the stove. Keep aside. Likewise, roast the green chillies as well.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once, the roasted tomatoes, garlic and green chilies are cool enough, peel its outer skin gently. Now, pound the garlic cloves along with green chilies, little salt to a semi coarse paste using a pestle and mortar.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: Take it out in a bowl. Chop the roasted, de-skinned tomatoes and gently pound them using a pestle and mortar till they mash up enough to get to the chutney consistency. Take the Tomato Chutney out in the bowl.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now to the bowl of mashed tomatoes, garlic and green chillies, add the chopped coriander, mustard oil, season with salt and mix well.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Check the salt and spices and transfer the Dhaba Style Tomato Chutney to a serving bowl Make Dhaba Style Tomato Chutney on the weekend and serve it along with the Phulkas, or Parathas or Puri's and Pindi Chole for the breakfast.

ingredients.text: 300 grams Chicken drumstick - cut into small pieces

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: To begin making the Dhania Murgh Makhani Recipe, we will wash the chicken pieces thoroughly and marinate with turmeric powder, salt and lemon juice in a bowl.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat pan with oil, add sliced onions and saute until it softens, add tomatoes and saute them as well until it is thoroughly mashed. Switch off the heat once done and allow it cool down.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind the sautéed onions and tomatoes along with coriander leaves, green chilli, garlic and ginger into a fine paste by adding some water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pressure cooker with oil, add whole spice like cinnamon and cardamom pods and add a teaspoon of cumin seeds and allow it to crackle for few seconds. Add sliced onions and saute until it softens.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add chopped potatoes, chicken, ground masala paste along with all the spice powders. Check for salt. Saute for about 5 minutes until the masala is coated well. Add curd and give one last stir.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: If the water is not enough for the chicken to cook, add about 1 cup water and pressure cook it for 4 whistle until done.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Dhania Murgh Makhani along with garlic naan, steamed rice and a vegetarian subzi to go along with curry for your Sunday meal.

name: Diabetic Friendly Green Moong Dal/ Mung Beans Soup

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Green Moong Dal Soup, wash the Green moong dal and soak it in water for 4 hours or overnight. Next day, add it to pressure cooker and cook for 3 whistles.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Once done, mash it or puree with hand blender or mixer adding a cup of water. Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds. Once the cumin seeds sizzles, add asafoetida and saute for a minute.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Now pour the mashed dal along with a cup of water, required salt, slit green chilli and crushed pepper. Mix well and boil in low flame for 5 minutes. Switch off the flame and add lemon juice. Garnish with Coriander leaves.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix and serve hot. Serve Green Moong Dal Soup along Sweet Potato & Methi Stuffed Paratha Recipe & Raw Papaya, Apple & Carrot Salad Recipe for a wholesome weeknight Indian dinner.

ingredients.text: 6 Small Green brinjal (green aubergine) - slit into four

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Dum Ke Baingan Recipe, we will grind all the masala that are mentioned in the list, cardamom, cinnamon stick, black pepper powder, cloves, bay leaf, cumin seeds, dry red chillies, onion, ginger, garlic to a coarse paste by adding some water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pan with oil, add whole brinjal that are slit and saute them for 10 minutes. Sprinkle some salt over it and cook it covered so that it gets cooked faster.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the brinjal becomes soft and turns dark brown then it is cooked. You can take them out and keep it aside until you make the gravy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add little more oil in the same pan , and add the ground masala into the pan and keep cooking until the gravy is cooked. The gravy will slowly turn thick now add the roasted brinjal and drizzle lemon juice.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Combine the Dum Ke Baingan well and check for salt. Cover it and cook for at least 2 minutes and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Dum Ke Baingan Recipe along with Tawa Paratha, Kadhi Pakora, Sweet Potato & Green Bean Salad by the side to pack it for your everyday lunch box or just have it at home.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Whole Black Peppercorns - coarsely pounded

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To make Kurg Style Mushroom Curry Recipe, first cut all the ingredients and prepare it. Coconut in a mixer grinder. Add cumin, garlic, water and make a paste. Keep it aside. Heat oil in a pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add dry red chili, whole black pepper and cook it for 5 to 10 seconds. Now add onions, green chilies and cook them to become soft. After the onion becomes soft, add mushrooms and cook till it becomes soft.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add ground spices and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Now add tomatoes, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt and mix well. Now add 1/2 cup of water and cook it for 5 minutes. Turn off the gas and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Kurg Style Mushroom Curry Recipe with Kerala and Carrot Methi Pachdi Recipe for dinner.

ingredients.text: 50 grams Spinach - washed and finely chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Egg White Spinach Omelette Recipe With Garlic & Oregano, get all the ingredients ready before you begin making the omelette.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Since we are using whites from 4 eggs, this can at most serve 2 people of you plan to split the omelette into half or just about one large omelette for one person.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: If you are making this for more people, then you would need to make it in batches of similar quantity as mentioned in the above ingredient list.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Take a large bowl, add all the ingredients together and whisk well with a fork until combined. The egg whites would have blended well and turned little fluffy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Preheat an 8 inch Omelette Skillet, spoon the Nutralite Garlic & Oregano Spread in the skillet. Once the skillet is heated, pour the whisked egg white omelette mixture onto the skillet.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Turn the heat to medium low, else the omelette will brown faster at the bottom than it can get cooked on the top.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once you notice the top of the Omelette begins to get cooked (you will know when the wetness has turned to dry), using a flat spatula, flip the omelette and cook the opposite side as well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Allow it to cook for a about a minute and once cooked well on both sides as per your preference, slide the omelette to the serving platter.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Egg White Spinach Omelette Recipe With Garlic & Oregano with with slices of buttered whole wheat bread, a glass of Carrot Pineapple Orange Juice Recipe or Cantaloupe (Melon) Juice Recipe for breakfast or for an after school snack.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Fennel Potato Croquettes with Paneer recipe, we will first get all the ingredients ready. In a bowl, make a dough of the paneer by combining it with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Divide the paneer into 6 portions and shape them into ovals. In another bowl, combine the remaining ingredients except the dried bread crumbs and the oil. Combine well, so the potatoes are mashed and well combined.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Divide the potato mixture into 6 portions. Oil the palm of your hands, take a portion of the potato and flatten it on the palm. Place a portion of the paneer in the center and cover back with the potato as its cover. Seal it well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Proceed the similar way with the remaining potatoes and the paneer portions. Preheat the airfryer or your oven at 200 C and then proceed to the next steps. Next roll the potatoes on the bread crumbs and coat them well.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: If you eat eggs, then first dip the potato croquette into the egg whites then roll through the bread crumbs. Cut the aluminium foil to the size of the air fryer basket.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Grease and dust the foil with a little flour so the croquettes don’t stick while getting fried. Pinch its edges of the foil and fit into the basket in such a way that there is some opening for air circulation.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Place the croquettes on to the foil and air fry them for 12 to 15 minutes at 200 C. Half way through the process of frying, drizzle 1/8th spoon of oil over each croquette and put it back in again until golden brown.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Fennel Potato Croquettes With Paneer Recipe with Roasted Tomato Sauce, Spicy Mexican Salsa Recipe or Creamed Spinach Recipe for an evening snack.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Fenugreek & Egg Fried Rice Recipe (Anda Methi Chawal), make sure you have all the ingredients ready including some cooked rice. A day old rice works great for such quick recipes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: We will next, cook the eggs to a scramble. Heat a dollop of butter in a skillet, break the eggs into the pre heated skillet. Add some salt and black pepper and keep whisking the eggs till it forms a scramble.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Keep the scrambled eggs aside. Next, heat large wok over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and allow to crackle. Add the chopped garlic, green chili and onions. Stir-fry until the onions become soft and transparent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onions have softened, add the chopped fenugreek (methi) leaves and cook until the leaves turn soft. Add the scrambled eggs and stir to combine.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally add the cooked rice, season with salt and pepper to taste and give the rice a stir to combine it along with the methi leaves and eggs.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir fry the rice over medium high heat for few minutes, until the flavors are blended well together. Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Finally stir in the chopped coriander leaves and serve warm Serve Fenugreek & Egg Fried Rice Recipe (Anda Methi Chawal) for the dinner along with Mushroom and Bok Choy Stir Fry Recipe for a wholesome weeknight dinner or even pack them into a lunch box for kids.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Foxtail Millet Nucchina Unde recipe, wash and soak foxtail millet in a bowl for 6 to 8 hours. Wash the toor dal, chana dal, moong dal and soak it for 3 hours. Drain the water and mix the lentils and millet.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix the other ingredients along with them except onion and grind it to a coarse mixture. Add salt, onion and quickly mix it with the coarse mixture. Grease the idli plates with ghee.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Make lemon sized balls out of the coarse mixture and flatten it to resemble a malai chum chum. Steam them for 15-20 minutes until they are done.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Foxtail Millet Nucchina Unde along with Masala Chai for a healthy evening snack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Samvat rice - or vrat ke chawal
Rock Salt - or sendha namak as required

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Wash and soak samvat rice for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Fried Samvat Rice Or Barnyard Millet recipe, now heat 2-1/2 cups of water in a sauce pan and add soaked samvat rice, cubed potatoes and pinch of salt in it and cook until you feel that it is cooked properly(cook on medium heat)Heat ghee in a wok/kadhai, add cumin seeds, black pepper, cashews and saute until cumin splutters.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add tomato and green chillies cook it for about 3 to 4 minutes. Now add salt and cook it for few minutes on low heat. Now add cooked samvat rice and mix it well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now switch off the flame and add lemon juice and coriander leaves mix well. Again cover the pan and let it sit for 15 minutes. In a separate pan add little ghee and pan fry paneer cubes and cashews until golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add to the Fried Samvat rice. Serve hot. Serve Fried Samvat Rice Or Barnyard Millet along with Palak Makhana Recipe and Tadka Raita for a fasting meal or as a light dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Jowar Seeds - soaked for 9 to 10 hours
Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - a few for garnish

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: To begin making Ghoogri Recipe, firstly boil the soaked jowar in enough water till the cooker releases 8 to 9 whistles The level of the water in the cooker should be approximately 2 inches above.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: The boiled jowar should be cooked well but chewy and not mushy. Strain out the residual water and use few tablespoons of it while cooking the spices later. In a kadhai heat ghee. Add cumin seeds and allow it to crackle.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add crushed green chilies, ginger and garlic, and saute for few seconds. Add onions and saute them until they are soft and pink. Add carrot and green peas, saute for a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add few tablespoons of water from the boiled jowar, cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Once the carrots and peas are cooked add chopped capsicum, garam masala powder, sugar and mix well. Add boiled jowar and toss well.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover and cook for a couple of minutes. Lastly, add lemon juice and mix everything well. Transfer the Ghoogri into a serving plate, garnish with green coriander leaves and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Ghoogri with a hot cup of Masala Chai for breakfast.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To Begin making the Goan Kaju Curry recipe, soak the cashew nuts into hot water for minimum 30 minutes. Meanwhile proceed for making the curry/gravy.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Dry roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, peppercorns, cloves and dry red chilies until you get a roasted aroma. Add the coconut and roast it along with the spices until you can smell the aromas of the coconut.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the tamarind ball and saute for a few seconds and turn off the heat. For making the gravy, place a kadai on medium heat and add a teaspoon of oil.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the finely chopped onion and garlic and saute until the onion is translucent. Once cooled, grind the above mentioned grated coconut and spice mixture along with the onions to make a smooth paste, by adding a little water.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: In the same pan where you sauteed the onions, heat a teaspoon of oil on medium heat. Add the chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder and saute them until it softens.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the capsicum and saute for a couple of minutes until it softens and cooks through. Add the masala curry paste to the above tomato capsicum mixture and the soaked cashew nuts and stir fry for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a little water to adjust the consistency of the Kaju Curry. Stir and simmer the Goan Kaju Curry for about 10 Minutes. Once done, check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Finally stir in the chopped coriander leaves and serve. Serve this Goan Kaju Curry for parties along with Phulkas, Jeera Riceand a Salad for a weeknight dinner or a special Sunday lunch

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To make goan moolacho ros, first peel the radish and cut it into 1-1 / 2 inch long pieces. In a pressure cooker, add dal, radish, onion, 1 cup of water, mix and close the cooker. Cook till 4 city comes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix coconut, dry red chillies, coriander seeds, tamarind, turmeric powder and 1/2 cup water in a grinder jar and grind to make gravy. Open the cooker and pour this gravy in the cooker.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Take Add jaggery to it, mix and let it cook for 10 minutes on low heat. Add salt and mix. Turn off the gas after 1 minute and serve hot. Serve Goan Moolachicho Ross with rice and Kokum Kadhi for dinner.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Goan Moolyacho Ross recipe, cut the peeled radish into 1 and 1/2 inch long finger shaped pieces. Add dal, radish and chopped onion along with 1 cup water in pressure cooker and pressure cook till 4 whistles.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind grated coconut, dry red chilies, coriander seeds, tamarind and turmeric powder by adding 1/2 cup water into a thin gravy using a blender. Mix the coconut gravy with the dal in pressure cooker.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add grated jaggery and mix well. Simmer the gravy for 10 minutes. Add salt to taste, mix and serve hot. Serve Goan Moolyacho Ross along with Steamed Rice and Cauliflower Thoran for a perfect weekday meal.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Goan Sorak Curry recipe, in a mixer jar take all the ingredients mentioned under Masala to grind. Add a little water and grind to a very smooth paste. Keep it aside. Next, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once it's hot, add the ground masala and slit green chilli into it. Saute for 2 to 3 minutes on low flame. Later add water, salt to taste, jaggery and kokum.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix well and allow the curry to simmer for few mins till it starts bubbling. Switch off the gas. Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve Goan Sorak Curry along with Steamed Rice and Suran Fodi for your weekday meal.

name: Goan Style Black Chickpeas And Cucumber Masala

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas) - soaked in water

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Black Chickpeas And Cucumber Masala Recipe, we will first soak the black chickpeas in water for at least 8 hours or overnight hours.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Once soaked pressure-cook in a pressure cooker until it is cooked through and soft. Its takes about 30 minutes to cook the chickpeas and sometimes a little more time. Steam the cucumber in a steamer for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once cooked through, keep aside. Grind the ingredients meant for gravy by little water water to make a smooth paste.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Into a large sauce pan, add the ground paste, the cooked chickpeas, sugar and salt to taste and the steamed cucumber. Stir well to combine all the ingredients. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: You can also adjust the consistency of the Taushem Tondak by adding a little water to form a gravy. Bring the mixture to a brisk boil and simmer for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, turn off the heat and transfer to a serving bowl and serve warm. Serve the Black Chickpeas And Cucumber Masala (Taushem Tondak) along with steamed rice for a wholesome lunch or weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Goan Style Brinjal Bharta Recipe, clean the brinjal and make 4 to 5 slits keeping the brinjal intact. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Switch off the pan and apply this oil to the brinjal.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Once done, put the brinjal in the same pan and cover it with a lid. After 2 minutes, open the lid and turn the brinjal carefully to the other side.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once it is slightly cooked from the other side, carefully insert the marble sized tamarind ball through one slit and again cover the lid. Keep on turning the brinjal till it gets cooked on all sides.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: This might take 25 to 35 minutes. Once cooked, it will turn brown and will release water. Let the brinjal remain covered until it cools down. After cooling, peel the brinjal and discard the peel.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mash the pulp and mix it with finely chopped onions and green chillies in a bowl. Add grated coconut, tamarind paste, salt to taste and mix everything well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once done, add finely chopped coriander leaves, mix well and it is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Goan Brinjal Bharta Recipe along with Steamed Rice, Goan Moolyacho Ross and Amlechi Uddamethi Recipe for a comforting and delicious lunch.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Goan Style Chicken Galinha Cafreal Recipe, we will first grind all the ingredients given in the list to grind to a coarse paste. Add this paste into a bowl.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Rub the drumsticks nicely with paste so that the masala will seep in. Rest the chicken for atleast 1 hour. Later heat a kadai with oil, add onions and saute until it softens. Add the marinated chicken with all the extra masala.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Roast the chicken for at least 5 minutes. Add 1 cup of water and cover it with a lid and cook over a medium flame for about 20 minutes. Make sure you keep turning the chicken so that it will evenly get cooked.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: You can cook for another 10 minutes if the chicken is undone. Serve the Goan Style Chicken Galinha Cafreal Recipe along with pav, focaccia bread, or just plain phulkas or tawa parathas to enjoy your one pot meals.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Dried Green Peas (Vatana) - soaked overnight

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Goan Style Patol Bhaji Recipe, wash and soak the green peas in water overnight.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pan with oil on medium flame, add coriander seeds, dry red chilies, cinnamon, peppercorns, cloves, Star anise, fennel seeds and cumin seeds. Fry until the aroma is released for about 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped onions, ginger, garlic and sauté until the onion turn translucent. Add freshly grated coconut and sauté until the mixture turns golden brown. Switch off the heat, allow the mixture to cool down.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the sautéed mixture in a mixer jar with water to a smooth paste. Heat a pressure cooker, add the freshly ground paste, soaked legumes, turmeric powder, jaggery, tamarind water and salt and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add about 1/2 cup of water and pressure cook the Patol Bhaji for about 3 whistle. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Open the pressure cooker, transfer to a serving bowl and serve piping hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Goan Style Patol Bhaji Recipe along with sukhi bhaji and Homemade Whole Wheat Pav Recipe / Ladi Pav by the side to enjoy your morning breakfast.

ingredients.text: 2 Potatoes (Aloo) - peeled and cut into medium pieces

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Goan Style Tonak Alsanyache Recipe soak the black eyed peas in water for at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a sautéing pan with oil, add coriander seeds, dry red chillies, cinnamon, cardamom, peppercorns, cloves and cumin seeds. Fry until the aroma is released for about 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped onions, garlic, green chilies and sauté until the onion turn translucent. Add freshly grated coconut and sauté until the mixture turns golden brown. Switch off the heat, allow the mixture to rest.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the sautéed mixture in a mixer with water to a smooth paste. Heat a pressure cooker, add the ground paste, soaked legumes, turmeric powder, and salt and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add about 1/2 cup water and pressure cook the curry for about 3 whistle. Allow the pressure to release naturally and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Goan Style Tonak Alsanyache Recipe along with hot Pavs or Phulka along with a goan fish fry to enjoy your Sunday meal.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil - to grease the Idli Plates
1/2 teaspoon Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - split

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Godhumai Idli Recipe (Instant Whole Wheat Flour Idli), first get all the ingredients ready and keep aside. Heat a pan over low heat and dry roast the wheat flour till they turn fragrant.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Keep stirring continuously to roast the flour uniformly and avoid burning. Transfer the flour to a another vessel and allow it to cool.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat the pan again with ghee and add the ingredients given under ' seasoning' in the order given. Allow them to roast and crackle and set it aside. Whisk together yogurt and 1 cup of water to make a buttermilk.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add buttermilk to the flour and using a hand whisk, stir to form a batter adding more water if required to make a thick batter. Once you have a thick batter, add the tempering to the batter and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add salt ( just a little) and allow the batter to rest for 20-30 minutes. In the meantime, grease the Idli plates and preheat the steamer.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Once you are ready to steam the idlis, add 1/2 teaspoon of enos fruit salt and stir the batter. The batter will become light and fluffy. Spoon the batter into the greased plate and steam the Idlis for 15 -20 minutes until done.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, turn off the heat and allow it to rest for 5 minutes. Remove Godhumai Idli from the plates and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve these healthy Godhumai Idlis along with Tomato Onion Chutney, Thakkali Vengaya Sambar or Idli Milagai Podi for breakfast or dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon Fresh coconut - few small pieces

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Goli Baje Recipe, mix all-purpose flour, chickpea flour, rice flour, yogurt, salt and sufficient water and make a thick batter. Cover it and keep aside for fermentation for about 2 to 3 hours.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the batter is fermented add grated ginger, chopped green chillies, curry leaves, baking powder, coconut, and asafoetida to it. Mix well to combine. Heat oil in a Kadai.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Now wet your hands and take a small lemon size portion of the prepared batter and drop it into the hot oil. You can fry 4-5 goli baje at a time. Do not overcrowd the oil in kadai.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry on a medium flame until they turn golden brown in colour on all sides. Once done drain on an oil absorbent paper and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Goli Baje along with Coriander Coconut Chutney and hot Filter Coffee for the evening snack or when you have guests at home.

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons Red cabbage - chopped or sliced
2 teaspoons Fresh Thyme leaves - finely chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Green Apple, Radish & Pepper Salad first wash the vegetables well and prepare them. Remove the pith and seeds from the peppers. Slice the eyes off the tomato. Peel the white radish but not the red.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Core the apple without peeling it and dice it. Next, dice all the vegetables for the salad into small similar size pieces and place in salad bowl.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: The Broccoli florets should be cut vertically to retain its shape, but into very thin slices. Place all the chopped vegetables in a large salad bowl and refrigerate till ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: To make the Salad Dressing, first mince the Ginger and hope up the cilantro. Slit the chilli lengthwise and de-seed it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Smash the garlic along with 1/4 teaspoon of salt, with a heavy ladle or other heavy implement, to bring out the fresh flavours.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a smaller mixing bowl, pour the lemon juice, add the smashed garlic, ginger, chilli and zest and stir. Add salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: Slowly drizzle the sesame oil into the dressing, whisking continuously till the juice and oil blend and emulsify. Sprinkle in the chopped cilantro and thyme and mix. Store the dressing in the refrigerator till ready to serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Dress the salad only when ready to serve. Pour the dressing on the salad and gently mix it in with the tips of your fingers. Cover and chill till ready to serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Green Apple, Radish & Pepper Salad on a hot day and it can make a refreshing meal all on its own or you could also serve it as an accompanying side for a meal of Pasta or Pizza.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Green Coriander and Mint Chutney Recipe, combine the coriander leaves, mint leaves, curry leaves, peanuts , ginger, green chillies, sugar, lemon juice, salt to taste and grind to a smooth paste in a blender.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add very little water to blend the chutney well. The addition of lemon juice enhances the flavours of mint and coriander and prevents discoloration of the greens.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Transfer the Dhania Pudina Chutney- Green Coriander and Mint Chutney to a bowl and serve. You can refrigerate the Green Coriander and Mint Chutney for a couple of days.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Dhaniya Pudina Chutney Recipe with Samosa Recipe or make Green Chutney Aloo Chaat Recipe and enjoy with a cup of Masala Chai Recipe.

ingredients.text: Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - a small bunch finely chopped

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Green Moong Sprout Salad Recipe With Vegetables, chop and keep the vegetables ready.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients- green moong sprouts, carrots, capsicum, tomato, lemon juice, salt and coriander leaves. Toss and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve this Green Moong Sprout Salad Recipe With Vegetables along with Watermelon And Cucumber Gazpacho Recipe and Boiled Egg Mayo Sandwich Recipe for a light summer meal.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: To begin making the Hari Matar Ke Pakode Recipe - Green Pea Fritters, we will coarsely blend few of the pakora ingredients in a chopper or a mixer-grinder.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Place the coriander leaves, peas, green chilies, garlic and cumin seeds in the blender and pulse to get a coarse mixture. Transfer the ingredients to a mixing bowl, add the salt, onions and gram flour and mix well to combine.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a little water to make a thick batter - only if required - like a few tablespoons. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste. Heat a kadai with enough oil to deep fry the Hari Matar Pakoras.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot spoon the matar pakora batter into the kadai and fry them till golden brown and cris on all sides. Do not over crowd the kadai.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Once one batch of the Matar ke Pakode are done, remove from the pan and drain on an oil absorbent paper. Proceed the same way with the remaining pakora batter.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Hari Matar Ke Pakode as a evening tea time snack along with Ginger Cardamom Chai or serve as an appetizer along with Pudina Dahi Chutney Recipe- Mint Yoghurt Dip at your next party.

name: Guacamole Stuffed Quesadilla With Mint Mayo

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making Guacamole Stuffed Quesadilla With Mint Mayo Recipe, mix the dry ingredients - wheat flour, maida flour and salt for tortilla. Add enough water to bind the mixture so that it is also easy to roll. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In the meantime keep all the ingredients ready for the Guacamole, mix the avocado, tomato, onion, red bell peppers, yellow bell peppers, garlic cloves, green chilies, coriander leaves, lemon and salt to taste in a bowl and keep it aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Check for seasoning and salt. Divide the dough into small equal balls and roll it on the board to a 6 inch diameter.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Do the same with the rest of the doughHeat a flat Skillet, add a teaspoon of oil and just toast the rolled dough lightly on both the sides.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the tortilla are done, spread 1 tablespoon of Delmonte mint mayo onto the tortilla and add the freshly guacamole, spread it evenly and cover it with another layer of tortilla and toast it again on the skillet with a tablespoon of butter on either side till the tortilla becomes crispy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: After the quesadilla are toasted slice them lengthwise. Serve your yummy filled Guacamole Stuffed Quesadilla as an appetizer or for an afternoon quick meal along with Corn Pineapple Salsa Salad.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Gujarati Badshahi Pulao Recipe, wash and soak rice in 4 cups of water for half an hour. Steam the vegetables - carrots, beans, florets and peas and set aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Using the pestle and mortar, pound together the cinnamon, cloves and cardamom to a fine powder. Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a small pan on medium heat, roast the nuts and raisins and set aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Make a paste of the onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies. Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons of ghee on medium heat; add onion-ginger-garlic paste and sauté until they turn light golden brown in colour.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the pounded spice powder, bay leaves, crushed peppercorns, tomatoes, turmeric powder and sauté until the tomatoes are tender and soft. Stir in the rice along with the water it was soaked in, salt, and chopped mint leaves.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Allow the Badshahi Pulao mixture to come to a boil and then turn the heat to low. Cover the pan and simmer for approximately 30 minutes until the rice has absorbed all the water and cooked to the desired texture.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once cooked, turn off the heat and allow the Badshahi Pulao to rest for 15 minutes. Gently stir in the steamed vegetables, roasted nuts and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Badshahi Pulao with Gujarati Kadhi and Papad and Boondi Raita for your everyday meals.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Gujarati Batata Pulao Recipe, wash and soak rice and lentil in 3 cups of water for half an hour. Using the pestle and mortar, pound together the cinnamon, cloves and cardamom to a fine powder.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a small pan; add the sliced onions and sauté until tender and caramelized and keep aside. Make a paste of the ginger, garlic and green chillies in a mixer grinder and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a large soup pot or handi on medium heat; add the cumin seeds, ginger garlic paste, and sauté until the raw smell from the ginger garlic paste turns to a roasted aroma and changes color.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir in the pounded spice powder, bay leaf, potatoes, turmeric powder, sugar, coconut, salt and sauté for a few seconds. Finally stir in the soaked rice and lentils along with the water.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Allow the mixture to come to a boil and then turn the heat to low. Cover the pan and simmer for approximately 30 minutes until the rice has absorbed all the water and cooked to the desired texture.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once cooked, turn off the heat and allow the Batata Pulao Recipe to rest for 15 minutes. Stir in the caramelized onions, peas, chopped mint and serve warm.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Gujarati Batata Pulao as it is or along with a Palak Raita for a quick and easy weeknight dinner. You can also serve it with Gujarati Kadhi and a roasted papad.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Gujarati Dhokla Pizza Recipe we will first make the Khatta Dhokla. Soak rice, urad dal and chana dal all together for about 5 to 6 hours.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After six hours, add the soaked rice and dal along with curd, 1 green chilli, ginger and salt to taste into a mixer grinder and grind to a smooth batter. Ferment the batter for 8 hours to overnight.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: The curd actually helps in making the batter a little sour. After the batter has fermented, add the grated carrots, green chillies, mint leaves and mix well to combine.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Place a dhokla steamer with little water on heat to steam the Khatta Dhokla in. Spoon the batter into a greased dhokla plates and steam it on high heat for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: So while the dhokla is steaming, we will prep the toppings for the pizza. Add oil into a preheated pan; add the onions and capsicum and saute on medium heat until the onions turns soft and get’s a caramelized texture.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, turn off the heat and keep aside. Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celsius for 10 minutes. Now check if the Khatta Dhokla is cooked. You will know its done, when you put a tester like a knife and it comes out clean.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Let the dhokla cool for 5 to 10 minutes before removing from the steamer and place it on a baking tray.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.detail: Smear the dhokla with the tomato basil sauce, top it with the caramelized onions and capsicum and sprinkle some sweet corn and black olives around.

steps.title: Bake
steps.detail: Top the Dhokla with some grated cheese and bake for 8 to 10 minutes till the cheese melts. Remove the Gujarati Dhokla Pizza and cut into slices and serve immediately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Gujarati Dhokla Pizza as an appetizer for your next party along with other fusion appetizers such as Veg Noodle Pakora and Macaroni Chaat. You can also serve an Aam Pannaalong with these snacks.

name: Gujarati Kadhi With Milk And Mint

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon Fresh cream - (clotted cream) or sour cream

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: To begin making the Gujarati Kadhi With Milk And Mint recipe, in a bowl whisk together the yogurt, sour cream/clotted cream and chickpea flour. Whisk until it turns into a smooth and lump free mixture.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add a little water and mix well. Transfer this yogurt mix to a heavy bottom saucepan and place the saucepan on medium flame. Add sugar, salt, ginger, green chillies and bring the mixture to a boil.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: The chickpea flour has a tendency to settle at the bottom so keep the flame gentle and continue to stir continuously. In another small wok/kadhai prepare the tempering. Place this wok on slow flame, add ghee.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To the ghee, add cumin seeds, red chilies, cinnamon, cloves, asafoetida and curry leaves. Once the cumin seeds starts spluttering, add the tempering to the boiling kadhi. Add the mint leaves and the milk.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: After 8-9 minutes of gentle boiling turn off the flame. Just before serving add the chopped coriander. Serve Gujarati Kadhi With Milk And Mint along with Gujarati Undhiyu and Methi Thepla for a weekday lunch or dinner.

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup Yellow Moong Dal (Split) - soaked for 30 minutes
1/4 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - soaked for 30 minutes
1/4 cup Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal) - soaked for 30 minutes

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: To begin making Gujarati Trevti Dal Recipe (Creamy Lentils Cooked In Mild Spices), wash and soak the dal in water for half an hour and then pressure cook along with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles, mash and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Prep with all the other ingredients in the meanwhile. Now heat oil in a kadai on medium heat, add the cumin seeds, dried red chillies and let it crackle. Add the onion and saute until it turns translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onion is translucent, add the grated ginger and minced garlic cloves and cook until the raw smell goes away. Now add the chillies and tomatoes, saute occasionally and cook until the tomatoes turns soft and mushy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the tomatoes are mushy, add in the red chilli powder and saute for a minute. Now, add the mashed dals, about 2 cups of water, season with salt and let it simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: After 10 minutes, check for salt and adjustGarnish with lemon juice, coriander leaves, mix and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Gujarati Trevti Dal Recipe (Creamy Lentils Cooked In Mild Spices) along with Phulkas and Batata nu Shaak (Aloo Tamatar Ki Sabzi) Recipe or with Steamed Rice and Crispy Crunchy Roti Ke Papad Recipe for a comforting weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Gujarati Vagharela Mag Recipe - Moong Sprouts Sabzi, you need to have the moong sprouts ready.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Place the moong sprouts in the pressure cooker along with 2 tablespoons of water, a pinch of salt and pressure cook for 2 whistles and turn off the heat. Allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat; add the cumin seeds and allow them to crackle. Stir in the green chillies, curry leaves ginger and turmeric powder, sauté for a few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the cooked moong sprouts and stir gently to combine all the ingredients. Taste and adjust the salt to suit your taste.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir fry the Vagharela Mag for about a minute and turn off the heat, Finally squeeze the lemon juice, add the coriander leaves and give it a gentle stir.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Gujarati Vagharela Mag Recipe - Moong Sprouts Sabzi along with Tawa paratha to make a rich, wholesome and nutritious breakfast.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Gujarati Valsadi Vada Recipe take a heavy bottom pan and dry roast all the grains and dals separately on a low to medium heat till they turn light brown.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once roasted, keep it aside for coolingStart with whole wheat, next rice, then jowar, tuvar dal chana dal and finally urad dal. Grind the mix grains into a coarse Powder in a Flour Mill.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Store them in an Airtight container for increasing its shelf life. For making Gujarati Valsadi Vada, take a cup of roasted flour and add turmeric powder , asafoetida, salt, ginger, chili and yogurt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: The consistency of Valsadi Vada batter should be of thick consistency. Give it a good mix and keep aside for two hours. Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once the oil is preheated, spoon or make small rounds of the vada and slide it into the hot oil. Deep fry the alsadi Vada medium heat till crisp and browned on all sides.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Transfer the Valsadi Vada on a plate lined with kitchen towel for removing excess oil.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry the remaining batches of vadas in the same wayServe the Gujarati Valsadi Vada along with a spicy Pudina Chutney Recipe as a tea time snack along with Masala Chai.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Gur Paare Recipe in a large mixing bowl add the maida and the melted ghee. Keep mixing the flour and ghee mixture until you get coarse crumb like texture and the ghee starts to hold the flour together.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: At this point add teaspoons of water at a time and knead it to make a firm dough. Divide the dough in four parts and roll each portion of the dough into a half an inch thick round circle.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Cut them into vertical strips and then into 2-3 inch long strips. Repeat for rest of the dough portions. In a kadai, heat oil for deep frying on medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, add the cut dough strips and fry until slightly brown and crisp. Do make sure to fry on medium heat so it gets crisp evenly. Drain them on a kitchen towel and allow them to cool a bit.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In another heavy bottomed pan, add chopped or grated jaggery. On a slow flame allow it to melt, stirring continuously all the time.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook till you attain the consistency where you add a drop of jaggery into the cool water and it solidifies. At this point add the saunf and stir. Turn off the heat and immediately add the fried strips to the jaggery syrup.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix quickly using two ladles so that all the strips are evenly coated with the jaggery. Once done, the Gur Paare is ready. Transfer the Gur Paare onto a tray cool completely.

steps.title: Step 8
