steps.detail: Once completely cool separate the strips carefully taking care not to break them too much. Store them an airtight container for 15 days.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Gur Paare for festivals like Karva Chauth or any other special occasion in the family.

ingredients.text: 1/2 kg Mutton - cut into small pieces

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Halli Style Mutton Saru Recipe, thoroughly wash and clean the mutton pieces.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixer-jar combine coconut, tomatoes, coriander leaves, green chilies, red chillies, ginger, garlic, poppy seeds, roasted gram, dal salt and sambar powder. Grind this masala into a paste with some water.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Transfer to a bowl and set aside. In a pressure cooker, heat oil on medium flame, add curry leaves and allow it to crackle, then add the sliced onions and fry till it turns brown in colour.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground masala, and cook till the oil comes to the surface, now add the mutton piecesAnd mix well, add 1 ½ cups of water and close the pressure cooker. Pressure cook for 4-5 whistles and turn off the flame.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Halli Style Mutton Saru along with Soft & Delicious Ragi Mudde Recipe - Karnataka Style Ragi Balls or Steamed Rice Recipe (Pressure Cooker & Sauce Pan Methods) or Homemade Crisp Ghee Roast Dosa Recipe for a complete meal.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Barnyard Millet - cooked (you can use either bajra or foxtail or any other local millet)

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: To begin making the Hara Bhara Kebab Recipe with Millets, we will first make sure we have all the ingredients needed to make these kebabs ready. This includes the boiled and mashed potatoes, paneer and the cooked millets.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Note that different types of millets have varied cooking times. So take your time to cook them and have the millets ready with a grainy texture. Our next step is to process the first set of ingredients in a Food Processor.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the green peas, mint, ginger and green chilli into the processor and blend to get a coarse paste. Transfer this to a large mixing bowl, add the remaining ingredients into the bowl, except the oil.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix well to combine all the ingredients. Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste. Once combined well, shape the kebabs into circular discs and keep them aside. The next step is to cook the kebabs.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Grease and preheat a pan on medium-high heat. Place the shaped Hara Bhara Kebabs with Millet onto the pan. Drizzle a bit of oil over each kebab and cook until the kebabs are evenly browned on both sides.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Hara Bhara Kebabs with Millet along with Green Chutney with a cup of Masala Chai. for an evening snack.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Hariyali Egg Curry recipe, we will first make the Hariyali Masala. Into the Mixer Grinder (medium jar), add the Coriander leaves mint leaves, Green Chillies and 1/2 cup water.

steps.title: Blend
steps.detail: Blend all of them together to make a smooth paste and keep aside. Into the small jar of the mixer grinder, add the onions, ginger and garlic and grind to make a paste.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a kadai over medium heat, add the Bay leaf (tej patta), Cloves, Cinnamon Stick and roast for a few seconds. Add the Onion ginger garlic paste. Saute for 4 to 5 minutes until raw onion smell goes away.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once the onions are roasted, add garam masala powder, coriander powder and saute for a few seconds. Add the Hariyali Coriander Mint Mixture, the fresh cream and the 4 Boiled eggs.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add water if required to adjust the consistency of the Hariyali Egg Curry. Cover & simmer the Hariyali Egg Curry for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Check the salt and spices and adjust to according to your taste and transfer the Hariyali Egg Curry into a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Hariyali Egg Curry along with Malabar Parotta or Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha and Burani Raita for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - cut into small cubes

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: To begin making the Hariyali Matar Recipe, peal the green peas, wash and steam it using a steamer and keep aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Make a fine paste of the ingredients listed in the green masala, coriander leaves, green chillies, garlic, ginger and lemon juice, using a mixer grinder adding very little water and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a wide pan, add the asafoetida, cumin seeds and let the cumin seeds splutter. Add the ground green masala and saute for 2 minutes until the masala is well cooked and comes together.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the steamed green peas, season with salt, add 1 cup water, give it a stir and let it simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Once the gravy has thickened, add the paneer cubes and mix well.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Let the mixture simmer for another 2 minutes and switch off the flame. Remove into a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Hariyali Matar Recipe along with Tawa Parathas and Gajar Shimla Mirch Sambharo for the weeknight dinner or pack away for your lunch box.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To begin making the Hariyali Mutton Curry recipe, clean/rinse mutton pieces. Add 1 teaspoon salt and pressure cook in 1/2 cup water for about 3 whistles.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind all the ingredients mentioned under ‘for green masala’ together with a little water. Heat oil in a pan. Add onion paste and saute until raw smell of the onions goes off.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates from the sides of the pan. Add green masala paste and cook for 5 minutes. Add cooked mutton pieces and mix well. Add salt to taste and little water if required.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.detail: Simmer and cook covered for 10 to 15 minutes. Whisk cream and add it to the curry. Serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Hariyali Mutton Curry along with Pudina Lahsun Lachha Paratha, Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita and Steamed Rice for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 250 grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - cut into an inch lengthwise

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Hariyali Paneer Tikka Masala Gravy ,coarsely grind the fennel seeds, coriander, mint, ginger and green chillies in a blender along with some water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat butter in a pan, add spices - cinnamon, bay leaf, and cardamon pods and then the tomato puree. Cook until the raw smell of the tomato goes away.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground green masala ingredients, and the garam masala and chaat masala, saute the masala for a few minutes on low heat. Cover the pan and allow the hariyali masala gravy to cook through.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: This will take about 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, stir in the cream and paneer. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste. Simmer for 3 more minutes so the paneer absorbs the flavors of the masala.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, turn of the heat and serve. Serve your exotic Hariyali Paneer Tikka Masala Gravy with Phulka or Garlic Naan and Boondi Raita Recipe Spiced With Black Salt

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Healthy Maravalli Kizhangu Bonda Recipe - Spicy Tapioca Fritters, wash tapioca to remove mud. Peel off the outer skin and wash them again. Cut tapioca into small pieces.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind chopped tapioca with green chilies and ginger in a mixer grinder to smooth paste. Do not add water. Transfer the paste to a bowl. Add finely chopped onion, asafoetida, coriander leaves, salt, besan and rice flour.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Combine all the ingredients together and check the taste. Make small balls of the bonda mixture. Heat paniyaram pan and add a few drops of oil in each cavity.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Place the Maravalli Kizhangu Bonda balls into the cavities and pan fry them evenly until browned and crisp on both sides. Cook on medium heat to make sure the tapioca root cooks well from the inside.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: For each batch, it took 10 mins to cook on low heat. Once done, remove the Maravalli Kizhangu Bonda from the pan and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Maravalli Kizhangu Bonda as a delicious tea time snack along with Coconut Chutney or Green Chutney and South Indian Filter Coffee.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Healthy No Cream Tomato Carrot Onion Soup recipe, firstly heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan. Once the oil is hot, add chopped garlic and saute it for about 20 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After 20 seconds, add chopped onions and cook them till they become soft and translucent. Once the onions are cooked, add the thinly sliced carrots. Add the required salt, mix it well and cover the pan for about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: We have to cook carrots only half. Once the carrots are partially cooked, add chopped tomatoes and season it with crushed black pepper. Mix it well and let it cook for about a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: After a minute, add some water and cover it with the lid again. Cook till the tomatoes are fully cooked and mushy. Switch off the gas and let the mixture come to room temperature.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Once it comes to room temperature, strain the mixture and keep the water aside. Grind the mixture to form a puree. Now, add the water in the puree and add it to the wok again. Switch on the gas and let it cook for about a minute.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add some more salt, little bit sugar if you feel tomato is too sour. Let it cook for about 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: After 3 to 4 minutes, switch off the gas and serve. (If you want it more thin you can strain ready soup again, discard the waste and cook strained part for one more minute)Serve Healthy No Cream Tomato Carrot Onion Soup along with Garlic Bread and Bean Sprout & Corn Salad for your healthy weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: 2 cups Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - thinly sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Healthy Vegetable Paratha Rolls Recipe, make sure you have freshly made hot tawa parathas ready.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: You can also make them once you have finished making the filling for the roll Heat a teaspoon of oil in a heavy bottomed pan on medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the onions, garlic, ginger, carrots and peas sprinkle some salt and stir fry on medium heat until the carrots is cooked.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: In meantime pressure cook the peeled potatoes for about 4 whistle and release the pressure naturally and mash it completely.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: When vegetables are almost done, add in the chopped cabbage, tomato and bell peppers and stir fry it until the cabbage is almost softened.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir in the spices powders and boiled and mashed potato into the kadai and check the spice levels and adjust to suit your taste. The next step is to make the wrap.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Place a the cooked flat bread or the tawa whole wheat paratha for the wrap on a working surface. Arrange a small portion of the roasted vegetables towards the center of the paratha.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.detail: Fold the two opposite ends of the flat paratha over the filling. Start rolling the paratha from one open end over the two folded sides. Roll the entire paratha tightly and wrap a foil or butter paper around it.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.detail: There are many different ways to roll a wrap, you can search on the internet and find your preferred way of wrapping.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the delicious Healthy Vegetable Paratha Rolls for the kids lunch box or as a travel snack or just a weeknight dinner along with Chickoo Banana Date Smoothie Recipe

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Himachal Style Panchkuti Khichdi Recipe, soak the dal and millet in water for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Pressure cook the dals along with millet in about 3 cups of water, add turmeric powder and salt as well and cook for about 5 whistle. If there is more liquid, it is fine you can keep the khichdi a little wet.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat another tempering pan, add ghee, and slowly add cumin seeds and mustard seeds allow it to splutter for few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in the remaining ingredients and fry the spice in oil for 10 seconds and pour it over the khichdi and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Himachal Style Panchkuti Khichdi Recipe along with Gujarati kadhi or Palak Raita Recipe (Spinach Yogurt Salad) for your morning breakfast.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Homemade Healthy Sour Cream Recipe, we will first make the hung curd To make 1 cup hung curd, we will require, 800 grams of regular dahi/curd.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Place a muslin cloth over a large strainer and place this strainer over a deep dish. Pour the curd into the strainer on which the muslin cloth is spread. Let this sit overnight in the fridge.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Next morning, discard the water collected in the deep dish, you will see the thick hung curd in the strainer. In a mixing bowl, combine the hung yogurt along with fresh cream salt and lemon juice.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.detail: Whisk well, ensuring the sour cream is turning into a nice smooth texture. Serve chilled.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Homemade Healthy Sour Cream Recipe over Veggie Loaded Nachos Recipe, or along with some appetizers like Peri Peri Fish Fingers or Tandoori Potato Wedges.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the whole wheat crepe recipe, first blend all the ingredients together in a blender until smooth. Then strain the crepe mixture through a fine mesh sieve.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Pouring the mix into a tall jug makes it easier to portion out the batter when making crepes on a hot pan. Allow the crepe batter to rest at room temperature for about 15 to 20 minutes. This makes the crepes soft and fluffy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the crepes, warm a crepe pan with a rim on a medium heat. Butter or oil it evenly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: When the pan gets hot, pour just enough batter to cover the base, and start tilting and swirling the pan to spread the batter and make a thin film on the surface of the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: This film should be as thin as possible, and if there is excess batter pour it back into the jug. Once you make a couple of crepes, you will understand how much batter your need to pour for a single crepe.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: You could also use a measuring cup to pour the batter, so that way the subsequent times you will get it just right.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: These crepes gets cooked really quick and you need to cook it just until the bottom begins to get a little golden, then gently lift the edges and flip the crepe to cook on the other side for a few seconds.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Transfer the prepared whole wheat crepes to a platter and cover with a dome lid to keep warm and soft. Proceed the same way with the remaining batter and stack the crepes one on top of the other. Serve the crepes as desired.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.detail: They can be used as the base for several sweet and savoury varieties of crepes and make excellent breakfast as well as brunch options.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Horse Gram Dal (Kollu/ Kulith) - soaked for at least 4-5 hours or overnight

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin, pressure cook the soaked horse-gram for two whistles over medium heat, along with the chopped onion, tomato and potato. Turn off the heat after two whistles and let the steam release naturally from the pressure cooker.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Meanwhile, in a mixer grind all the curry ingredients to make the smooth paste using little water. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Open the lid of the pressure cooker, add the curry masala, close the lid once again and pressure cook the horse-gram for two more whistles.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Open the pressure cooker, add the tamarind extract and salt to taste, and let the curry simmer for few minutes till all the flavours are combined well. For the tempering, in a tadka pan heat the ghee over medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the mustard seeds and onions and sauté gently on a low heat till the onions become golden in colour. Next add the curry leaves, asafoetida and red chillies. When it all sputter, pour it over the curry and stir to combine.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Hurali Saaru with steamed rice or Phulka for the wholesome lunch.

ingredients.text: 2 cups Basmati rice - soaked for 30 minutes

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Hyderabadi Style Kuska, heat a pressure cooker with oil, add fennel seeds, maze, star anise, stone flower and leave it for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the sliced onions, ginger and garlic and fry the onions till they turn light brown. Add the tomatoes and little salt so that the tomatoes get cooked and become mushy.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the tomatoes are cooked add the herbs and give it a stir. Add the turmeric powder and biryani masala powder. Sauté until the masala is fried and coated well with onions and tomatoes. Add the curd and give it a stir.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the soaked rice and 4 cups of water. Check for salt and close the cooker and cook for 2 whistle. Allow the pressure to release by itself and open the lid, give it a stir lightly and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Hyderabadi Style Kuska with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita or Hyderabadi Bagara Baingan Recipe to enjoy your Sunday lunch.

ingredients.text: 500 grams Boneless chicken - cut into cubes
1/2 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - soaked for 30 mins

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making Hyderabadi Chicken Shikampuri Kebab Recipe, firstly heat 1-2 cups of water in a pan and add chicken pieces, chana dal, crushed cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves, black pepper, shahi jeera, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, chopped ginger and garlic.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cover the lid and cook till the chicken is done and the dal is soft cooked. Discard excess water since more water will ruin it. Allow to cool and grind everything together to make a fine paste.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add egg, chopped mint and coriander into the mixture and mix well. Keep aside. Meanwhile, take a bowl and prepare the filling by mixing the hung curd with finely minced onion, salt, green chili and coriander powder.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Pinch a lemon size ball of the kebab paste and flatten it between your palms like a disc. Place a small filling of the hung curd and cover up the filling.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Cover from all sides nicely and again flatten it to shape a disc and place on a tray lined with parchment paper. Heat a skillet or shallow frying pan with a little oil.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Once the oil is hot, fry in hot oil till browned on a medium heat and flip to brown evenly on the other side too. Transfer the kebabs once shallow fried, on a kitchen napkin to soak excess oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Hyderabadi Chicken Shikampuri Kebab Recipe along with dips like Dhaniya Pudina Chutney Recipe (Green Chutney) and other appetizers like Tawa Crispy Pomfret Fry Recipe for your house parties.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Indian Chicken Keema Sliders Recipe, firstly roast all the masalas including cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, black pepper corns, coriander seeds, star anise and Kashmiri dry red chillies at low heat in a flat pan till fragrant.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Set it aside. Once cool, powder them or pound in a pestle and mortar. Heat the oil in a pan on medium-high flame. Once the oil is hot and simmering, add the onion, ginger, garlic and green chillies.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Keep and eye on it and keep sautéing for about 15-20 minutes till the onions moisture and start to turn brown. Reduce the flame to low, add the ground spices. Saute for 20 seconds and add in the onions.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped tomatoes with their water and keep cooking till the tomatoes soften and turn mushy. If the mixture is burning, add a splash of water. This should take another 10 minutes. Add yogurt in 3 batches.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mixing well every time you add the yogurt. Cook for about 2 minutes. Next add in the chicken keema and with your ladle break any clumps and mix well. Do this step quickly before the chicken starts to cook to avoid lumps.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add water if required, cook the chicken in the spices for about 10-15 minutes till the curry starts to simmer. Once it simmers (bubbles on the surface) cook for another 5 minutes to ensure its done.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Finish with juice of one whole Lemon and Coriander Leaves. Toast the slider buns with little bit of butter. Scoop the chicken keema inside and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Indian Chicken Keema Sliders along with other starter such as Paneer Tikka and a chilled glass of your favourite Mocktail for house parties.

ingredients.text: 100 grams Carrot (Gajjar) - diced into 1/2 centimetre cubes
100 grams Green beans (French Beans) - chopped similarly

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Instant Mixed Vegetable Pickle recipe, clean and dry all the vegetables on a kitchen towel.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: Chop them finely and tip them into a mixing bowl and add the juice of one lemon and a teaspoon of salt and mixed through the vegetables.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a small mixing jar, add the ingredients for the marinating paste and grind to a smooth paste in a grinder without adding any water. Mix this paste through the vegetables and let it sit for at least 2 hours before serving.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: It stays fresh for a week to a fortnight and needs to be kept in the fridge at all times. Serve Instant Mixed Vegetable Pickle with curd rice for a comforting week day meal.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: To begin making the Instant Oats Rava Idli Recipe, we will first prepare the tempering/tadka that will be added to the Oats Rava Idli. Heat oil in a skillet on medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add mustard seeds and as they begin to splutter, add chana dal and roast the dal until it turns golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the dal has turned golden brown, add chopped green chilies, curry leaves and asafoetida and saute for a few seconds. Turn off the flame and set aside to cool.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: In another pan, on medium flame dry roast the oats until you get the roasted aroma and it slightly changes in color. Once roasted, allow it to cool and blend to a make a powder and keep it aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a large mixing bowl, add the oats powder and roasted rava, roasted seasoning ingredients, grated carrots and chopped coriander leaves. Mix well. Add yogurt, salt and little water at a time to make it to a thick batter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: The consistency of the oats idli batter should be slightly loose than a idli batter. Set it aside for 10-15 mins. The batter will thicken while it rests. After the resting period, add the enos fruit salt and mix again.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Preheat an idli steamer with water. Grease idli plates with oil and pour the batter into each cavity of the idli plate. Place the Oats Rava Idli into the steamer and steam for 10-15 minutes until cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Instant Oats Rava Idli Recipe along with some Tomato Onion Chutney or Vengayam Sambar for a weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: To begin making the Iranian Baida Curry Recipe, boil the whole egg in water, make sure the eggs are fully immersed.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Boil them for at least 15 minutes until the eggs are completely cooked and keep them aside to de shell them once it cools down.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Dry roast the ingredients mentioned in the list to grind on to a pan, once done cool it down and grind it into a smooth paste by adding little water. Heat a kadai with oil, add onions and saute them until it turns golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the ground masala paste. Saute for 10 minutes. Add 1 cup of water along with jaggery and bring it to a boil. Check for salt and adjust according to your palate.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Finally, de-shell the eggs, cut them into half and drop them into the boiling curry. Boil the curry for 2 more minutes and switch it off. Serve by garnishing it with some coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Iranian Baida Curry Recipe along with Garlic naan, Chapathi and some steamed rice along with Moong Sprouts Salad with Grated Carrots and Coriander.

steps.title: Bake
steps.detail: To begin making the Iyengar Bakery Khara Biscuit recipe, firstly pulse sugar in a mixer. Sift together flour and salt. Cream together butter and sugar till the sugar dissolves. Add in 1-1/2 tablespoon curd and continue beating.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in the swift flour, chopped chillies, coriander leaves and curry leaves. Mix gently using your fingertips or spoon. You will observe that the dough is crumbly in texture.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: In that case add the remaining 1 to 2 tablespoons curd and gently knead it and make a non-sticky dough. Allow the dough to sit for 10 to 15 minutes. Cover the dough and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Meanwhile preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 160 deg. After 15 minutes, take a big ball of the dough and using a rolling pin roll to make a smooth medium thick chapati.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Now take a cookie cutter or a circular lid, dip into dry flour and cut into small biscuits. Spread a butter paper on the baking sheet and arrange biscuits over it. Using a fork, prick the cookies to make wholes.

steps.title: Bake
steps.detail: Bake them at 180 c or 350 F for 10 minutes. After 10 mins, take out the cookies, set the temperature of the oven to 170 C or 325 F and bake for another 8 to 10 mins or till the cookies become golden brown.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Baking at lower temperature makes the cookies crispy. Remove the cookies from the oven, allow it to cool completely. Store them in air tight containers and relish.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Iyengar Bakery Khara Biscuit along with Masala Chai and Masala Mixed Sprouts Sandwich during your tea time break.

name: Iyengar Style Whole Wheat & Oats Khara Biscuit

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon Whole Black Pepper Corns - coarsely pounded

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: We begin making the Iyengar Style Whole Wheat and Oats Khara Biscuit Recipe (Savory Cookie Recipe) by pre heating the oven to 180 degree Celsius for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix all the ingredients for the iyengar biscuits into a bowl till it binds. You can also use a food processor to combine all the ingredient.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Shape the Iyengar Biscuits into round and flat shaped cookies, place them on a baking sheet/ tray and bake them in the oven for about 30 minutes till you see a golden crust and it is crisp.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once done, take them out of the oven and allow the cookies to rest on a wire rack for at least 15 minutes until it cools down completely.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: The iyengar biscuits will continue to cook and get crisp white it is resting on the wire rack and hence it is important to do this process.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, store these Whole Wheat and Oats Khara Biscuit in air tight containers and serve them as and when you like to have it.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Iyengar Style Whole Wheat and Oats Khara Biscuit Recipe along with Corn Matar Kachori Recipe so that you can indulge in a some tea time snack during the evening.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making Jeera Miri Kolambi Recipe (Cumin & Black Pepper Prawns), grind all the ingredients for the spice paste including ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, dry red chillies, whole black peppercorns, salt, malt vinegar with about 2 tablespoons water.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Make a smooth spice paste. Marinade the prawns with the paste and add some salt. Keep aside. Heat the oil in a kadai. On a medium high heat, add the curry leaves and the onions. Stir occasionally.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: When the onions are caramelised, add the tomato paste or chopped tomato. Cook on medium heat till the tomatoes are mushy and the onions and tomatoes have come together.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the prawns along with all the spice paste they were marinaded in.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add about 1/4 cup of water and cook on high heat till the prawns are done and all the water has evaporated. (If you want, you can add more water and you can make a gravy dish from the same prawns as well.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Jeera Miri Kolambi Recipe (Cumin & Black Pepper Prawns) with some Coconut Rice and Raw Mango Raita Recipe or along with Green Chutney as a party appetizer served with Cucumbertini Recipe for cocktail party.

ingredients.text: 2 cups Rice - washed and soaked for 30 minutes
1/2 cup Cauliflower (gobi) - cut into small florets
1 Potato (Aloo) - skin peeled and chopped small
4 Whole Wheat Brown Bread - cut into cubes

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Jodhpuri Kabuli Recipe, first keep the rice in a pressure cooker with ghee, cloves and lemon juice. Add about 4 cups of water and pressure cook for 2 whistle.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: In the meanwhile, heat a kadai with 2 tablespoon ghee, add bread cubes and toast them till they are light brown and toasty. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Into the same kadai add some more ghee and toast the cashew nuts and raisins and keep them aside. Add little more and all the whole spice and allow it sizzle for few seconds. Add onions and saute till they turn translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add cauliflower, potato and sprinkle with little salt and turmeric. Allow it to cook for few minutes. You can sprinkle with water and cover it with the lid and cook for at least 10 minutes until done.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add all the spice powders along with curd and keep stirring till the water evaporates from the curd. Once that is done add green peas and toasted bread cubes and give it a stir. Add cooked rice as well.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Give a stir and check for salt. Switch off the heat, serve it in a bowl and sprinkle with toasted cashew nuts, raisins and pomegranates on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Jodhpuri Kabuli Recipe along with raita by the side and Dill Poha Cutlets to begin with for your Sunday lunch.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Methi Leaves (Fenugreek Leaves) - finely chopped

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making the Juvar Jo Dodo Recipe, we will first make the dough. In a mixing bowl, combine the onion, methi leaves, coriander leaves, salt, green chilli, finely chopped and mix well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: To this, add the jowar flour and cooking oil and mix until well combined. Use just enough water to make a stiff dough. Add a few drops of oil and smoothen out the dough. Cover and set aside. Heat a tawa on medium high flame.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Divide the dough into equal portions. Use a wet thin napkin or parchment paper greased with oil and grease your fingers with oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Take a dough ball and begin flattening it on the greased sheets or wet napkin, using your fingers and palms. We are looking for approximately 4 inch diameter dodo, of medium thickness.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Carefully over turn the sheet or napkin on the tawa, in a way that the flattened dough is on the surface of the tawa and the sheet is over that. Now carefully, remove the sheet, ensuring the dodo is placed without breaking.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Slather some ghee and cook on both sides on medium flame. We need it to cook in a way that we get lovely brown spots. Repeat the same for the other portions of the dodo dough and cook in the same manner.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Juvar Jo Dodo hot on a platter. Serve Jowar Jo Dodo along with Panchmel Dal Recipe, Bharva Baingan Masala Recipe ,Carrot Beet Amaranth Super Salad Recipe, Aam Ka Achaar Recipe for a simple weekday lunch.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Jowar Jo Dodo along with Sindhi Tridali Dal Recipe, and Aam Ka Achaar Recipe - North Indian Spicy Raw Mango Pickle for a simple weekday lunch.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: To prepare Kaanole Recipe (Maharashtrian Steamed Wheat Flour Sweet), in a bowl take grated Jaggery and add some warm water to it to dissolve the Jaggery. Stir well. Filter the jaggery dissolved water for impurities if any.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Take wheat flour in a another bowl, add suji and a pinch of salt and oil to the flour and using this Jaggery water, knead into a soft dough. Add more water if needed while kneading the dough.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Cover the dough and keep aside for 10-15 minutes. Pinch a small portion of the dough and make a ball shape. Roll it out using a rolling pin to a circular shape by applying few drops of oil on the rolling board.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Now apply oil and fold it to half , again apply some oil and then fold one more time to form a triangle or cone shape.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Make all the Kaanole in similar way and keep them in a greased container and cook in a pressure cooker for 3 whistles, oe steam them in an idli steamer for 20 minutes or till done.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Kaanole Recipe (Maharashtrian Steamed Wheat Flour Sweet) with either green chilli pickle or along with Appe Payasa.

name: Kabuli Chana Chaat - High Protein Snack of Chikki Chaat

ingredients.text: 2 cups Kabuli Chana (White Chickpeas) - soaked for 8 hours

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making Kabuli Chana Chaat Recipe, soak the chickpeas for 8 hours. Pressure cook the chickpeas along with a little salt for about 25 to 30 minutes and keep aside.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Boil the potatoes in the pressure cooker and cook until soft. Once done, peel and chop the potatoes. Allow it to cool completely. In a Salad Mixing Bowl, add boiled and cooled chickpeas.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Make sure that the chickpeas are drained and no additional water is present. Add chopped onion, tomato, boiled potatoes, and cucumber to it.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: Season the Chana Chaat with chopped green chilies, freshly chopped coriander leaves, chaat masala, dry mango power and lemon juice. Add salt to taste. Finally toss the Kabuli Chana Chaat well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Adjust the salt and chaat masala to suit your taste. You can make the Kabuli Chana Chaat spicier by adding more chopped green chilies. Add Namkeen or Aloo bhujia on top and the delicious Kabuli Chana Chaat is ready to be served.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Chana Chaat as a team time snack or as a party appetizer along with Spinach Paneer Kofta Curry, Garlic Naan and Cauliflower & Cucumber Raita

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Cauliflower (gobi) - broken into small florets
1/4 cup Green beans (French Beans) - cut into one-inch pieces
1/4 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - cut into inch long pieces

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making Kaigari Pirattal (Chettinad Style Mixed Vegetables) Recipe, heat a wok in medium flame and pour oil in it. Now, put the mustard seeds, curry leaves and let it splutter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now, add all the cut vegetables into the tempering and give it a stir. Sprinkle some water over it and cook with the lid on for five more minutes. Keep stirring in between till the vegetables are fully cooked.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Now make a coarse mixture of grated coconut, red chilies, cumin and fennel seeds using a mixer grinder. Add this spice mix to the vegetables, season with salt, and give it a good stir and switch off the flame.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve this Kaigari Pirattal (Chettinad Style Mixed Vegetables) with steamed rice and spicy Manathakkali Kai Vathal Kuzhambu.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Kala Chana Salad With Grated Carrot, Cucumber & Tomatoes Recipe, we will soak the black chickpeas in water overnight. This will make the chana edible and soft.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Pressure cook the kala chana in the pressure cooker along with a little salt, for about 20 minutes until it is cooked through. Ensure you cook on medium heat, so the kala chana get cooked well.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Once done allow the pressure to release naturally. Drain the excess water from the pressure cooker. You can use this water to cook a rice, or even make a soup. The final step to put the Indian Salad together.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Cut all the vegetables as suggested above. In a large mixing bowl, add the cooked kala chana, the grated carrots, chopped cucumber, chopped tomatoes, green chillies, salt, coriander leaves and juice from one lemon.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir well to combine the Kala Chana Salad recipe. Check the salt and spices and adjust accordingly and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kala Chana Salad with Grated Carrot, Cucumber & Tomatoes Recipe along with Palak Mushroom Makhani, Punjabi Kadhi and Jeera Rice (Pulao) for a Indian lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: We begin making the Karnataka Style Seke Undlaka/ Undlige Recipe (Mini steamed sweet dumplings Recipe) by boiling water over a sauce. About 1/2 cup. Once it comes to a boil, add the rice flour with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Then keep mixing till it combines. Once done switch it off, and by using ghee start making small dumpling when it is hot itself. Heat an idli or dhokla steamer and stream these dumplings for about 10 minutes. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a pan, add the jaggery, coconut and cardamom. Leave the jaggery to melt and combine. Add these steamed dumplings and coat it nicely with this sweet mixture.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karnataka Style Seke Undlaka/ Undlige Recipe (Mini steamed sweet dumplings Recipe) after a nice meal of Mavinakayi Chitranna Recipe (Spiced Raw Mango Tempered Rice) or Avalakki Bisi Bele Bhat Recipe.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Avarekalu / Lilva Beans - pressure cooked
1/4 cup Yellow Moong Dal (Split) - soaked in water for 30 minutes

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin preparing Karnataka Style Avarekalu Kosambari Recipe, soak the moong dal in water for at least 30 minutes and keep it ready.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Pressure cook the avarekalu beans along with 1/2 a cup water in the cooker, sprinkle with salt and just cook for 1 whistle. Allow the pressure to release naturally and drain the water out.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl, add carrots, boiled avarekalu, sweet corn, freshly grated coconut, coriander leaves, salt and lemon juice into the same bowl and mix it well. The next step is tempering.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: For tempering, heat the oil in a tadka pan on medium flame and add mustard seeds. Once it crackles, add asafoetida and curry leaves and let it crisp up. Add it to the kosambari and mix everything well and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karnataka Style Avarekalu Kosambari Recipe along with chitranna Recipe , Cabbage Onion Vada Recipe and Paal Payasam Recipe to make it a complete meal.

ingredients.text: 4 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - finely chopped for garnish

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making Avarekalu Sagu Recipe, wash and pressure cook the hyacinth beans or avare and potato cubes with one cup water, salt for 2 to 3 whistles using a pressure cooker and keep aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Allow the pressure to release naturally. The next step is to make the sagu masala. Into the mixer grinder, add the Roasted chana dal, garlic, green chillies, poppy seeds, coriander seeds, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods and cloves.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add 1/4 cup of water and blend to make a smooth sagu masala paste. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, add the mustard seeds and let it splutter. Add the curry leaves and saute for a few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped onion and saute until it turns translucent. Add the tomatoes and cook until it turns soft and mushy. Now, add the ground sagu masala paste, saute till the raw smell goes away.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: This will take about 2 to 3 minutes over medium heat. Add the cooked hyacinth beans/ Avarekalu and potato, season with salt, add 2 cups of water, mix well.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.detail: Let the Avarekalu Sagu simmer for 10 minutes, so it all comes together as a thick sagu consistency. Turn off the heat, squeeze the juice of half a lemon and garnish with coriander leaves and stir.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Give this delicious Avarekalu Sagu Recipe a try and serve it along with hot Malabar Parotta or Puri Recipe - Learn to Make Soft Puffed Puris At Home for breakfast.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: We begin making the Karnataka Style Badnekayi Mosaru Gojju Recipe by roasting the eggplant. Try to poke the eggplant on all the sides. Roast them on your stove directly or you can slowly roast them on a griddle as well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Keep turning them evenly and add a tablespoon of oil. Roast them until the eggplant becomes soft and the skin starts to peel off slowly. Take it out and rest it for coupe of minutes.

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: Then peel off the skin and chop the flesh and mash it coarsely. Mix it with curd, green chilli and salt. Adjust the consistency by adding water if necessary.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: Now to make the tadka, heat a kadai with oil and then add in the mustard seeds, urad dal, channa dal, hing and dry red chilli, crackle the curry leaves. Pour it over the Gojju and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karnataka Style Badnekayi Mosaru Gojju Recipe along with some steamed rice,Palak Tovve or Palak Dal Recipe (Spinach and Lentil Curry) and Gorikayi Palya Recipe to complete a meal.

ingredients.text: 1 Banana Stem - skin peeled and cut into small pieces

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin preparing the Baledindina Kosambari Recipe soak the dal for an hour and then drain the water. Finely chop the vegetables and add it to the dal in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add freshly grated coconut, coriander leaves, salt and lemon juice and mix it well. The next step is tempering. For tempering, heat the oil in a pan and add mustard seeds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once it crackles, add asafoetida and curry leaves and let it crisp up. Add it to the kosambari and mix everything properly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karnataka Style Baledindina Kosambari Recipe along with Chitranna or steamed rice and Karnataka Style Sorakkai Palya Recipe.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Karnataka Style Chicken Saaru Recipe, we will first make the masala for the saaru. Heat a small skillet on medium-low flame, add the poppy seeds and dry roast them.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once the poppy seeds are roasted, add in the cloves, cinnamon and dry red chilli and roast them well. Turn off the flame and keep it aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat another pan on medium flame, add a tablespoon of oil, add ginger, garlic, onions and saute until the onions turn translucent. Add grated coconut and saute well till they turn light brown. Turn off the flame.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixer-jar, combine the dry roasted spices along with ginger-garlic-onion mixture, grind to a smooth paste along with some water. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat, add the chicken, turmeric powder,salt and red chilli powder.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Roast the chicken in the pan for about 5 minutes until the chicken begins to get a roasted texture and is getting partially cooked.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: After 5 minutes of roasting the chicken, add the ground saaru masala (onion coconut & spices paste) and give it a stir.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Check for salt and add 1 cup of water and pressure cook for about 3 to 4 whistles until the chicken is cooked and turn off the heat. Allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Open the cooker and check for spices and salt and adjust accordingly. Serve the Karnataka Style Chicken Saaru Recipe along with Ragi Mudde, Akki Roti or Jolada Rotti to enjoy it for your lunch.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Karnataka Style Gasagase Payasa, roast the poppy seeds and rice in a skillet on low-medium heat until it turns into a nice golden brown. This will take about 4-6 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Turn off the flame and allow it to cool. Transfer into a mixer jar. and grind it into a coarse mixture, add grated coconut and water and grind again to a smooth mixture.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a sauce pan with milk on medium flame, add the ground poppy seeds and coconut mixture, cardamom pods, jaggery and bring it to a boil. Boil the payasam till it thickens.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a tadka pan, on low flame and fry the cashew nuts and raisins for 2 minutes. Turn off the flame and pour it over the payasam and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Gasagase Payasa after having a Spicy Mixed Vegetable Pulao Recipe with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita to cool down your palate with a sweet note.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To begin making Karnataka Style Mixed Vegetable Pulao Recipe, first get all the ingredients ready.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind the ingredients mentioned in "For pulao masala" including fresh coconut, pearl onions, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, coriander leaves, tomato, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom and green chillies to a fine paste using a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: You can a little warm water to make it into a smooth paste. Steam the vegetables using a steamer and keep aside. Cook Basmati rice in 3-1-/2 cups of water in a sauce pan, along with salt and bring it to a brisk boil.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Once it comes to a boil, turn the heat to low, cover the pan and cook the rice until all the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and allow the rice to cool and then fluff the rice up with a fork.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan, add the bay leaf and the ground paste. Saute the pulao masala till it turns brown and fragrant. Add the cooked rice, paneer, bread croutons and vegetables to this masala and mix well.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Check the salt and adjust to suit your taste and serve. Serve the Karnataka Style Mixed Vegetable Pulao Recipe along with a bowl of Tomato Onion Raita for lunch or dinner or even pack it into your lunch box.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: We begin making the Southekayi Seppe Chutney Recipe (Mangalore Cucumber Peel Chutney Recipe) by peeling the skin of the mangalore cucumber. Keep the flesh for later use. Heat Kadai with oil, fry these chopped peel till it is soft.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Then take them out. In the same kadai, add the urad dal, chana dal and coconut and roast them for 2 minutes. Once done grind along with the rest of the ingredients mentioned above including the Mangalore peel.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Season it with salt if required and put it into a serving cup. Heat a small kadai, and temper the ingredients by crackling the mustard seeds and curry leaves and pour it over the chutney.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Southekayi Seppe Chutney Recipe (Mangalore Cucumber Peel Chutney Recipe) along with Konkani Style Phanna Doddak Recipe (Tempered Dosa Recipe) for your morning breakfast.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To make the Karuvepillai Pachadi Recipe, we will first make the Karuvepillai Pachadi Masala.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: To make the Karuvepillai Pachadi MasalaIn a dry mixer jar, combine the curry leaves, ginger, green chilli, cumin seeds, whole black pepper corns and pulse it with absolutely no water.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: You will see a a dry fiber like coarse mixture. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Getting ahead, to make the Karuvepillai Pachadi in a mixing bowl, combine the yogurt and salt, and whisk well until smooth, add the freshly ground Karuvepillai Pachadi Masala and give it a good mix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Transfer the Karuvepillai Pachadi to a serving bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Temper
steps.detail: To make the tadka for the Karuvepillai Pachadi In a tadka pan, heat the oil on medium flame, add the mustard seeds and allow them to splutter, then add the urad dal and allow it to turn into a light brown colour, next add the curry leaves.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once you see the curry leaves crackle, add the red chilli and turn off the flame. Pour this tadka over the Karuvepillai Pachadi and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Karuvepillai Pachadi as a side dish along with Avarekalu Pulao Recipe and Raw Mango Cucumber Salad Recipe with Roasted Peanuts for a complete meal.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: To begin making the Karuveppilai Chicken Fry Recipe, wash and clean the chicken thoroughly.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: For the Karuveppilai MasalaHeat a skillet on low flame, add curry leaves, cinnamon stick, star anise, cardamom pod, stone flower, fennel seeds, dry red chillies, black peppercorns and dry roast all of them.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Roast until the aroma of spices wafts through. This will take about 5-7 minutes. Turn off the flame. Allow the spices to cool down to room temperature and grind it into a smooth powder using a mixer-grinder. Set aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next, place a heavy bottom pan on medium flame, add some oil. Once the oil is hot, add ginger and garlic and saute for a couple of minutes. Add in onions and saute till they turn translucent. This will take about a minute or two.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onion have softened, add the green chillies and chicken pieces along with turmeric powder. Stir the ingredients together until the chicken is half cooked.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in the Karuveppilai Masala and coriander powder, sprinkle salt and keep roasting until the chicken is well cooked. You can sprinkle some water if the masala is getting stuck at the bottom. Cover and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Finally add chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karuveppilai Chicken Fry Recipe as an appetizer with chilled Beer or serve it along with a simple Sunday lunch with Chettinad Style Poondu Rasam Recipe - Garlic Rasam Recipe, piping hot Steamed Rice and Elai Vadam Recipe for a comforting South Indian lunch.

name: Karwar Style Dali Ambat Ani Maska Sang

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: To begin making the Karwar Style Dali Ambat Ani Maska Sang Recipe-Toor Dal and Drumsticks Pod Curry by pressure cooking the toor dal in a pressure cooker with 1 1/2 cup of water for about 4 whistles.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Release the pressure naturally. Dry roast the coriander seeds and dry chillies in a small skillet without oil till it becomes brown, once done set aside to cool.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Now in a mixer, grind the roasted coriander seeds, dry red chillies along with coconut to a smooth paste and set aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: We will also mash the dal into a smooth paste, add 1 cup water and drumstick pods, cook till the pods are soft. This will take about 10 minutes. Transfer the coconut mixture to the dal and simmer it for 10 more minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add kokum rind and jaggery and cook it again till it combines and Dali Ambat comes together.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karwar Style Dali Ambat Ani Maska Sang Recipe-Toor Dal and Drumsticks Pod Curry along with steam rice and Manga Rasam Recipe to enjoy a weekend Meal.

ingredients.text: 3 Ripe Bananas - cut into thick roundels

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Karwar Style Kelya Sasav Recipe-Ripened Banana Relish by grinding the coconut, jaggery and dry red chillies in a hand blender to a coarse paste.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix it along with the sliced banana and toss so that it is mixed thoroughly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Karwar Style Kelya Sasav Recipe-Ripened Banana Relish as a snack after school or even serve it as a side dish along with Karwar Style Kalingana Polo Recipe - Watermelon Rind Dosa as a sweet Breakfast.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Kashmiri Kokur Yakhni recipe, wash chicken nicely and drain off water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat mustard oil in a pressure cooker and add chicken into it along with some salt, fennel powder, crushed big cardamom, asafoetida, cinnamon and bay leaf and fry for 5 minutes on full flame.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Put 1/2 a glass of water, stir and pressure-cook upto 1-2 whistles only. Heat some ghee in a wok/kadai and add cumin and cloves into it. Keep the heat low and now add well-whisked curd and turn the flames high.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Keep stirring on high flames till it starts to boil. Stir continuously so that the curd doesn't curdle. While the curd is boiling add the chicken along with the spices and left over pure ghee and cook for another 5 to 8 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once the chicken is nicely cooked, turn off the gas and add lot of crushed dry mint on top. Serve Kashmiri Kokur Yakhni along with Steamed rice and Kachumber Salad for a weekday meal.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup Coconut milk - or grated fresh coconut

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: To prepare Kerala Chicken Curry With Freshly Ground Spices, get prep with all the ingredients and marinate chicken with curd and salt for 2 hours. To make the fresh masala.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: In a shallow frying pan, dry roast the peppercorns, coriander seeds, cinnamon stick, fennel and dried red chilies. Roast for about 5 minutes on medium-low flame.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Then turn off the flame, allow it to cool and grind to a corase powder using a mixer-grinder. Heat oil in kadai, add mustard seeds. When it splutters, add onion and curry leaves.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Sauté.When onions are lightly brown, add ginger, garlic, and sauté for a minute. Add chicken, half of the ground masala, and salt. If using grated or desiccated coconut, add in.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Mix them, cover with a lid, simmer and cook till the chicken is almost done, for about 15-20 minutes at least. Keep sautéing occasionally to avoid charring.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: If using coconut milk, add it now, and simmer for five more minutes till well combined and cooked. Lastly, add the reserved half of the ground masala and give it a nice stir.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.detail: Keep it covered for 5-10 minutes before serving, to help the flavors combine well.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kerala Chicken Curry With Freshly Ground Spices along with Kerala Style Appam Recipe (Without Yeast) or Ghee Rice Recipe | Neychoru and a side of Meen Varuthathu Recipe - Kerala Style Fish Fry for a complete meal.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.detail: To begin making the Kerala Style Chemmeen Moilee Recipe - Prawn Curry, marinate the shrimps with turmeric powder and lemon juice and keep it aside for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil, add cinnamon, cardamom pods, pepper corns and allow it to sizzle. Add whole shallots and saute until they turn slightly brown. Once done add chopped ginger, garlic and saute until they soften.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Now add the tomatoes and salt to taste. Do not mash them completely. Cook till the tomatoes just turn soft. Once done add coconut milk along with turmeric powder and salt and bring it to a boil.

steps.title: Stir
steps.detail: Stir in the sugar and slowly drop in the shrimps and cook in a medium heat for about 20 minutes till the shrimp are cooked. Once done turn off the heat and transfer the Kerala Style Chemmeen Moilee to a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kerala Style Chemmeen Moilee Recipe along with Steamed Rice or kerala parotta and Cabbage Thoran.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.detail: To begin making the Kerala Style Mutton Stew Recipe, clean and wash the mutton pieces and keep them aside. Dice the onion, chillies, and tomatoes into small pieces. Peel and dice the potatoes into four pieces and keep it aside.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind the coriander seeds and poppy seeds separately to a fine paste. Grind the ginger and garlic together.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next add onions, chilies, tomatoes, spices and salt to the mutton and give it a good stir so that mutton pieces are coated properly. Heat the oil and add spices including poppy seeds, cinnamon, cloves and coriander seeds.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook it for few minutes and make sure that spices are not getting burnt. Add the mutton and fry it for a while. Add just sufficient water to cook the mutton; cook till the time mutton pieces become tender and cooked.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Next, add the grated coconut & chopped coriander leaves. Cook it for 7 to 9 minutes on low heat and serve it hot. Serve Kerala Style Mutton Stew along with Kerala Pumpkin Pachadi and Kerala Parotta for a weekday meal.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: To begin making the Kerala Style Pazham Pori Recipe (Banana Fry), slice each banana into lengthwise pieces of about 1 to 1-1/2 inches. In a bowl, combine the flour, milk, coconut and salt to make a smooth thick batter.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add additional flour if you feel the batter is thin. Preheat oil for deep frying; once the oil is heated, dip the sliced banana pieces in the flour batter until it coats well.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Dip the batter coated banana into the oil and fry until golden brown. Proceed the same way with the remaining banana pieces and serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kerala Style Pazham Pori (Banana Fry) for breakfast or as a tea time snack or even as an appetiser for parties with hot Masala Chai.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: We begin by baking Kara Obbattu Recipe(Bread Stuffed with Spicy Potato Mixture Recipe) the dough by combining all the ingredients with curd and soak it for 10 minutes then knead with enough water till it is soft and stretchy.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add oil for a good binding. For the filling heat the pan with oil and temper with cumin and curry leaves. Then add the rest of the ingredients except boiled potato and the spice powders.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onions are translucent add the spice powders. Then add the mashed potato and combine it together, finally add some coriander leaves. Bind them and make small balls and keep it aside.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Make small balls and divide the dough equally. Keeping a little flour for dusting handy on a plate; roll out the dough into 3 inch diameter circles. Place a portion of the filling (potato) mixture into the center of the circle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.detail: Bring edges of the circle towards the center and fold over to cover the entire filling; making sure the edges are all sealed well by pinching them together if there is any opening.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.detail: Flatten the stuffed dough; dust the dough over a little flour and roll gently into a 5 to 6 inch diameter circle taking care not to put too much pressure as the filling can come out of the dough.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Preheat an iron skillet on medium-high; place the rolled obbattu onto the skillet to cook until golden brown on both sides. You can cook the obbattu with ghee to give it a richer taste and flavor.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Repeat the above process for all the remaining dough and filling portions. Serve the Karnataka style Kara Obbattu hot with ghee smeared on the top, or with allam pachadi recipe

ingredients.text: 1 Onion - cut into rounds for garnish

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making Khatua Recipe, wash the rice and toor dal and soak it water for a hour.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.detail: Now pressure cook the soaked rice and dal along with turmeric, salt, 5 cups of water for 5 to 6 whistles and let the pressure release in its own. Open the lid, mash the khichdi well and keep aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat ghee in a small tadka pan, add the finely chopped onions and saute till translucent. Roughly pound the garlic and green chillies using a mortar and pestle and add it to the tadka pan.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.detail: Saute till the raw smell of the garlic goes away. Pour this tadka into the cooked khichdi, add in the lemon juice and mix well.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with the onions rings, and serve the Khatua Recipe along with some curd, salad and papad for a weeknight dinner. Serve Khatua along with Burani Raita, Palak Raita or any other raita of your choice.

ingredients.text: 1 to 1 1/4 Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - finely chopped
1 tablespoon Sunflower Oil - as required for shallow frying

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: To begin making the Kobiche Vade Recipe, first grind together chillies, ginger, cumin seeds and garlic in a blender or mortar pestle.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients like the cabbage, multigrain flour, gram flour, rice flour, green chillies, ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, ajwain, coriander leaves, lemon juice and salt.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Use some water to make a thick batter of dropping consistency. Heat a non-stick Appam pan. Drizzle some oil in each of the cavities. Drop about 2 tablespoon batter into each cavity. Cover and cook on low flame till they brown.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Using a wooden skewer turn the Kobiche vade upside down and cook for a couple of minutes more till golden brown on all sides. Serve Kobiche Vade with Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and Masala Chai.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Whole Black Peppercorns - coarsely pounded

steps.title: Chop
steps.detail: To begin making the Kodava Kummu Curry Recipe chop all the ingredients and keep it ready. Grind fresh coconut, jeera seeds and garlic. Add little water and grind it into a smooth paste. Keep this aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil, add in curry leaves and allow it to sparkle for few seconds, add in dry red chillies and peppercorns and allow them to sizzle for few seconds. Add sliced onions and green chillies and saute till they soften.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in chopped mushroom and keep sautéing until it leaves out moisture. Add in the ground paste and saute till the paste is cooked well.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add chopped tomatoes and sprinkle all the spice powders like coriander powder, turmeric powder and salt to taste. Pour about 1/2 cup water and allow the Kummu Curry/ Coorg Mushroom Curry to simmer for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, check the salt and seasonings and adjust according to taste. Turn off the heat and transfer the Kodava Kummu Curry to a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kodava Kummu Curry Recipe- Spicy Mushroom Gravy along with Ghee Rice/ Neychoru, Parotta and a Moong Sprouts Usal for a wholesome weeknight lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Kolambi Bhaath, In a heavy bottom wok/kadhai, heat oil and add hing to it till it sizzles. Next, add jeera and sauté till golden brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add all the dry masalas including cloves, cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaves. Fry till they are fragrant. Add onion, curry leaves, garlic and ginger and sauté further till the onions turn translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add tomatoes and fry till they are mushy and oil separates. Add turmeric powder, chilli powder and then add the prawns. Fry for about 3 to 4 minutes till the prawns are cooked. Mix it with boiled rice delicately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve hot garnished with fresh coriander leaves. Serve Kolambi Bhaath with Burani Raita, Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita or any other Raita of your choice for a perfect weekday lunch or dinner.

name: Kolhapuri Khanda Lasun Masala Spice Mix

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Kolhapuri Khanda Lasun Masala, heat a sauce pan and dry roast the spices like coriander seeds, sesame seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds and bay leaves till they are light brown. You will get a nice aroma.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Roast them for about 10 minutes and keep it aside. Add little oil and roast the other spices like, peppercorns, cloves, broken cardamom pods, star anise, lichen and hing. Roast them till you get a nice aroma for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Keep it aside. In the same pan add some more oil and add the onions and saute them till they become brown. Once done remove the onions and add grated coconut and toast them until brown. Keep it aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the dry red chilies and roast them as well till they crisp up. Once done add all the roasted spices and ingredients into a mixer along with ginger, garlic and salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Blitz it to a coarse powder and store the spice for later use. Serve the kolhapuri Khanda Lasun Masala Spice Mix in Bhadang Recipe (Puffed Rice Snack Mix) to create a tasty snack.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: To begin making the Kholapuri Palak Egg Curry Recipe, we will first prepare the hard boiled eggs, de shell them and halve them and keep aside.

steps.title: Grind
steps.detail: Grind the ingredients that are mentioned in the "To Grind" list which includes onion, ginger, garlic, green chillies, almonds to a smooth paste and keep it ready.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil, add cumin seeds, cloves, bay leaf, dry red chillies and allow it to crackle. Add the ground paste, and stir fry until the raw smell of the onions goes away.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in poppy seeds and freshly grated coconut, stir fry them for atleast 15 minutes till they turn brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the coconut turn brown, you can add chopped tomatoes, salt and turmeric powder and stir until all ingredients combine well. Cook until the tomatoes turn mushy, later add spinach and garam masala powder and give it a mix.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Keep on a low flame for at least 10 minutes until the spinach wilts. Allow this mixture it to cool down and grind it to a coarse paste.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a flat pan with oil, place the cut egg on the flat side and roast for atleast 2 minutes till they get a charred surface. Do not flip them, once done keep them aside.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Into the same pan, add the ground paste and cook till the gravy leaves out some oil and check for salt. Add the roasted egg into the gravy and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kolhapure Palak Egg Curry Recipe along with Garlic Naan, Jeera rice and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita to make it a complete meal.

ingredients.text: 2 Dry Red Chillies - (adjust according to the heat of the chilli)
1 Dry Red Chilli - cut it into smaller pieces

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Kongunadu Kathirikai Rasam Recipe, soak the coriander seeds, tuvar dal, cumin seeds, dry red chillies, garlic pods, peppercorns, curry leaves, coriander leaves, for 30 minutes and then transfer to a mixer jar and grind them to a fine paste in a mixer grinder.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Cut the crown of the baby brinjals and slit cutting just half way through the brinjals. Place the tamarind water in the sauce pan along with the slit brinjals, tomatoes, turmeric powder and salt.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook this until the brinjals have softened. Once the brinjals have softened, add the freshly ground rasam masala, 2 more additional cups of water and salt to taste. Bring the Kathirikai Rasam to a brisk boil.

steps.title: Boil
steps.detail: Once it comes to a brisk boil, turn the heat to low and simmer the rasam for about 10 minutes until you notice it starts to froth up. At this stage turn off the heat.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To Season The RasamHeat ghee in skillet or tadka pan on medium heat; add the mustard seeds and allow to to crackle. Add the red chili, curry leaves and asafoetida and keep it going for a few seconds.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Pour the seasoning into the Kathirikai Rasam and serve. Serve the Kongunadu Brinjal Rasam along with steamed rice topped with ghee and a poriyal like Beetroot Curry.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Pearl onions (Sambar Onions) - peeled and kept whole
Coriander (Dhania) Leaves - small bunch finely chopped

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Kongunadu Special Pattani Biryani Recipe, wash rice and soak in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set it aside. Heat a tablespoon of oil in a heavy bottomed pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add chopped mint leaves, bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and fennel seeds. Saute for a minute. Add Shallots (sambar onions) and fry for about 5 minutes till golden. Add the ginger, garlic and green chillies.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Cook for another 2 minutes, stirring continuously until you can smell a good aroma. Add in the tomatoes, turmeric and saute until the tomato softens. Finally add in the green peas, the washed rice and 4 cups of water.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add salt to taste. Bring the Pattani Biryani to a brisk boil. Once the rice comes to a brisk boil, turn the heat to low, cover the pan and cook the Pattani Biryani until all the water is absorbed and rice is tender and fluffy.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Once done, turn off the heat and allow the Kongunadu Special Pattani Biryani to rest in the pan for 5 minutes and then open to stir in lime juice and coriander leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kongunadu Special Pattani Biryani along with a Thakkali Vengaya Pachadi for lunch or a weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: To begin making the Kongunadu Style Kalan kuzhambu Recipe, we will heat a skillet with oil, add cloves, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, fennel seeds and cumin seeds. Allow it to sizzle for few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add ginger and garlic and saute till they soften. Add chopped onions and saute till they turn translucent and add grated coconut and saute till they turn light brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add garam masala and mix well, cook for another 10 minutes and switch off the heat. Rest for few seconds and grind it along with water to a smooth paste.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Heat a kadai with oil, add mustard seeds and allow it to splutter for few seconds, add curry leaves and allow it to crackle. Add onions and saute till they turn translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add in chopped green chillies and mushroom and toss well till the mushroom has cooked.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: You can add the freshly ground paste now and mix well, check for salt and add 1 cup of water and cook for around 10 minutes a until it becomes to a rolling boil, turn off the flame, transfer into a serving bowl and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve the Kongunadu Style Kalan kuzhambu Recipe along with parotta and Moong Sprouts Usal Recipe (Indian Salad Chaat).

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoon Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - roasted
3 Dry Red Chillies - adjust according to tasted

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: To begin making the Kongunadu Urulai Kurma Recipe, in a small pan, lightly dry roast all the ingredients given under ‘to roast and grind’ till they turn fragrant.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Once roasted, allow it to cool a little and grind into a smooth paste adding a little warm water. Keep the paste aside. Heat a wide pan or kadai with ghee. Add the grated ginger and garlic and saute them for a few seconds.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Add the chopped onions, little salt and keep stirring over low flame for one minute or till the time the onions turn glossy and lightly brown.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: Once the onions are done, add the tomato puree, turmeric powder, the ground masala and the boiled potatoes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Turn the heat to low, cover the pan and simmer the Kurma for about 5 minutes until the spices come through into the potatoes. After 5 minutes, once done, check the salt and adjust to suit your taste and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.detail: Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve Kongunadu Urulai Kurma along with Dosas for a quick weeknight dinner or even for parties.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Dosa rice - soaked for 1 hour
Sunflower Oil - for greasing the skillet

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Konkani Style Cabbage Sanna Polo Recipe, soak the raw rice for an hour. Then grind it along with grated coconut, red chillies and tamarind to a smooth paste adding very little water.

steps.title: Add
steps.detail: The consistency of the batter should be a little thicker than the normal dosa batter. Add the finely chopped cabbage, onions to the batter and season with salt. Heat the skillet on a medium flame and grease it with a little oil.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Pour a ladle full of batter and spread it in swift circular motions to make thin dosa of about 4-6 inch diameter. Pour a little oil from the sides and let it cook for about three minutes on low flame.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Once it is cooked on one side, flip it and cook on the other side for three more minutes. Similarly, make more dosas with the remaining batter.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Konkani Style Cabbage Sanna Polo Recipe for breakfast along with Mysore Chutney or Capsicum Chutney and Filter Coffee for breakfast.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons Sunflower Oil - to make dosas

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Doddak Recipe, wash and soak the split urad dal for 1 hour in enough water. Grind it to a smooth fluffy batter in a mixer grinder by adding enough water.

steps.title: Mix
steps.detail: Take this mixture out in a big mixing bowl, add the idli or normal rava, grated ginger and green chilli, season with salt and make a thick batter with little water.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: The consistency of the batter should be little thicker than the dosa batter. Heat a skillet in medium heat, grease it with a little oil and pour a laddle full of this doddak batter an spread to a thick 4 inch diameter in size.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: Smear a little oil on the sides and let it cook on one side. Once done, flip over and cook the other side and remove it in a plate. Similarly, prepare the Doddaks with the remaining batter and serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Doddak Recipe along with South Indian Coconut Chutney or Carrot Chutney for breakfast or as a quick lunch box recipe for kids.

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: To begin making the Pathrode Recipe, wash and soak the rice and dal in water for 3 to 6 hours. Wash the colocasia leaves, remove the stem & the large veins of the leaves with the help of a knife.

steps.title: Cook
steps.detail: This will help them cook fast and make them less itchy. Drain off the excess water from rice and grind all mentioned masala ingredients (except the leaves) to chutney/spread consistency. Now first take the largest/biggest leaf.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.detail: Keep leaf upside down and smear a layer of masala on back side of leaf. Place the second leaf on top of the first leaf & smear masala. Repeat the process for 3 to 5 leaves. In one pathravadev roll there should be minimum 3 leaves.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.detail: Now pathravade is ready for rolls. Firstly fold the sides of the leaf towards the centre and then roll along length of the leaves to make a roll. After it is rolled, smear the paste on top of it.

steps.title: Steam
steps.detail: Once the rolls are done, steam cook these rolls 15 to 20 minutes. Wait till the pathravade cools down a bit. Once the pathravade is cooled, you can serve them in 2 ways.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Just slice them, smear little butter and relish or shallow fry them with coconut oil till they turn crisp. Serve hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.detail: Serve Pathravade as a side dish along with your Konkan meal of Konkani Style Vengaya Sagle and Tawa Parathas during weekday lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: To begin making the Konkani Style Pomfret Fry Recipe, we will wash the fish and keep it ready. Using a knife, make three slits diagonally on either side of the fish. This will help the masala to seep inside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.detail: Sprinkle salt and turmeric powder on either side and massage well.

steps.title: Heat
steps.detail: Keep asideTo make the masalaHeat a flat skillet on medium heat, dry roast the grated coconut, red chillies, garlic, ginger, green chillies, cumin seeds and cardamom pods.

steps.title: Sauté
